chapters.title: Chapter 1701: Mo Shentian’s Plans
paragraphs: Mo Shentian looked at his three sons, observing them with a serious gaze. "My subordinates have discovered the Endless Domain, and I want the three of you to go there."

Mo Zainan raised an eyebrow, as she didn’t expect that her husband would send their three sons away, and he didn’t discuss it with her. She didn’t say anything and waited for her husband’s next order, but she contacted her subordinates to ask about it. ’Could it be that he already knows everything?’
The eyes of Mo Zixiao, Mo Taizi, and Mo Tianqi flickered upon hearing that. "Which demon races should we meet in that domain, Father?"
"Xie Yao, Xie Yan, and several other demon race leaders." Mo Shentian gave his three sons the list of demon race leaders. "Go now."
"Yes, Father." Mo Zixiao, Mo Taizi, and Mo Tianqi immediately left the palace. The third prince contacted Zhang Fei through one of his clones, informing him of his father’s plans.
Mo Zainan couldn’t help but ask. "What exactly are you planning, husband? Why do you suddenly intend to gather those demons?"

"I need them to attack Qian Yan, Wu Mian, the Thousand Eyes Demon Domain, and the Faceless Demon Domain." Mo Zainan was shocked by this. "I’ve waited too long to unite all the demon races, and I’m running out of patience now. Since we haven’t managed to locate the other demon domains, I’ll start with those two demon races."
Mo Zainan frowned for a moment. "Are you sure you want to face Qian Yan now? I don’t doubt your ability to face Wu Mian, but that demon beast is different, and he has connections to the four perils."

"I’ll start with Wu Mian and his Faceless Demon Race first." Mo Zainan wasn’t surprised by her husband’s decision because that demon race was the weakest of the ten major demon races. "If I manage to subdue that weakling demon god, it will be easier for us to find the other demon races, and I will attack the weakest one first."
"Are you targeting Qi Qingxiu, Nalan Shizhe, and Ye Mingran?"
"You already know my goal, so I don’t need to explain it to you anymore." Mo Shentian walked away, and he asked his two daughters-in-law to follow him.
Mo Zainan was confused by that. "Why did he ask them to follow him? Fortunately, those two are not the real ones, and the real ones are by Zhang Fei’s side."
"Mother." Mo Zainan looked at her two daughters, who were also fake. "Why do I feel like my father has changed since he came back from the tunnel?"
Mo Zainan nodded to Mo Anqi. "Your father has indeed changed, and he didn’t tell me about his plans with your fake sisters-in-law."
"Do we need to tell Zhang Fei about this, Mother?" Mo Yousha asked.
"You two don’t need to get involved in this matter, and you both should just enjoy your lives at the Moonlit Passion Temple."
"Hehe," Mo Anqi giggled. "Zhang Fei sent our real bodies to the Zenith Solar Sanctum with the others, and we’ll cultivate there for the time being."
"Oh?" Mo Zainan was a little surprised. "How did Zhang Fei manage to bring you two to that dungeon? As I recall, the portal connecting to that place won’t open until about a thousand years from now."
"Mother, you were closer to Zhang Fei, remember?" Mo Zainan was a little embarrassed when Mo Anqi asked that. "Hehe! My mother is such a shy woman! Do you want to be with him?"
Mo Zainan nodded slightly. "I want to be with him, but we can never be together as long as your father is still around."

"That’s true." Mo Anqi nodded. "After I spent a few years in the Moonlit Passion Temple, I felt that Zhang Fei was much better than my father, and he treated all races with respect and fairness. If you want to be with him in the future, my sister and I will support you."
"Are you two okay with that?"

Mo Anqi and Mo Yousha nodded. "Mother, we’ve known for a long time that our father never loved us, and he only saw us as his tools. Besides, we can see that you’ve become more cheerful after getting to know Zhang Fei, so we’ll support you if you want to be with him."
"Let’s see in the future." Then, Mo Zainan asked them. "Do you two like Zhang Fei?"

"No," Mo Anqi shook her head. "Zhang Fei treated me well, and he also gave me many beneficial pills, but I don’t have that kind of interest in him. In fact, I like someone from the Moonlit Passion Temple, but our relationship is still normal, so I won’t tell you his identity now."
"Which race is that man from?"

"He’s human, Mother." Mo Zainan looked at Mo Anqi with a curious gaze. "Hehe! He knows my identity as a celestial demon, but he doesn’t have a problem with it, and I often spend time with his family."

"If you two like each other, I will support your choice, and you must tell me his identity once you are officially a couple." Mo Zainan looked at her second daughter. "What about you, Yousha? Did you find a man who caught your eye there?"
Mo Yousha nodded slightly. "I found someone I like, and our relationship is going well. He’s much weaker than me because he’s a beast from the upper realm, but I like him."
"Which beast race is he from?"

"The Golden Fox Race, Mother." Mo Zainan was surprised to hear that because there was no golden fox race in the Paradise Realm. "His name is Huli Taichu, and he is a descendant of one of Zhang Fei’s wives."

Mo Zainan nodded with a happy smile. "As long as you two like them, and they treat you well, I will support your relationship with them. After Zhang Fei has settled the situation in our domain and defeated your father, you two must bring them here to meet me."
"We will."
"You two can go back to your respective places now." After they left, Mo Zainan checked Mo Shentian’s seclusion place. "What exactly was he planning? Why did he bring them there?"

After spending a lot of time with Zhang Fei and being intimate with him, Mo Zainan no longer cared about Mo Shentian. She returned to her room to cultivate, even though she knew it would be difficult for her to reach the Demon God Level.
In his seclusion, Mo Shentian took off his clothes and stared at his two daughters-in-law. "Strip."
Shang Xueli followed Mo Shentian’s orders and took off her dress. After all, she wasn’t the real her, and she was an artificial doll.

Nalan Wangzi, who was standing in front of Mo Shentian, was also not the original one. She was a male demon from the Soul-Devouring Race whom Zhang Fei deliberately turned into one. She followed his orders and took off her dress.
Mo Shentian didn’t flinch seeing the two naked women in front of him, and he touched their foreheads, imparting a technique to them. "Learn the technique first and dual cultivate with me after."
"Yes, Demon God." Shang Xueli and Nalan Wangzi hurriedly sat cross-legged to learn the technique.

Mo Shentian narrowed his eyes as he observed Shang Xueli. He remembered his daughter-in-law’s condition before he went into the tunnel, but she had recovered when he returned to his domain some time ago, and she seemed relaxed, unlike in the past. ’Did something happen to her while I was away? I thought she would never recover, but it turned out I was wrong.’

Mo Shentian gave up after discovering nothing unusual about Shang Xueli. He observed Nalan Wanzi, but he also found nothing unusual about her because Zhang Fei’s body modification ability was undetectable, and he didn’t realize that his second daughter-in-law was actually a male demon.
If Mo Shentian realized the true identity of Nalan Wangzi sitting in front of him was a male demon, he would definitely vomit blood.
After Shang Xueli and Nalan Wangzi finished learning the technique, Mo Shentian asked them to serve him, and the moans of the two women continued to echo throughout the area for a long time.
At the pond in the Zenith Solar Sanctum, Shang Xueli told Qi Qingxiu, Nalan Shizhe, Ye Mingran, Dong Xuanyin, and Sha Qingge about the situation in the Celestial Demon Race.

"Haha," Nalan Shizhe laughed heartily after hearing all this. "I didn’t expect Mo Shentian to be so crazy! He must have lost his mind after being trapped in the tunnel for so many years! If he knew that Nalan Wangzi, who was with him, was a male demon, he would probably commit suicide out of shame in the future."
"Isn’t that good? Zhang Fei must have gotten this information, and he’s probably already hatched a plan against Mo Shentian by now." Dong Xuanyin casually said.
Ye Mingran didn’t think much of Mo Shentian, and she was more worried about Shang Xueli. "Does your artificial doll’s activities not affect you, Xueli?"
"No," Shang Xueli replied with a shake of her head. "The doll and I are separate from each other, and I control it using my consciousness, so its activities don’t affect me."
Qi Qingxiu spoke. "Xueli, I think you should use the doll to do something to Mo Shentian."
"What should I do to him, Big Sis Qingxiu?"
"Hmm?" Qi Qingxiu thought for a moment. "I don’t have any ideas for that, so I think we should discuss this matter with Zhang Fei first."
"What are you guys talking about?" They looked at Feng Yao, who had just arrived with Tian Shuying.
"We were talking about Mo Shentian’s madness."
"Tell me."

chapters.title: Chapter 1702: Yin-Yang Immortal Valley
paragraphs: Shang Xueli recounted everything to Feng Yao.

"I see." Feng Yao glanced at Tian Shuying, who had an ugly expression on her face due to the presence of the female demons. "Little Shuying, I understand your hatred for the demons because your Sun Clan was destroyed by them, but all these women are not members of the Moon Clan, and they are my husband’s wives. You shouldn’t look at them with hatred because they don’t have any problem with you, and my husband never likes it when someone looks at all his wives with such hatred."
"Humph!" Tian Shuying snorted.

"Senior, you should have listened to Sister Yao." Tian Shuying looked at Qi Qingxiu with a frown. "You may have been a powerful cultivator in the past, but you won’t be able to fight us with that weak soul of yours. Besides, our husband loves us, and he will never tolerate your attitude towards us."

Ye Mingran spoke. "Believe it or not, our husband is a relaxed but also ruthless person, and he will not hesitate to eliminate anyone he deems a threat to us. Never mind outsiders; he killed his big brother and ex-lover in the past, so you shouldn’t underestimate him."
"Did he really kill his big brother and ex-lover?" Tian Shuying asked Feng Yao.

"He killed them with his own hands." Feng Yao told Tian Shuying about the problems between Zhang Fei, Zhang He, and Chen Xin in the past. "Since the two of them didn’t change and continued to do bad things, our husband killed them."

"Does that mean he will kill you all if you guys do anything that violates his limits?" Tian Shuying felt the question was ridiculous since they were Zhang Fei’s wives, but she was also curious about the answer.

"He will." Tian Shuying was stunned by their reply, which was given in unison. "Our husband is a loving and easygoing person, but he truly hates betrayal. If we betray him or do anything bad to our other sisters, he won’t hesitate to kill us, even if we are his wives."
"Why did you choose to be with a madman like him? Killing his own wives is really crazy!" Tian Shuying shouted.

"We’re willing to be his wives because there’s no better man than him in this universe." Their answer left Tian Shuying speechless. "As long as we don’t hurt or betray him, he will never kill us, so we have no problem with that."
Tian Shuying felt that Qi Qingxiu and the others had gone too crazy, and they were blinded by their feelings for Zhang Fei. She didn’t ask further, removed her dress, and entered the pond.
"Can you feel the benefits of this pond with just your soul, Senior?" Sha Qingge curiously asked.
Tian Shuying shook her head. "This pond is useless for a dead woman like me, and I just want to soak here."
’This old ghost must be lonely since she’s been dead for so long.’ They thought.
"So, what do you think about Mo Shentian, Sister Yao?" Nalan Shizhe asked.

Feng Yao’s eyebrows knitted together. "Mo Shentian must be planning something by dual cultivating with the fake Nalan Wangzi and the fake Shang Xueli, but I can’t guess his plans. If I remember correctly, your domain is quite close to Wu Mian’s domain, right, Qingxiu?"
"Yes," Qi Qingxiu nodded. "Since our two domains are so close, Wu Mian protected my domain while I was away. Do you think Mo Shentian will attack my domain?"
"Isn’t that obvious from Shang Xueli’s previous story?" Qi Qingxiu sighed as she nodded. "Wu Mian is the weakest among the ten demon gods, so Mo Shentian plans to attack him and his domain first."
"If Wu Mian and his domain fall, Mo Shentian will attack me and my domain after that."

"Mo Shentian is confident in his demon abilities, but he greatly underestimates Wu Mian’s abilities, and he won’t be able to find him. Besides, he still doesn’t know that his three sons are already in our husband’s hands, and they’ve already told him about their father’s plans, so you don’t need to worry about that."
"What is our husband planning to do to Mo Shentian, Sister Yao?"

"Nothing." Feng Yao shook her head at Ye Mingran. "Our husband has decided not to attack Mo Shentian for now, but that doesn’t mean he will stay silent. He will do something to hinder his plans, so we don’t need to worry about this matter and leave everything to him."
"Is your husband really that capable, Guang Zhiyi?"

Feng Yao looked at Tian Shuying, smiling. "If my husband wasn’t capable, I wouldn’t choose him as my husband, right? Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and Dong Xuanyin are demon gods from the Paradise Realm. They’ve gathered here because of my husband, so you should already know whether he’s capable or not, right?"
"He’s just a pervert!" Tian Shuying snorted.
"Hahaha," Dong Xuanyin laughed. "Try saying that in front of our husband, Senior."

Tian Shuying looked at Dong Xuanyin before raising an eyebrow at her strange smile, and the other female demons also had similarly strange smiles on their faces, giving her goosebumps. ’I don’t understand why women of such high status would be willing to accept a young man who is much weaker than them.’
"Is Mo Shentian dual cultivating with your doll and the fake Nalan Wangzi, Xueli?"
Shang Xueli nodded at Feng Yao. "Mo Shentian is dual cultivating with the fake Nalan Wangzi right now, but his dual cultivation method is truly strange, Big Sis Yao."
"Show us."
"Alright." Shang Xueli created a qi screen showing Mo Shentian’s activities, causing all the women present to frown.
"What did Mo Shentian do to her?" Nalan Shizhe asked with a hint of anger, as the fake Nalan Wangzi was one of her subordinates.
"How could the fake Nalan Wangzi’s body turn black like that?"
"She looked like she was in pain."
"Mo Shentian’s dual cultivation technique is truly evil, and it’s completely different from our husband’s technique."
"Ugh! That’s terrible!" Sha Qingge covered her eyes as her body trembled.
Tian Shuying seriously stared at the qi screen, trying to recall Mo Shentian’s technique. "Guang Zhiyi, that technique belongs to the—"

"Yes," Feng Yao nodded solemnly. "Mo Shentian’s technique belonged to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley in the past. Although they use ’immortal’ in the name of their sect, the people of that sect are evil dual cultivators, and they use their partners’ bodies as cultivation furnaces. Every time they use that technique on their partner, it shortens their partner’s lifespan by several years."
"What?" Qi Qingxiu and the others cried out in shock. "How could they have such a terrifying technique?"
"The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley has two techniques, one for men and one for women. The technique for men is the Yin Sacrifice Art, and the technique for women is the Yang Sacrifice Art."
"Aren’t the two techniques reversed?"
"No," Feng Yao shook her head. "Men use the Yin Sacrifice Art to transform a woman’s body into a cultivation furnace, so only men can use it, and vice versa with the Yang Sacrifice Art."
"So, whether they are men or women who are used for cultivation furnaces, they will experience a reduction in lifespan every time they dual cultivate?"
Feng Yao sighed. "If I remember correctly, their lifespan will be reduced by ten years in a single session of dual cultivation."
"Fortunately, our husband didn’t use that kind of technique, or we would have died much too soon." Qi Qingxiu muttered softly.
Ye Mingran blushed as she recalled Zhang Fei’s strength in bed. "Our husband can do dual cultivation without rest for several whole months."
"All women would die prematurely if our husband used that technique on us." Dong Xuanyin shook her head.
Nalan Shizhe chose not to comment because she was Zhang Fei’s mother-in-law, and she had never dual cultivated with him, so she wasn’t sure about his prowess in bed.
Sha Qingge blushed as she listened to them, and her mind spun rapidly with wild imaginations about her relationship with Zhang Fei.
Shang Xueli looked calmer because she was used to hearing the moans of all the women in the pavilion when they dual cultivated with Zhang Fei.

"Where did that man get that technique?" Feng Yao explained to Tian Shuying that the Ancient Realm and the Paradise Realm overlap, resulting in the appearance of many secret portals that connect the two realms. "Oh! So, that’s the reason you guys were able to come to this realm, huh?"
Feng Yao shook her head. "Honestly, I can bring my husband to the Ancient Realm whenever I want, but I wouldn’t bring him here if we weren’t facing a serious problem."
"Those creatures, right?"
"That’s right," Feng Yao thought for a moment. "I think I’ll take my husband to that valley, and we might discover a lot of things related to dual cultivation there."
"Didn’t you say that sect is an evil sect? Why do you want to take our husband there?"
"Haha," Feng Yao laughed, listening to Qi Qingxiu’s question. "Qingxiu, you know that our husband has many evil techniques, right?"
"That’s true."

"In fact, that sect isn’t entirely evil, and they still have many other techniques related to dual cultivation. If our husband can find one that suits us, his cultivation will definitely progress faster, and you will also have a chance to break through to the Three God Realms." Qi Qingxiu’s, Ye Mingran’s, Nalan Shizhe’s, and Dong Xuanyin’s eyes lit up when they heard that because their cultivation had long been stuck in the Celestial God Realm. "Our husband will obtain the Sun Flame in two weeks, and I will take him to that valley. Besides, I also want to find out how and when Mo Shentian obtained that sect’s technique."

"This pond is useless for a dead woman like me, and I just want to soak here."
’This old ghost must be lonely since she’s been dead for so long.’ They thought.
"So, what do you think about Mo Shentian, Sister Yao?" Nalan Shizhe asked.
Feng Yao’s eyebrows knitted together.
"Mo Shentian must be planning something by dual cultivating with the fake Nalan Wangzi and the fake Shang Xueli, but I can’t guess his plans.
If I remember correctly, your domain is quite close to Wu Mian’s domain, right, Qingxiu?"
"Yes," Qi Qingxiu nodded.
"Since our two domains are so close, Wu Mian protected my domain while I was away.
Do you think Mo Shentian will attack my domain?"
"Isn’t that obvious from Shang Xueli’s previous story?" Qi Qingxiu sighed as she nodded.
"Wu Mian is the weakest among the ten demon gods, so Mo Shentian plans to attack him and his domain first."
"If Wu Mian and his domain fall, Mo Shentian will attack me and my domain after that."
"Mo Shentian is confident in his demon abilities, but he greatly underestimates Wu Mian’s abilities, and he won’t be able to find him.
Besides, he still doesn’t know that his three sons are already in our husband’s hands, and they’ve already told him about their father’s plans, so you don’t need to worry about that."
"What is our husband planning to do to Mo Shentian, Sister Yao?"
"Nothing." Feng Yao shook her head at Ye Mingran.
"Our husband has decided not to attack Mo Shentian for now, but that doesn’t mean he will stay silent.
He will do something to hinder his plans, so we don’t need to worry about this matter and leave everything to him."
"Is your husband really that capable, Guang Zhiyi?"
Feng Yao looked at Tian Shuying, smiling.
"If my husband wasn’t capable, I wouldn’t choose him as my husband, right?
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and Dong Xuanyin are demon gods from the Paradise Realm.
They’ve gathered here because of my husband, so you should already know whether he’s capable or not, right?"
"He’s just a pervert!" Tian Shuying snorted.
"Hahaha," Dong Xuanyin laughed.
"Try saying that in front of our husband, Senior."

Tian Shuying looked at Dong Xuanyin before raising an eyebrow at her strange smile, and the other female demons also had similarly strange smiles on their faces, giving her goosebumps. ’I don’t understand why women of such high status would be willing to accept a young man who is much weaker than them.’
"Is Mo Shentian dual cultivating with your doll and the fake Nalan Wangzi, Xueli?"
Shang Xueli nodded at Feng Yao.
"Mo Shentian is dual cultivating with the fake Nalan Wangzi right now, but his dual cultivation method is truly strange, Big Sis Yao."
"Show us."
"Alright." Shang Xueli created a qi screen showing Mo Shentian’s activities, causing all the women present to frown.
"What did Mo Shentian do to her?" Nalan Shizhe asked with a hint of anger, as the fake Nalan Wangzi was one of her subordinates.
"How could the fake Nalan Wangzi’s body turn black like that?"
"She looked like she was in pain."
"Mo Shentian’s dual cultivation technique is truly evil, and it’s completely different from our husband’s technique."
"Ugh!
That’s terrible!" Sha Qingge covered her eyes as her body trembled.
Tian Shuying seriously stared at the qi screen, trying to recall Mo Shentian’s technique.
"Guang Zhiyi, that technique belongs to the—"
"Yes," Feng Yao nodded solemnly.
"Mo Shentian’s technique belonged to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley in the past.
Although they use ’immortal’ in the name of their sect, the people of that sect are evil dual cultivators, and they use their partners’ bodies as cultivation furnaces.
Every time they use that technique on their partner, it shortens their partner’s lifespan by several years."
"What?" Qi Qingxiu and the others cried out in shock.
"How could they have such a terrifying technique?"
"The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley has two techniques, one for men and one for women.
The technique for men is the Yin Sacrifice Art, and the technique for women is the Yang Sacrifice Art."
"Aren’t the two techniques reversed?"
"No," Feng Yao shook her head.
"Men use the Yin Sacrifice Art to transform a woman’s body into a cultivation furnace, so only men can use it, and vice versa with the Yang Sacrifice Art."
"So, whether they are men or women who are used for cultivation furnaces, they will experience a reduction in lifespan every time they dual cultivate?"
Feng Yao sighed.
"If I remember correctly, their lifespan will be reduced by ten years in a single session of dual cultivation."
"Fortunately, our husband didn’t use that kind of technique, or we would have died much too soon." Qi Qingxiu muttered softly.
Ye Mingran blushed as she recalled Zhang Fei’s strength in bed.
"Our husband can do dual cultivation without rest for several whole months."
"All women would die prematurely if our husband used that technique on us." Dong Xuanyin shook her head.
Nalan Shizhe chose not to comment because she was Zhang Fei’s mother-in-law, and she had never dual cultivated with him, so she wasn’t sure about his prowess in bed.
Sha Qingge blushed as she listened to them, and her mind spun rapidly with wild imaginations about her relationship with Zhang Fei.
Shang Xueli looked calmer because she was used to hearing the moans of all the women in the pavilion when they dual cultivated with Zhang Fei.

"Where did that man get that technique?" Feng Yao explained to Tian Shuying that the Ancient Realm and the Paradise Realm overlap, resulting in the appearance of many secret portals that connect the two realms.
"Oh!
So, that’s the reason you guys were able to come to this realm, huh?"
Feng Yao shook her head.
"Honestly, I can bring my husband to the Ancient Realm whenever I want, but I wouldn’t bring him here if we weren’t facing a serious problem."
"Those creatures, right?"
"That’s right," Feng Yao thought for a moment.
"I think I’ll take my husband to that valley, and we might discover a lot of things related to dual cultivation there."
"Didn’t you say that sect is an evil sect?
Why do you want to take our husband there?"
"Haha," Feng Yao laughed, listening to Qi Qingxiu’s question.
"Qingxiu, you know that our husband has many evil techniques, right?"
"That’s true."
"In fact, that sect isn’t entirely evil, and they still have many other techniques related to dual cultivation.

If our husband can find one that suits us, his cultivation will definitely progress faster, and you will also have a chance to break through to the Three God Realms." Qi Qingxiu’s, Ye Mingran’s, Nalan Shizhe’s, and Dong Xuanyin’s eyes lit up when they heard that because their cultivation had long been stuck in the Celestial God Realm.
"Our husband will obtain the Sun Flame in two weeks, and I will take him to that valley.
Besides, I also want to find out how and when Mo Shentian obtained that sect’s technique."

chapters.title: Chapter 1703: Zhang Fei’s Threat
paragraphs: Qi Qingxiu and the others decided to follow Luo Yunxiao and the others to the southeastern area, where the weapons and artifacts warehouse was located. Feng Yao and Tian Shuying remained in the underground pond. "What are you thinking about?"

"My Sun Clan." Tian Shuying looked at her. "If only you had intervened and stopped what happened that day, my clan and the other clans wouldn’t have been destroyed. I know you couldn’t interfere in that matter, but I still hate you for watching our destruction from the sidelines."

Feng Yao chose not to comment on the matter. "Rather than looking back on a past you can never change, you should be thinking more about your future. You and Tian Taiyang still exist today, and you two must work together to rebuild the Sun Clan. I know it will take a long time, but it’s not impossible to do, and my husband should be able to help you both with it."
"You trust your husband so much, huh?"
"He’s my husband, so it’s natural that I trust him, right?"
"You’re different from Guang Zhiyi."
"Guang Zhiyi died long ago, and I’m Feng Yao. Although our souls are the same, we’re two different people."
"So, how will your husband help me and my clan?"

"Why must you talk about something so far in the future?" Tian Shuying knitted her brows. "You need decades to strengthen your soul, so you don’t need to think about that, and you should focus on the path ahead. After you reshape your body, you can start thinking about rebuilding your clan."
"What is the fastest way to recover my soul?"

"Dual soul cultivated with my husband." Tian Shuying’s eyes widened. "My husband’s soul power is much stronger than other cultivators, and your soul power will recover much faster if you dual cultivate soul with him."

"I’m just giving you advice, but you’ll be the one to decide." Tian Shuying simply nodded without saying anything. "Your Sun Clan is fortunate to have Tian Taiyang still around, but the Moon Clan is different, and only Yin Yue is left of that clan."
"Is Yin Yue in a relationship with your husband?"
Feng Yao shook her head. "Yin Yue is interested in my husband, and he’s also interested in her, but their relationship hasn’t gone that far yet."
"Oh! Tell me more about your husband."
"Okay."

Zhang Fei [5] spoke to Wu Mian about Mo Shentian’s plans, but it did not surprise the demon god because he had long known about the Celestial Demon God’s grand ambition to become the sole ruler of all the demon race.

After serious consideration, Wu Mian chose to keep his original body and use another one, like in the past. Zhang Fei [5] kept his original body in his soul world because it was the safest place, just like before.

After discussing some other matters, Zhang Fei [5] left the Faceless Demon Domain, and he went to the Endless Domain to meet Xie Yao and Xie Yan. He also planned to check on Mo Tianshen and Morgana’s progress.

Mo Tianshen had long since finished absorbing the inherited power of the previous Celestial Demon God, and his cultivation had already reached the Celestial Venerable level, leaving Morgana far behind him.

Zhang Fei [5] had long given both of them the dual cultivation technique and some other techniques, so Mo Tianshen could help Morgana to improve her cultivation faster. He gave them some new pills, and he also offered them to return to the Moonlit Passion Temple, but they refused him and chose to stay on the mountain.
Zhang Fei [5] did not force Mo Tianshen and Morgana to return, and he left them after they discussed many things.

Xie Yao and Xie Yan were surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s sudden arrival. Although they had been in frequent contact, they had not seen him since his last visit about six years ago, so they were quite surprised to find that his cultivation had already reached the Celestial Emperor Realm.
"You two are still living the same easy life as before, huh?"
"Hahaha," Xie Yao laughed. "Isn’t this because of you? I don’t know how you did it, but I’ve always believed that you were the mastermind behind the disappearance of those gates."
"With those gates gone, almost no other cultivators come to this domain, so we can live in peace here," Xie Yan added. "So, what brings you here today?"

Zhang Fei [5] explained to the two lust demon gods that Mo Shentian plans to use them and the demons of the Endless Domain to attack Wu Mian and Qian Yan. "You don’t need to worry about his three sons because they are no different from my servants, but you must be careful if he comes to this domain by himself. You two must inform the other demon races about his plans, and you guys must work together to deal with him."
"We won’t be able to defeat Mo Shentian." Xie Yao said, shaking her head.

Xie Yan spoke. "In this domain, there are no other demon gods besides the two of us, so they are easy prey for Mo Shentian. If you don’t help us, we will fall into his hands, and he will use us against Wu Mian and Qian Yan."

"Let’s talk about that later." Zhang Fei [5] gave Xie Yao and Xie Yan some pills, which excited both of them. "His three sons will arrive in this domain in two months, and I will ask them to stay here for a while longer. If he decides to come here himself, I will ask someone to fight him."
"Who?"
"You two will know by then." Zhang Fei [5] opened a gate. "Since my business here is finished, I will return to my domain now."
"Who do you think he’ll send here to help us fight Mo Shentian?"
Xie Yao shook his head. "That kid has Empress Huo’s backing, and he still has many powerful cultivators behind him, so I can’t predict who he’ll send here at that time."
"If he sends Empress Huo to help us, we can defeat Mo Shentian easily."
"That’s true." Xie Yao hugged her waist and flew away with her. "Let’s meet with the other races to discuss this matter."
After forty days of completing all the challenges on the second floor of the tower, none of the women failed, and Zhang Fei [1] led them to the third floor.
On the third floor, Zhang Fei [1] saw many cultivators from the Divine Samsara Sect still there; he also saw Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi.
Apart from them, Jian Kuang, Su Shentian, and Zhuxian Sheng also had not left the tower.
"You guys have finally arrived on this floo." Su Shentian said.
"Why did you guys take so long on the lower two floors?"
Zhang Fei [1] shook his head. "This is the first time all my wives have challenged the tower, and their cultivation isn’t as high as yours. Are the people from that sect making a fuss here?"
"Not really." Zhuxian Sheng looked at the people. "There was some trouble between Wang Tieshan and Wang Yusheng some time ago, but nothing else happened after that."
Zhang Fei [1] raised an eyebrow. "What does he want from them?"

"It was mostly an internal matter of their Wang Clan, but I didn’t expect that Wang Tieshan knew that the Mirror of Eternity was in Wang Jingzhi’s hands, and he wanted to snatch it from her." Su Shentian explained.

Zhang Fei [1] was not surprised to hear that Wang Tieshan wanted the Mirror of Eternity, but not everyone could gain the recognition of the Seven Profound Treasures, and the mirror had already chosen Wang Jingzhi as its master.

"Kid," Zhang Fei [1] looked at Jian Kuang. "The Wang Clan is one of the righteous clans in this Paradise Realm, and I knew some people from that clan in the past. If possible, you can move that clan to our domain, and you can also ask the Wang siblings to join our sects."
"Let me talk to them first." Zhang Fei [1] turned to all his wives. "You guys can start your challenge on this floor, but you must be careful when facing each of them."
"Yes."

Wang Tieshan and the people from the Divine Samsara Sect frowned as they saw Zhang Fei [1] walking towards Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi. They had heard a lot about him from their sect master and elders, and they also knew that their ancestors were looking for him.
Wang Tieshan hurriedly contacted Liang Huizhong and informed him of Zhang Fei [1]’s return to the tower. He also informed his master about the hundreds of women who had come with him.

Zhang Fei [1] glanced at them slightly before releasing his killing intent, enveloping them with it. Wang Tieshan and the people from the Divine Samsara Sect broke out in a cold sweat, and they had difficulty breathing because of his killing intent.
Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi were shocked by Zhang Fei [1]’s actions; they thought he had gone insane by looking for trouble with the Divine Samsara Sect.

"Is this the extent of the Divine Samsara Sect’s disciples’ and elders’ capabilities? Disappointing!" Zhang Fei [1]’s cold voice echoed on the third floor. "I won’t do anything to you now, but I will slaughter you all if I find out that you have malicious intentions towards any of my wives."
Yu Shan sighed and approached Zhang Fei [1]. "Please calm down, Kid."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [1] retracted his killing intent. "Senior Yu, I let them off today because I respect you, but I won’t spare them a second time, especially that brat, Wang Tieshan."

chapters.title: Chapter 1704: Ninth Heavenly Flames
paragraphs: "Hmm? What did Wang Tieshan do to provoke your anger?"
Zhang Fei [1] pointed at Wang Tieshan. "Why don’t you ask him directly, Senior Yu?"
Yu Shan looked at Wang Tieshan, but he refused to admit his actions.
"What a coward!" Zhang Fei [1] cursed. "Do you think I don’t know that you contacted Liang Huizhong and told him about all my wives?"
Wang Tieshan froze, not expecting Zhang Fei [1] to know about his contact with Liang Huizhong. ’Shit! How did he know that?’

"Heh!" Zhang Fei [1] snorted. "Do you think I don’t know about Liang Huizhong and the others’ plan to capture me? You are his favorite disciple, and he must have given you that task. Honestly, I’m not afraid of any of you, and I would have destroyed your sect if it weren’t for the danger. Even if Huang Tianzhun, Ouyang Xuening, and the other eight ancestors appeared before me right now, I wouldn’t be afraid to face them, let alone a weak disciple like you."

Wang Tieshan and the others were shocked to hear Zhang Fei [1]’s words, but they were even more shocked because he knew the identities of their ancestors. Yu Shan didn’t expect it either, as only a few people in the Paradise Realm knew about them. "Did Empress Huo tell you about them, Kid?"
"What do you think, Senior Yu?" Zhang Fei [1] asked back with a relaxed smile. "Empress Huo is my wife, so she will naturally help me, right?"
Zhang Fei [1]’s confession about his relationship with Feng Yao was like lightning striking their minds; they found it difficult to believe that he managed to conquer her heart.
Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi were also shocked after learning about their relationship, but they remembered that Feng Yao always protected those on Zhang Fei [1]’s side.
"Is Empress Huo really your wife, Kid?"
Zhang Fei [1] pointed at Feng Tian and Feng Jiu. "They are Empress Huo’s parents; you can ask them about our relationship if you don’t believe me."

Feng Tian and Feng Jiu did not expect that Zhang Fei [1] would openly reveal his relationship with Feng Yao to the public, but they had no problem with it, and they confirmed their relationship when Yu Shan and the others looked at them.

Zhang Fei [1] spoke to them again. "Even without my wife’s help, I can kill all of you and destroy the Divine Samsara Sect, so you guys should think twice about looking for trouble with me. If you guys are reckless, I won’t just destroy your bodies, but I’ll also destroy your souls so that you can’t be reincarnated."
"Haha," Jian Kuang laughed and moved to Zhang Fei [1]’s side. "What happened to you? You usually keep a low profile, but you suddenly become overbearing."

Zhang [1] shook his head. "Nothing happened to me, and I’m just annoyed that these idiots keep looking for trouble with me. If I keep a low profile, they’ll come at me non-stop, so I choose to give them a stern warning. If they insist on looking for trouble with me, I won’t hesitate to kill them and everyone close to them."
"Haha." Su Shentian looked at the people from the Divine Sect. "You guys should heed his warning if you don’t want to die at his hands, and your families will accompany you to the afterlife."

Zhuxian Sheng didn’t say anything and shot a warning glare at those people, as he knew that Zhang Fei [1] never joked with his words, and they would all die by his hands if they continued to provoke him.
Wang Tieshan and the people from the Divine Samsara Sect gulped hard.
Yu Shan sighed softly. "I hope we will never be enemies, Kid."
"Senior Yu, we will never be enemies as long as you don’t join forces with your sect against me, but it’s a different story if you choose to join forces with them."
Even though Zhang Fei [1] said those words with a smile, Yu Shan could see the seriousness in his expression, and he immediately returned to the disciples.
Zhang Fei [1] ignored those people and went to see Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi. "I want to make an offer to you two."
"Hmm?" Both Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi were surprised by this. "What’s your offer, Brother?"
"How many members of the Wang Clan are left?"
"What—"
Wang Jingzhi stopped her brother. "Our core clan numbers are no more than thirty now. But why do you ask that?"

"What if you take your clan members to the Twin Flames Domain? If they move there, there will be no more cultivators to pressure them, and they will live much safer." Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi didn’t expect that Zhang Fei [1] would offer that. "Besides, I want the two of you to join the Moonlit Passion Temple and become elders there. You two must have heard that my sect is no longer a dual cultivation sect but a universal one, so that shouldn’t be a problem for the two of you, right?"
Wang Yusheng nodded at him. "As long as your sect is a universal sect, it’s not a problem for us."
"However, we cannot make a decision regarding this matter, and we have to discuss it with our elders first," Wang Jingzhi said.
"No problem." Zhang Fei [1] understood their situation. "Have you two completed all your challenges? When do you plan to return to your domain?"
"We haven’t finalized everything yet, but we thought we’d come back early and discuss your offer with our elders."
"Which domain?"
"The Heavenly Cloud Domain."

"Alright." Zhang Fei [1] closed the gate after Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi, and he looked at Wang Tieshan with a murderous glint in his eyes.
"So, how was your trip to the Ancient Realm?"

"Not that bad, but not that good either." Jian Kuang and the other two men were puzzled by this, but Zhang Fei [1] immediately explained a few things to them. "If you want, I can send the three of you to the Puyang Clan, but the situation there is unstable, and those creatures keep trying to break through the clan’s barrier."
"Are those creatures really that powerful?"

"Feng Yao had a hard time killing those creatures, so you should already have an idea of their strength, right?" They sighed, realizing their strength was no match for the woman’s. "Once the situation there is stable, I’ll take the three of you there, so you guys just need to wait for now."
"Yeah."

At first, the elders were hesitant to move, but they changed their minds after their two juniors informed them that Empress Huo was one of Zhang Fei’s wives, and they immediately decided to move their clan.

After their discussion, Wang Yusheng contacted Zhang Fei and informed him of their decision. However, they couldn’t move immediately, and they would need one to two months to settle all the Wang Clan’s affairs in the Heavenly Cloud Domain.

Zhang Fei had no problem with that, and he told Wang Yusheng to contact him once everything was ready. He asked the natural races in the Moonlit Passion Temple to build a new building that would be occupied by the Wang Clan in the future, and he asked them to choose an area for the residence.

"I see." Wang Yusheng nodded in understanding. "I don’t want to move either, but we have to think about the safety of our clan members. We won’t be able to face Liang Huizhong and those elders, so we must leave this domain."
"Do you think they will attack us anytime soon?"

"I can’t be sure, Big Sis," Wang Yusheng replied with a shake of his head. "I don’t know if the people from the Divine Samsara Sect have discovered our domain’s location yet, so I can’t predict it. Rather than worrying about them, we should help our elders pack up, and we’ll move to the Twin Flames Domain afterward."
"Let’s go."
Without realizing it, two weeks passed quickly.

[The host’s fire strength has increased by 900%.]
Zhang Fei exhaled softly after receiving the notification. He opened his palm and used the Sun Flame. "Not bad! 900% fire strength!"

"Hehe," Ying Tai came out of Zhang Fei’s body. "Even though you have nine elements, your fire element is the strongest, Master. Not only do you have nine heavenly flames, but you also have many other types of flames."
Zhang Fei nodded at him. "That’s why I use my fire element more often than my other elements, but I also use others on several occasions."

Zhang Fei [1] pointed at Wang Tieshan.

Yu Shan looked at Wang Tieshan, but he refused to admit his actions.

Wang Tieshan froze, not expecting Zhang Fei [1] to know about his contact with Liang Huizhong. ’Shit!

"Heh!" Zhang Fei [1] snorted.
"Do you think I don’t know about Liang Huizhong and the others’ plan to capture me?

Wang Tieshan and the others were shocked to hear Zhang Fei [1]’s words, but they were even more shocked because he knew the identities of their ancestors.
Yu Shan didn’t expect it either, as only a few people in the Paradise Realm knew about them.
"Did Empress Huo tell you about them, Kid?"
"What do you think, Senior Yu?" Zhang Fei [1] asked back with a relaxed smile.
"Empress Huo is my wife, so she will naturally help me, right?"
Zhang Fei [1]’s confession about his relationship with Feng Yao was like lightning striking their minds; they found it difficult to believe that he managed to conquer her heart.
Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi were also shocked after learning about their relationship, but they remembered that Feng Yao always protected those on Zhang Fei [1]’s side.
"Is Empress Huo really your wife, Kid?"
Zhang Fei [1] pointed at Feng Tian and Feng Jiu.
"They are Empress Huo’s parents; you can ask them about our relationship if you don’t believe me."

Feng Tian and Feng Jiu did not expect that Zhang Fei [1] would openly reveal his relationship with Feng Yao to the public, but they had no problem with it, and they confirmed their relationship when Yu Shan and the others looked at them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1705: Toward The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley
paragraphs: "Brother Ying!" Yin Ling flew over to hug Ying Tai. "Congratulations, Brother Ying. You finally got a new master, so you don’t have to stay here anymore."
Ying Tai hugged her back. "From now on, I’ll be living with you again, Ling’er. I’ve also told my master about our relationship, and he has no problem with it."
"Really, Zhang Fei?" Yin Lin’s eyes glistened.
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "You and Ying Tai love each other, and you two can live together in my soul world from now on."
"Hehehe," Yin Ling softly laughed. "Thank you, Zhang Fei."
"No need to thank me."
*Tap... Tap...*
"Your fire element strength has increased again, husband."
Zhang Fei turned to Feng Yao, but she raised an eyebrow when she saw Tian Shuying. "Is she one of the ancestors of the Sun Clan, Yao’er?"

"Her name is Tian Shuying." Feng Yao walked to Zhang Fei’s side. "At first, I thought Tian Taiyang was the only remaining member of the Sun Clan, but her soul still lingers here due to her regret over the destruction of their clan. Her soul is too weak to reshape her body, so I want you to send her into your soul world and help her improve her soul power first."
"Wait a minute!" Tian Shuying shouted. "What do you mean by his soul world?"
"Hehehe." Feng Yao chuckled at her expression. "Husband, take us into your soul world and let her see everything with her own eyes."
"Alright."
"This." Tian Shuying and Ying Tai fell into a daze as soon as they appeared inside Zhang Fei’s soul world.

Yin Ling hugged Ying Tai’s arm. "Brother Ying, this place is truly beautiful! My master and I have been living here for several years, and we’ve adapted to the atmosphere. In this entire universe, only Zhang Fei has a soul world, and his soul world may evolve into a soul universe in the future."
"A soul universe?" Ying Tai was shocked to hear that.
"Yes," Yin Ling nodded. "After all, Zhang Fei is not an ordinary cultivator, and he is the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox."
Ying Tai nodded slightly and looked at the area around them. "This soul world is like the world outside, but the majority of the population are beasts, and only a few people live here."
"They are Zhang Fei’s friends, and they are helping him develop his soul world." Yin Ling took Ying Tai flying with her. "Let’s go! I’ll show you the interesting places in this soul world."

Tian Shuying was utterly speechless as she looked around the surrounding area, and she could feel that the qi in the soul world was quite strong, although not yet as strong as the qi in the Ancient Realm. She had lived for so long before the destruction of her Sun Clan, but she had never heard of cultivators having a soul world before.
*Swoosh*

Tian Shuying’s expression turned ugly as soon as Yin Yue appeared in front of them, but she quickly calmed herself down because the woman’s soul was much stronger than hers. "Long time no see, Yin Yue."
"Yeah." Yin Yue nodded slightly. "Long time no see, Tian Shuying. I thought that only Tian Taiyang’s soul was left of your clan members, but you are here now."
"How can I leave in peace?" Tian Shuying sighed. "The destruction of my clan dealt me a heavy blow, and I deeply regret my weakness at that time."
Yin Yue put on an apologetic look. "Shuying, please forgive me. That person wouldn’t have destroyed our clans if it weren’t for my past ambitions."

"Forget it," Tian Shuying observed Yin Yue’s soul. "That incident has long passed, so we don’t need to discuss it anymore. Your and Tian Taiyang’s souls are strong enough now, and you two should be able to reshape your bodies soon. As for me, my soul is too weak now, and I need a long time to improve it."

Yin Yue gestured towards Zhang Fei. "If it weren’t for his help, my soul would still be very weak right now. Since he brought you here, he will definitely help you increase your soul power, and you will be able to reshape your body in the future."
"Since I still have a lot of things to do outside, I’ll go out now, and you two can talk." Without waiting for their reply, Zhang Fei brought Feng Yao out of his soul world.
"Do you dual soul cultivating with him?"

Yin Yue shook her head at Tian Shuying. "Over the past few years, he’s been helping me restore my soul using other methods. Since you already know Feng Yao’s true identity, she should have told you a lot about her husband, right?"
"Yes," Tian Shuying nodded. "She told me that you like her husband, but you never dared to tell him how you feel."
"Tch! Big mouth!" Yin Yue grumbled. "I do like Zhang Fei, but there are some things that make me hesitate, so I have never expressed my feelings to him."
"Is that because he helped you recover your soul?"
"One of them," Yin Yue nodded. "Unlike you, my soul has been bonded with his since we first met, and we’ve spent a lot of time together for so many years."
"Oh." Tian Shuying didn’t like interfering with others, so she didn’t ask more than that, and Yin Yue took her to another area.
After they returned to the Zenith Solar Sanctum, Zhang Fei sent Tian Taiyang’s soul back to his soul world.

"I want to tell you something." Feng Yao immediately created a qi screen that showed Mo Shentian’s activities with the fake Shang Yueli and the fake Nalan Wangzhi, causing Zhang Fei’s face to darken. "I don’t know how he obtained the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley’s Yin Sacrifice Art, but he used that technique to turn their bodies into his cultivation furnace."

"The Yin Sacrifice Art?" Feng Yao nodded and explained to Zhang Fei about the sect, including its two evil dual cultivation techniques. "Do you think he found a portal connecting to the sect’s domain?"

"That’s for sure." Then, Feng Yao asked him, "Do you want to go to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley? If we set off now, we’ll arrive at that domain in two weeks, and you’ll probably obtain many relics left behind by that sect."
"Isn’t that sect an evil dual cultivation sect? That means all their techniques are also evil, right?"

Feng Yao changed the image on the qi screen, which showed the situation at the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley during its heyday. "That sect isn’t entirely evil, and it has various dual cultivation techniques. The Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art are two of them, so I think we can go there to look for their relics."
"Do you think their dual cultivation techniques can rival my Flawless Yin-Yang Arts and the Forbidden Lotus Codex?"

"Hmm?" Feng Yao considered the two techniques. "I’m not sure if they have techniques that can surpass your Flawless Yin-Yang Arts, but they might have techniques that can surpass the Forbidden Lotus Codex. Since we’re already in this realm, I think we should check out the ruins of that sect. Even if we can’t find techniques that are far superior to your two techniques, I’m sure that they have techniques that will be useful for your sect, especially those dual cultivators."

Zhang Fei seriously considered Feng Yao’s opinion because the Moonlit Passion Temple didn’t have a dual cultivation technique as excellent as the Flawless Yin-Yang Arts, and not everyone could learn the Forbidden Lotus Codex. If they could find a dual cultivation technique that had qualities close to or even equal to those two techniques, the dual cultivators in his sect could cultivate much faster. "Do you think the original techniques of the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art are still in the sect?"

"Hmm?" Feng Yao raised an eyebrow. "Do you want to use those two techniques? Don’t you have the Yin-Yang Space to harvest Yin Qi from female cultivators? So, you shouldn’t need to use those kinds of techniques, right?"

Zhang Fei nodded at her. "My Yin-Yang Space does function like a cultivation furnace, but it doesn’t harm those female cultivators in absorbing their Yin Qi. I have no intention of using those two techniques, and I want to destroy them so that no more dual cultivators can learn them."
"I don’t know whether the original manuscripts of those two techniques are still in that sect or not, so we have to go there to check it out in person."
"In that case, we’ll go to the sect, but I want to check the Sun Clan’s treasury first." Zhang Fei hugged Feng Yao and teleported away to the treasury.

For a while, Zhang Fei examined all the artifacts in the treasury, but he didn’t find anything that caught his attention. After that, he took Feng Yao to the library, where Luo Yunxiao and the others were still busy copying all the techniques there.
Two weeks have passed since they started copying those techniques, but they have only finished two-thirds of them, and they still need time to copy them all.
Zhang Fei tried to open the gate to the Zenith Solar Sanctum because the system was still being upgraded, and he didn’t get any notification whether the gate feature had saved the location or not.

Zhang Fei was relieved to find that the gate to the place had opened immediately, so he didn’t have to worry about traveling back and forth. He informed Luo Yunxiao and the others that he would take Feng Yao to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and his clone would pick them up after they finished copying everything.
"Let’s go to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, Senior Xukong."

Huo Ling immediately came out of Zhang Fei [5]’s body, and she asked Mo Zainan to release her soul. "Do it now! I will remove your husband’s soul mark from your soul."
After Mo Zainan released her soul, Huo Ling immediately channeled her qi into it. Within seconds, Mo Shentian’s soul mark disappeared from her soul, and she reinserted her soul into her body.
"You are a free woman now."
"Thank you, Senior."

paragraphs: "Why is this residence empty? Where is everyone? Are those four people your clones?" Mo Zainan leaned onto Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder.
Zhang Fei [5] embraced her waist. "Most of them are in the Tower of Eternity, some are in the Moonlit Passion Temple, and some are in the Zenith Solar Sanctum."
"Oh." Mo Zainan looked up at him. "I heard from my two daughters that you sent them to the Zenith Solar Sanctum to cultivate."

"The Zenith Solar Sanctum is actually part of the Ancient Realm, Zainan. The quality and quantity of qi there is slightly higher than in the Paradise Realm, so they can cultivate faster, and I also asked them to do some things there."

"My two daughters already told me about it, but I didn’t expect that you could freely go to the Ancient Realm." Zhang Fei [5] smiled at Mo Zainan. "Are you sure my husband won’t realize that the me in the dungeon is a doll?"

"Don’t worry about it, okay?" Mo Zainan hugged Zhang Fei [5]’s neck as he carried her. "By the way, I want to take you to meet someone, and you’ll definitely be surprised when you meet him. I’ll bring you back here after we meet him so you can concentrate on your training. I’m sure you’ll be superior to Mo Shentian in some ways, and I want the two of you to work together to destroy your husband."
"Him? Who is the man you mean?" Mo Zainan asked in confusion.
"You will meet him soon."
Before long, they had arrived at the mountain in the Endless Domain, surprising Mo Zainan. "Did you know that Mo Shentian sent our three sons to this domain?"
"I know." Zhang Fei [5] led Mo Zainan to enter the area within the mountain. "You don’t need to worry about your three sons; I will keep them safe from your husband."
"I believe in you."
After some time, they arrived at the base of the mountain.
Mo Zainan gasped in shock when she saw Mo Tianshen and Morgana. "Tianshen? Is it really you?"
"Long time no see, Zainan." Mo Tianshen hugged Morgana’s waist. "She is my wife, a witch demon, Morgana."
"Long time no see." Mo Zainan looked at Morgana. "You have such a beautiful wife, Tianshen."
"Haha," Mo Tianshen laughed. "If it weren’t for my brother banishing me to the Three Mortal Realms, I would never have met my wife. Should I call you sister-in-law?"
"No," Mo Zainan shook her head vigorously. "I am your brother’s wife, but I have decided to leave him, and I will live with Zhang Fei [5] in the future."
Morgana looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "You already have more than a hundred wives, but you haven’t stopped adding to the number of women by your side."

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose. "You know me, right? I’m a lust demon, and my lust is simply too strong. Even so, I feel that I’m still inferior than Xie Yao, and the number of my women can’t compare to his."

"Xie Yao has thousands of women, but he never cared about them, and all he wanted was sex with them." Mo Zainan took Morgana’s hand. "In the past, I had a good relationship with Tianshen, and we were like family. Since you are his wife, that means we are sisters, Sister Morgana."
Morgana nodded with a smile. "My husband has told me many things about you, and I’m glad we finally meet, Sister Zainan."
"Zhang Fei, can I stay here for a while? I want to chat with them and reminisce about old times."
"Okay, you can stay here for a while."
Mo Zainan pulled Morgana to his side, sat down, and began chatting.
Mo Tianshen smiled at them. "I didn’t expect you to take her as a member of your harem."

"Honestly, I originally had no intention of taking her into my harem, and I was thinking of using her to fight against Mo Shentian. However, I learned many things from her, including your past relationship with her, so I changed my mind about her." Mo Tianshen sighed when he heard that because Mo Zainan was supposed to be his wife, but his brother banished him to the Three Mortal Realms to take over his position as the future demon god of their race. "I still have some business in other domains, so I will leave her here with the two of you, and I will take her to my training space after your reunion."
Mo Tianshen nodded slightly. "I’ll contact you later."
"Alright."
After Zhang Fei [5] left, Mo Tianshen joined Mo Zainan and Morgana, reminiscing about many things, especially about the past.
Mo Shentian looked at the female demons, who were lying exhausted. He felt something was different about them, but he couldn’t pinpoint the difference.
In the blink of an eye, Mo Shentian had arrived at the dungeon. He stood in front of Mo Zainan’s prison room, but he couldn’t recognize that the woman before him was a doll.
"What did you come here for?" Mo Zainan coldly asked.

Mo Shentian didn’t say anything and immediately walked into the prison. He lifted Mo Zainan and strangled her neck. "Although you are my wife, you must remember that you are my tool, so you should not challenge my patience. So what if I dual cultivate with our daughters? "You bitch!" Mo Shentian tore off Mo Zainan’s dress and pressed her against the prison wall. "Do you think I don’t dare to kill you? I’ve wanted to get rid of you for a long time, but I haven’t done it because I still need you as my tool. When my cultivation surpasses the Celestial God Realm, I will no longer hesitate to kill you and our five children."

Mo Zainan looked at Mo Shentian bewilderedly; Zhang Fei had told her that there was still other stages after the Five Celestial Realm, but she didn’t expect that her husband knew about it. "What do you mean by that?"

"Heh!" Mo Shentian coldly snorted. "Do you think the Five Celestial God Realm is the pinnacle of the cultivation world? Several thousand years ago, I accidentally entered a portal, and it sent me to a place called the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, where I found some records. They had no clear information about those stages, but they were certain that they existed, and they created two dual cultivation techniques to achieve them."
Mo Zainan pretended to be confused because Zhang Fei asked her to look for information on how Mo Shentian was able to obtain those two techniques.

"The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley is definitely not part of the Paradise Realm, just like the Forbidden Land. If I were to guess, that place was in a higher realm because the quality and quantity of qi there were much better than here. Unfortunately, I was sent back to this realm after I learned one of those techniques, and I never managed to find the portal again after that." Mo Shentian grabbed her breast. "Honestly, I didn’t want to learn that technique because I knew it would affect me, but I had no choice but to learn it, especially after that mysterious woman attacked me in the tunnel. "You’re truly insane! You’ve been blinded by your ambition! You even used our two daughters as your cultivation furnace!" Mo Zainan shouted furiously.
"You can curse me as much as you like, but it won’t change your future. Once you help me reach that stage, I will kill you and our two daughters."
"You bastard!"
Zhang Fei, who had just finished dual cultivation with Feng Yao, frowned as soon as he heard Mo Zainan’s voice message.
"Did something happen?"
"Mo Shentian is truly vile!" Zhang Fei told Feng Yao about Mo Zainan’s voice message.

Feng Yao sighed. "It seems my actions in the tunnel years ago changed Mo Shentian’s mindset, and he decided to use that technique on them. Unfortunately, it was just his wishful thinking, and he would never succeed in reaching the Three God Realms."
"Will Mo Shentian really never reach that stage?"

"No," Feng Yao shook her head slightly. "Even if Mo Shentian sacrificed all the female demons in his domain, he would never be able to reach that stage. However, he will become increasingly powerful, and I’m not confident that Mo Tianshen will be able to stop him."

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "Even if Mo Shentian didn’t use that technique, Mo Tianshen would never have been able to defeat him because the difference in strength between them was simply too vast. If not for the appearance of those creatures, I would have already gone into his domain to fight him."

"Your strength is still no match for Mo Shentian, but you have Ling’er by your side, so you should be able to defeat him." Feng Yao looked up at him. "For now, you don’t need to worry about him because his wife and two daughters are safe with you, and I will help you fight him after we find a solution to get rid of those shadowy creatures."

I’m sure you’ll be superior to Mo Shentian in some ways, and I want the two of you to work together to destroy your husband."
"Him?
Who is the man you mean?" Mo Zainan asked in confusion.
"You will meet him soon."
Before long, they had arrived at the mountain in the Endless Domain, surprising Mo Zainan.
"Did you know that Mo Shentian sent our three sons to this domain?"
"I know." Zhang Fei [5] led Mo Zainan to enter the area within the mountain.
"You don’t need to worry about your three sons; I will keep them safe from your husband."
"I believe in you."
After some time, they arrived at the base of the mountain.
Mo Zainan gasped in shock when she saw Mo Tianshen and Morgana.
"Tianshen?
Is it really you?"
"Long time no see, Zainan." Mo Tianshen hugged Morgana’s waist.
"She is my wife, a witch demon, Morgana."
"Long time no see." Mo Zainan looked at Morgana.
"You have such a beautiful wife, Tianshen."
"Haha," Mo Tianshen laughed.
"If it weren’t for my brother banishing me to the Three Mortal Realms, I would never have met my wife.
Should I call you sister-in-law?"
"No," Mo Zainan shook her head vigorously.
"I am your brother’s wife, but I have decided to leave him, and I will live with Zhang Fei [5] in the future."
Morgana looked at Zhang Fei [5].
"You already have more than a hundred wives, but you haven’t stopped adding to the number of women by your side."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose.
"You know me, right?
I’m a lust demon, and my lust is simply too strong.
Even so, I feel that I’m still inferior than Xie Yao, and the number of my women can’t compare to his."
"Xie Yao has thousands of women, but he never cared about them, and all he wanted was sex with them." Mo Zainan took Morgana’s hand.
"In the past, I had a good relationship with Tianshen, and we were like family.
Since you are his wife, that means we are sisters, Sister Morgana."
Morgana nodded with a smile.
"My husband has told me many things about you, and I’m glad we finally meet, Sister Zainan."
"Zhang Fei, can I stay here for a while?
I want to chat with them and reminisce about old times."
"Okay, you can stay here for a while."
Mo Zainan pulled Morgana to his side, sat down, and began chatting.
Mo Tianshen smiled at them.
"I didn’t expect you to take her as a member of your harem."
"Honestly, I originally had no intention of taking her into my harem, and I was thinking of using her to fight against Mo Shentian.

However, I learned many things from her, including your past relationship with her, so I changed my mind about her." Mo Tianshen sighed when he heard that because Mo Zainan was supposed to be his wife, but his brother banished him to the Three Mortal Realms to take over his position as the future demon god of their race.
"I still have some business in other domains, so I will leave her here with the two of you, and I will take her to my training space after your reunion."
Mo Tianshen nodded slightly.
"I’ll contact you later."
"Alright."
After Zhang Fei [5] left, Mo Tianshen joined Mo Zainan and Morgana, reminiscing about many things, especially about the past.
Mo Shentian looked at the female demons, who were lying exhausted.
He felt something was different about them, but he couldn’t pinpoint the difference.
In the blink of an eye, Mo Shentian had arrived at the dungeon.
He stood in front of Mo Zainan’s prison room, but he couldn’t recognize that the woman before him was a doll.
"What did you come here for?" Mo Zainan coldly asked.
Mo Shentian didn’t say anything and immediately walked into the prison.
He lifted Mo Zainan and strangled her neck.
"Although you are my wife, you must remember that you are my tool, so you should not challenge my patience.
So what if I dual cultivate with our daughters?
They should be grateful that they were born from my seed, and they should be grateful that I gave them the opportunity to serve me."
Mo Zainan sneered in her heart because Mo Shentian still didn’t realize that she and their two daughters were dolls.
"Heh!
Do you want to kill me?
Kill me if you dare."
"You bitch!" Mo Shentian tore off Mo Zainan’s dress and pressed her against the prison wall.
"Do you think I don’t dare to kill you?
I’ve wanted to get rid of you for a long time, but I haven’t done it because I still need you as my tool.
When my cultivation surpasses the Celestial God Realm, I will no longer hesitate to kill you and our five children."
Mo Zainan looked at Mo Shentian bewilderedly; Zhang Fei had told her that there was still other stages after the Five Celestial Realm, but she didn’t expect that her husband knew about it.
"What do you mean by that?"
"Heh!" Mo Shentian coldly snorted.
"Do you think the Five Celestial God Realm is the pinnacle of the cultivation world?
Several thousand years ago, I accidentally entered a portal, and it sent me to a place called the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, where I found some records.
They had no clear information about those stages, but they were certain that they existed, and they created two dual cultivation techniques to achieve them."
Mo Zainan pretended to be confused because Zhang Fei asked her to look for information on how Mo Shentian was able to obtain those two techniques.
"The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley is definitely not part of the Paradise Realm, just like the Forbidden Land.
If I were to guess, that place was in a higher realm because the quality and quantity of qi there were much better than here.
Unfortunately, I was sent back to this realm after I learned one of those techniques, and I never managed to find the portal again after that." Mo Shentian grabbed her breast.
"Honestly, I didn’t want to learn that technique because I knew it would affect me, but I had no choice but to learn it, especially after that mysterious woman attacked me in the tunnel.
You, our two princesses, and all the female demons in our domain are merely my tools.
Since I’ve learned that technique, I’ll use your bodies as my cultivation furnaces, and I’ll become the sole ruler of the Paradise Realm once I reach that stage."
"You’re truly insane!
You’ve been blinded by your ambition!
You even used our two daughters as your cultivation furnace!" Mo Zainan shouted furiously.
"You can curse me as much as you like, but it won’t change your future.
Once you help me reach that stage, I will kill you and our two daughters."
"You bastard!"
Zhang Fei, who had just finished dual cultivation with Feng Yao, frowned as soon as he heard Mo Zainan’s voice message.
"Did something happen?"
"Mo Shentian is truly vile!" Zhang Fei told Feng Yao about Mo Zainan’s voice message.
Feng Yao sighed.
"It seems my actions in the tunnel years ago changed Mo Shentian’s mindset, and he decided to use that technique on them.
Unfortunately, it was just his wishful thinking, and he would never succeed in reaching the Three God Realms."
"Will Mo Shentian really never reach that stage?"
"No," Feng Yao shook her head slightly.
"Even if Mo Shentian sacrificed all the female demons in his domain, he would never be able to reach that stage.
However, he will become increasingly powerful, and I’m not confident that Mo Tianshen will be able to stop him."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly.
"Even if Mo Shentian didn’t use that technique, Mo Tianshen would never have been able to defeat him because the difference in strength between them was simply too vast.
If not for the appearance of those creatures, I would have already gone into his domain to fight him."
"Your strength is still no match for Mo Shentian, but you have Ling’er by your side, so you should be able to defeat him." Feng Yao looked up at him.
"For now, you don’t need to worry about him because his wife and two daughters are safe with you, and I will help you fight him after we find a solution to get rid of those shadowy creatures."

chapters.title: Chapter 1708: Arrive At The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley
paragraphs: Zhang Fei sighed. "I just want to get to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley soon, and I hope to find a dual cultivation technique that is on par with or superior to the Forbidden Lotus Codex. That way, my people will have the opportunity to strengthen themselves, and they can protect everything on their own. If they can protect everything, I will focus on becoming a Celestial God, and I will help all my wives improve their cultivation."
"Have you ever realized something important, husband?"
"What do you mean by that?"
"All your wives, of course!"
"What’s wrong with them?"

"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "In the past, when they were still living in the Three Mortal Realms, most of them were independent cultivators, and they could protect themselves. However, the situation changed after you brought them to the Nine Stars Realm, and they have always lived under your protection. I know that you want to protect them, but do you realize that your protection is weakening them?"
"This-"

"After that, you encountered many powerful cultivators from the Immortal Jin Realm and others, including those from the Sovereign Heaven Realm." Zhang Fei could more or less guess Feng Yao’s intentions. "Zhe Wuming and the others were powerful cultivators in their generation, but they were no different from chicks once you brought them to this Paradise Realm. From then on, they simply stayed in your sect and focused on their cultivation, and I think that was a setback for them."
"You mean?"

"Yes," Feng Yao nodded. "Even though their cultivation base is constantly improving, their fighting abilities haven’t improved at all. Instead of having them stay in your sect, you should let them travel to other domains to gain experience. You can’t protect them forever, and they must find their own path, but they will still be part of your sect. If we compare them with my subordinates, not a single one of them can defeat all the women in my domain, even if their cultivation is at the same level."

"I never forbid them from going to other domains, and I’m actually happy if they have the desire to do so." Zhang Fei sighed. "I don’t know about their lifestyles, but I feel that they don’t want to leave, and they want to improve their cultivation first."

"At least you can talk to them, right?" Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao. "They’ve been training in your training space for a long time, and they also have quite a bit of experience as cultivators. Although they can’t defeat those powerful cultivators yet, they can still fight cultivators at the same level. The Twin Flames Domain is too calm for them, so they have no opponents to develop themselves, and their only choice is to go to other domains."
Zhang Fei thought about Feng Yao’s suggestion seriously. "In that case, I will install more teleportation devices, so—"

"No need for that," Feng Yao interrupted. "They’ve gotten used to long distances since their time in the Three Mortal Realms, so you should let them return to their old lives, and they should go to the other domains on their own."

"Alright! I will send my clones to talk to them about this matter, and I will have them go on adventures to other domains. However, some of them will have to stay in the sect, like Lin Jingxia and the others."

Feng Yao agreed with him. "Lin Jingxia is an alchemist, so she should stay in the sect. Hun Di is the leader of the Soul Hall, but I think it’s fine if he leaves, and his other disciples can handle his duties. Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Cheng Gaoji should also stay because you don’t have better blacksmiths and artifact crafters than they do. Yao Shen and Xin Hongyan can go with the people from the Hidden Moon Sect, and you can ask them to set up an Assassin Hall in another domain. As for Zhe Wuming, I have one suitable subordinate to accompany him to travel, and I will ask her to go to your sect later."
"What about the others?"
"Some others are irreplaceable to your sect, so they must remain."
"What if I send the people from the Sky Jade Realm and the Nine Stars Realm to the Tower of Eternity?"

Feng Yao thought for a moment before answering. "Sooner or later, they will have to go to the tower to improve themselves, but all the challenges there are not easy for cultivators at their level. The people from the Nine Stars Realm and the Sovereign Heaven Realm might be able to face those challenges, but I’m not sure about the people from the Sky Jade Realm."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei rubbed his chin in thought. "In that case, I’ll ask my in-laws and the others from the Nine Stars Realm and the Sovereign Heaven Realm to go to the tower, but they don’t need to force themselves, and they should give up if they encounter any difficulties in going through those challenges. I will send my in-laws from the Sky Jade Realm to other domains, and I will also ask those beasts and natural races to the Divine Origin Main Domain and the Floral Mirage Domain."
"Since you have connected your domain with several other domains, the people of the Sky Jade Realm can go to other domains to choose one that suits them."
"My clones are talking to them about this matter now." Zhang Fei rubbed his chest. "Don’t you want to get out of my body, Ling’er?"
[Husband, you should have fun with my master first.]
"Hehe," Zhang Fei chuckled. "Ling’er still seems exhausted, and she doesn’t want to come out to join us, Yao’er."

Feng Yao smiled. "How could Ling’er not be exhausted if you dual cultivated with her for that long? Even though she is the spirit of the Primordial Flame, she will not be able to serve you for that long. I myself feel exhausted from serving you, especially when your lust is high."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed and kissed her. "Looks like I’ll have to control myself while your sisters are away."
"Why don’t you bring Mo Zainan here to serve you? Are you thinking of giving her to one of your clones?"

Zhang Fei himself had long thought about Mo Zainan, but he felt that she was not worthy of being a member of his main harem. "I haven’t made a decision about her yet, and I’ll let her reunite with Mo Tianshen first, so I’ll make a decision after that."
Zhang Fei lifted Feng Yao and sat opposite her. "Let’s dual soul cultivate, Yao’er."
"Alright."

After Zhang Fei’s clone spoke with the people from the Sky Jade Realm, the Nine Stars Realm, and the Sovereign Heaven Realm, they decided to follow his plans, and some of them hurriedly left the Twin Flames Domain to venture to other domains.

As for the people from the Nine Stars Realm, Zhang Fei’s clone sent them to the Tower of Eternity to begin their training, and he sent the people from the Sky Jade Realm to other domains of their choice.
At the Divine Samsara Sect, Liang Huizhong was chatting with Luo Lianjin and the main elders, discussing Wang Tieshan’s message regarding the presence of almost all of Zhang Fei’s wives there.
"Are we really not going to the tower to capture them?" Luo Lianjin asked.

Liang Huizhong shook his head. "I wanted to go to that domain and capture them, but Ancestor Huang Tianzhun forbade us from leaving our domain because he was afraid those creatures would suddenly appear here. Besides, we don’t have clear information about the strength of those creatures, but Zhang Fei and Empress Huo’s expressions at the tower clearly indicated that they were powerful, so we must guard our domain with great vigilance."

"I see." Long Lianjin nodded his head. "I still find it hard to believe that Ancestor Yue Ningxue would leave our sect, and she seems to be joining Zhang Fei because the Celestial Moon Sect is also in his domain."
Liang Huizhong himself was disappointed with Yue Ningxue’s decision because her strength was second only to Huang Tianzhun, and losing her was a huge loss for their sect.
"Has Ancestor Tianzhun already chosen someone to replace her?"

"Ancestor Tianzhun has already chosen Ancestor Yue Zhiying to replace her, but her strength isn’t on par with Ancestor Ningxue’s, so he hasn’t officially announced his decision." Liang Huizhong tried to contact Huang Tianzhun and inquire about his location. "He and Ancestor Ouyang Xuening have been gone for a month and a half, but they still haven’t found the location of the Twin Flames Domain."

Long Lianjin gritted his teeth. "If it weren’t for the disappearance of those gates, our situation wouldn’t be like this. Could the disappearance of those gates have something to do with Zhang Fei and Empress Huo?"

"Forget it, the gates are long gone, so we don’t need to discuss that issue anymore." Liang Huizhong stood up and walked out. "Our focus now is to guard our domain, and we’ll wait for news from Ancestor Tianzhun before deciding our next move."
Two weeks later.
After Feng Yao confirmed that there were no such shadowy creatures in the domain, Long Xukong took her and Zhang Fei out of the void, and they immediately arrived at the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley.

The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley was a vast, ancient ruin, once belonging to an ancient sect, now filled with chaotic spiritual energy, ruined places, broken formations, drifting mists, and lingering ancient pressure. This valley was both deadly and mysterious, holding hidden legacies, forgotten treasures, and dangerous remnants of a lost ancient era.
"The pressure is really strong!" Long Xukong said grimly.
Zhang Fei agreed with him. "So, where shall we start exploring this place?"
