chapters.title: Chapter 1709: Yin-Yang Spirit River
paragraphs: "Over there."

Zhang Fei and Long Xukong looked at the river to the east that Feng Yao had pointed to. The river itself wasn’t that wide or deep, and it was split into several channels, one of which flowed into the inner area of the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley. The water in the river was not clear; one side was white, and the other side was black.
"That river is almost similar to the Yin-Yang River in the Twin Flames Domain, but there is something special in it."
"What’s so special about that river?" Long Xukong didn’t see anything special about that river, and it was no different from ordinary rivers.
"You’re not a dual cultivator, so you don’t understand the difference." Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei. "However, you must have realized the specialness of that river, right, husband?"
Zhang Fei nodded at her. "The river is almost similar to Yin and Yang. The white water flow is Yang, and the black water flow is Yin."
"Yin and Yang?" Long Xukong was puzzled.

Feng Yao and Zhang Fei released the lotuses within their souls, allowing Long Xukong to see them for himself. "What do you think of these lotuses, Senior Xukong? Aren’t they the same as the water in that river?"

"If you two don’t show me these lotuses, I’ll have a hard time understanding what you mean, as I’m not a dual cultivator." Long Xukong looked at the river again. "But how can the water in the river be half white and half black?

Feng Yao and Zhang Fei returned the lotuses to their souls. "This place is called the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley not without reason, and the river is one of the advantages of this place. In the past, people from that sect dual cultivated in the river, and they did that at the same time."
"Hmm?" Long Xukong frowned and asked. "Weren’t they embarrassed to do such things? How could those male cultivators allow their partners to be naked in front of other men?"

"If I were in their shoes, I would gouge out all those men’s eyes." Long Xukong laughed at Zhang Fei’s statement. "I have no problem with other women seeing my wives naked, but it’s a big no for other men to see them in such a state. My wives’ bodies are my treasures, so only I can enjoy them."
"Hahaha," Long Xukong laughed even louder after hearing that. "Do you ever get bored after seeing them naked for decades?"
"Your question is truly weird, Senior Xu Kong." Zhang Fei cast a side glance. "Don’t tell me you’re tired of seeing your wife naked?"
Long Xukong smacked his own lips. "I’m not a man like you, okay? I never get tired of seeing my wife naked, but we’ve rarely done it in the past hundred years."
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed softly. "Does that mean you’re bored with your wife?"
"What the hell, kid! How could I be bored with my wife? It’s just—" Long Xukong didn’t continue his words.
Feng Yao smiled to herself when she saw Long Xukong’s embarrassed look, and she realized the problem between him and his wife.
Seeing Long Xukong like that, an idea popped into Zhang Fei’s mind. "Do you need my help?"
"What can you do for me?"
"Hey! I’m a lust demon, and I have the ability to modify other people’s bodies, remember?"
Long Xukong immediately caught the meaning behind Zhang Fei’s words. "Can you really do that?"
"Are my wives so few in your eyes?"
"A few, my ass!" Long Xukong shouted. "If your number of women is small, what about me, who only has one wife?"
Zhang Fei shrugged. "You are a dragon, so you should be able to have many wives. Don’t tell me that you are afraid of your wife."
"Alright! Don’t mention this matter again."
Zhang Fei glanced at him. "How about I bring your wife to this domain? Since we’re in this domain now, I’ll help you two, and you guys can try cultivating in that river."
"Please bring her here."
"Alright."
As soon as his fifth clone went straight to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain to pick up Long Xukong’s wife, Zhang Fei opened the portal to the Ying-Yang Space.

paragraphs: "You know I’m a fire phoenix and the embodiment of the core of this universe, right?"
"Then?"

Feng Yao created a qi screen, causing Zhang Fei to raise an eyebrow. "Normally, if a female phoenix has transformed into a human, she will give birth like any other ordinary woman, but I’m different from them. As you can see, my mother couldn’t give birth to me the normal way; instead, she laid an egg."
"Hmm?"

Zhang Fei seriously looked at the qi screen, and he saw Feng Jiu in her phoenix form. She was in great pain during childbirth, and the area around her was filled with phoenix flames. In the end, she didn’t give birth to a baby, but she laid a huge crimson egg with many flame patterns on its shell.

Zhang Fei could see that Feng Tian and Feng Jiu were confused by it because she was supposed to give birth to their first child, but instead, she laid an egg. After a long discussion and no solution, they decided to accept the situation, and she incubated her egg like other female beasts who hadn’t yet transformed into humans.
"How long did it take for your eggs to hatch at that time?"

"A thousand years." Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao in confusion because she was under a thousand years old. "For beasts, our age is not calculated based on the time we were in the egg, but rather based on the time we hatched from the egg. My mother incubated my egg for a thousand years, and it wasted a lot of her qi because my egg continued to absorb it, which almost caused her to die from qi depletion."

"I see." Zhang Fei turned his gaze to the qi screen again, which showed the process of Feng Yao’s egg hatching. She was born in the form of a phoenix with crimson flames enveloping her body. However, it didn’t last long, and she transformed into a baby girl, which made Feng Tian and Feng Jiu even more confused about her birth.
Normally, a phoenix needed a long time to mature and transform into a human, but Feng Yao could transform into a baby girl as soon as she hatched from her egg.
"Why are you showing all this to me, Yao’er?"

Feng Yao removed the qi screen and answered him, "With my condition, I’m not sure if my child will be born normally like a human, and my child’s birth will probably be as strange as when my mother gave birth to me."

"Oh." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and pulled her into his embrace. "Yao’er, I don’t care what kind of child we’ll have in the future or about the birth process. I only know that I want to have a child with you, and the birth of our child will make my life perfect. Even if our child can’t be born naturally like other human children, I’m not concerned about that. Even if I have to wait thousands or even tens of thousands of years, I will wait patiently because our child is proof of our love."
Feng Yao sighed at Zhang Fei’s impatience. "Husband, I understand your worries about your dreams, but dreams are just flowers of sleep, so you don’t need to dwell on them."

"I don’t want to think about those dreams, but they keep coming back every time I fall asleep, and I feel that they are real." Zhang Fei rubbed her cheek. "Yao’er, please allow me to impregnate you, and our child will be my first child."
Feng Yao pressed his palm to her cheek. "I understand your wishes, but let me think about it first, okay?"

"Alright." Zhang Fe was disappointed that Feng Yao still wanted to think about it first, but he didn’t want to force her, and he chose to give her time. "Speaking of a beast egg, I have one in my beast space. I got it when I went to the Xianjin Realm for the first time, and I’ve been using a beast incubation array on it for years. Besides, my beast space’s timeflow is four times faster than the outside world, but the egg still hasn’t hatched to this day."
Feng Yao was surprised to hear that. "Do you know what beast egg that is?"
"No," Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head. "The egg is too mysterious, and I don’t have any information about it."
"Show me the egg."
"Alright."

Zhang Fei and Feng Yao arrived at the location of the egg in the beast space, and the female phoenix was seriously observing it. "Hmm? I’ve never seen this kind of egg in our universe, husband. Did you get it from the system?"
"You know about that?" Zhang Fei was shocked.
Feng Yao nodded slightly. "I’ve implanted my flame in your body for a long time, so I know everything about you, including the system, Mei, and everything else."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "You are the third woman to know about all this besides Zhang Lin and my grandmother."
"Haha," Feng Yao softly laughed. "Zhang Lin guessed it all with her own ideas, and you told Zhang Chen when you took her as your wife."
"That’s right." Zhang Fei nodded. "So, you don’t know what kind of beast is in this egg?"

"No." Feng Yao approached the beast egg and rubbed its shell. "This egg and the beast inside never existed in this universe, husband. Since Xuanyuan Yue gave you the system, she should have the answer to this egg, but she clearly doesn’t want to tell you about it."
"Forget it then, and I’ll wait until this egg hatches on its own." Zhang Fei brought Feng Yao out of the beast space.
"So, where are we going now?"
Feng Yao took Zhang Fei’s hand and led him off somewhere. "The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley has a place that’s very useful for dual cultivators, and you’ll definitely be interested in it."
"What kind of place is it?"
"You’ll find out when we get there."

Soon, they arrived at an open area, and Zhang Fei could see many carvings on the floor throughout the area. He also found much debris there, but it was different from the debris in other areas. "Hmm? A natural formation?"
"That’s right." Feng Yao nodded, pointing to the stone platform in the center of the place. "See that? To activate this Dragon Phoenix Union Formation Array, we need a man and a woman."
"The Dragon Phoenix Union Formation Array?"

"This Dragon Phoenix Union Formation Array is different from other dual cultivation formations." Feng Yao led Zhang Fei to land on the stone platform. "Once we start dual cultivation, this formation will activate automatically. I can’t explain its benefits in words, so you’ll have to experience its effects for yourself when we dual cultivate. Can you open the gate to this place?"
"I can." Zhang Fei asked Mei to open the gate. "Are you sure this formation is still active?"

Feng Yao nodded. "The formation is still intact even though this entire area has been in ruins for a long time, so I’m confident we can activate it. Since you can open the gate to this place, you should bring all your wives to dual cultivate with you here in turn in the future, and their cultivation will improve even faster."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei knitted his brows. "Is the effect of this formation much more useful for female cultivators than male cultivators?"

"Not really." Feng Yao shook her head slightly. "Naturally, this formation will be useful for all dual cultivators, whether they are male or female. However, this formation will be more useful for those with a lower cultivation level than their partners, so you should understand what I mean, right?"

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "If I dual cultivate with you in this formation, I will gain many more benefits because your cultivation is far above mine. If I dual cultivate with some of my wives with cultivation below mine, they will gain even more benefits."
"That’s right." Feng Yao quickly removed her dress, making Zhang Fei’s breathing become irregular. She smiled seductively and helped him undress. "Are you impatient to dual cultivate with me again?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed wryly. "Yao’er, even if we dual cultivate for millions of years, I will never get bored of dual cultivating with you."
"Let’s do it then." Feng Yao pushed Zhang Fei to sit, and she sat on his lap as she inserted his cock into her.

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as the formation lit up on his own, and he realized that the formation beneath him formed a Yin Yang symbol. Soon, the silhouette of a dragon appeared behind him, and a silhouette of a phoenix appeared behind Feng Yao. "This."

Feng Yao smiled. "See? The formation is still active, right? This formation activates on its own once our bodies are connected, and you will understand the benefits once our Yin and Yang Qi circulate within our bodies."

"Let’s do it then." Zhang Fei and Feng Yao released their souls, and the white and black lotuses within them immediately came out before merging into one to form the true Yin-Yang Lotus. Once their Yang and Yin qi revolved within each other’s bodies and souls, the dragon and the phoenix shone brightly. "This."
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "Do you like the benefits, husband?"
"I like it." Zhang Fei replied with excitement. "I didn’t expect your Yin Qi to become so much stronger than usual once this formation is activated."
"Do you want to know the amount of Yin Qi you can get from me while we are in this formation?"
"That’s for sure!" Feng Yao simply smiled and released her Yin Qi, and the two notifications that appeared shocked Zhang Fei.

I can’t explain its benefits in words, so you’ll have to experience its effects for yourself when we dual cultivate.
Can you open the gate to this place?"
"I can." Zhang Fei asked Mei to open the gate.
"Are you sure this formation is still active?"
Feng Yao nodded.
"The formation is still intact even though this entire area has been in ruins for a long time, so I’m confident we can activate it.
Since you can open the gate to this place, you should bring all your wives to dual cultivate with you here in turn in the future, and their cultivation will improve even faster."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei knitted his brows.
"Is the effect of this formation much more useful for female cultivators than male cultivators?"
"Not really." Feng Yao shook her head slightly.
"Naturally, this formation will be useful for all dual cultivators, whether they are male or female.
However, this formation will be more useful for those with a lower cultivation level than their partners, so you should understand what I mean, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"If I dual cultivate with you in this formation, I will gain many more benefits because your cultivation is far above mine.
If I dual cultivate with some of my wives with cultivation below mine, they will gain even more benefits."
"That’s right." Feng Yao quickly removed her dress, making Zhang Fei’s breathing become irregular.
She smiled seductively and helped him undress.
"Are you impatient to dual cultivate with me again?"
"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed wryly.
"Yao’er, even if we dual cultivate for millions of years, I will never get bored of dual cultivating with you."
"Let’s do it then." Feng Yao pushed Zhang Fei to sit, and she sat on his lap as she inserted his cock into her.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow as the formation lit up on his own, and he realized that the formation beneath him formed a Yin Yang symbol.
Soon, the silhouette of a dragon appeared behind him, and a silhouette of a phoenix appeared behind Feng Yao.
"This."
Feng Yao smiled.
"See?
The formation is still active, right?
This formation activates on its own once our bodies are connected, and you will understand the benefits once our Yin and Yang Qi circulate within our bodies."
"Let’s do it then." Zhang Fei and Feng Yao released their souls, and the white and black lotuses within them immediately came out before merging into one to form the true Yin-Yang Lotus.
Once their Yang and Yin qi revolved within each other’s bodies and souls, the dragon and the phoenix shone brightly.
"This."
"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled.
"Do you like the benefits, husband?"
"I like it." Zhang Fei replied with excitement.
"I didn’t expect your Yin Qi to become so much stronger than usual once this formation is activated."
"Do you want to know the amount of Yin Qi you can get from me while we are in this formation?"
"That’s for sure!" Feng Yao simply smiled and released her Yin Qi, and the two notifications that appeared shocked Zhang Fei.

chapters.title: Chapter 1711: The Ruin Of the Ancient Library
paragraphs: [You gained 500,000,000 Yin Qi from Feng Yao.]
[You gained 50,000,000 Beast Essence from Feng Yao.]

Zhang Fei nodded slightly. "Not bad! Ten times the original amount! However, you forgot that my training space has many much better features, including the fast timeflow. Even so, I have to admit that the effects of the Dragon Phoenix Union Formation are truly extraordinary, and it will be useful to the people of my sect."
"Since you don’t plan to bring people from your sect to your training space, you can bring them here, and they can cultivate much faster than in the sect."

Zhang Fei agreed. "The weakness of this formation is that it does not benefit both parties, and it only benefits those who are weaker. Unlike this formation, all the features in my training space benefit both parties, so everyone will improve at the same time."

"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "You’re right, that is indeed the main weakness of this formation. However, you are the only cultivator in this universe who possesses all of those advantages, making this formation insignificant for you, while it remains a treasure trove for others. In the past, people tried to attack this sect, but the members were powerful for the others, so none of the attackers ever succeeded in taking over. If not for the disaster, this sect would not have been destroyed, and its members would have become too powerful."

"Hey, Yao’er, what exactly was the cause of those past disasters?" Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei uncertainly. "You said that the destruction of the Primordial Era was caused by the actions of those primordial beings. The situation calmed down after the appearance of Hu Tianlang, who stopped the fighting between them and brought calm back. However, you never mentioned the disaster that hit the Ancient Realm in the past, so I’m curious about that."

Feng Yao sighed. "The disaster that struck the Ancient Realm in the past was almost the same as the disaster that destroyed the Primordial Realm, but its scale was much smaller because the strength of the ancients was too weak compared to the primordials. Although many of them died at that time, the ancients still managed to survive to this day. As for the source of the disaster, you should be able to guess it, right?"
"All living beings are the cause of the disaster."
"That’s right." Feng Yao nodded. "We don’t need to talk about other realms, and we can take the Earth as an example."
"Earth?"
"You must still remember that many cultivators and beasts lived on Earth in the past, right?"
"That’s right."

"Even though Earth is in the lower realm, the planet was prosperous in the past, and the qi there was quite abundant. However, the greed of the people of the four realms changed everything, and the era of cultivators ended after the war between the four races in the past, which ended with the qi disappearing completely from the planet."
"The cause was my master, Han Ling, with his Forgotten Sword Technique."

"Han Ling was indeed the cause, but we can’t blame him either. If the people of the Xian, Diyu, and Tian Realms hadn’t tried to take over Earth, he might never have used that technique, and Earth might have had a different future."
"Yes," Zhang Fei agreed. "After that incident, all the cultivators moved to other realms, and my master had to shoulder the blame that should have been everyone’s responsibility."

"Selfishness is one of the basic traits of all living creatures, and the weak always blame the stronger for what happens in their lives." Zhang Fei smiled bitterly hearing that. "Those have no ability to help in battle, and they always blame others for their suffering. If Han Ling had not used his sword technique back then, Earth would have long been overrun by the people of the three realms, and those who were weak would have suffered greatly."

Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh. "Although the cultivator era has ended on Earth, the Earthlings have never changed, and their actions are slowly destroying the planet. In the past, I asked Lillea and Janette to restore nature there in the hope that it would improve in the future, but I’m not sure it will last, and nature will be damaged again because of their actions."

"Honestly, those Earthlings are much more selfish and greedier than the cultivators." Zhang Fei didn’t argue with Feng Yao, and she immediately created a qi screen that displayed the situation on Earth. "See? Lillea and Janette’s efforts to restore Earth’s condition were in vain because the Earthlings never changed, and they continued to destroy nature. They don’t have the power of cultivators, but they have a lot of technology that can destroy many things, and some countries really like war. Actually, your decision to get rid of those slaves was a big mistake, and you should have let them live to maintain the situation on Earth."

Zhang Fei had no regrets about getting rid of his slaves, especially since they were a burden on his soul. "Forget it, Yao’er. If Earth is destroyed in the future, then those Earthlings will have only themselves to blame, and we shouldn’t interfere in their lives."
"Do you really have the heart to see Earth destroyed?"

"Why not?" Zhang Fei shrugged. "I’ve asked Lillea and Janette to restore Earth’s condition, but those Earthlings have no intention of changing. Therefore, I will no longer help them, and I will watch their destruction from afar."
Feng Yao could only shake her head at Zhang Fei’s response.

Zhang Fei continued. "Rather than worrying about the fate of Earthlings, I prefer to think about my future and the future of everyone close to me. After all, those shadowy creatures are extremely powerful and dangerous, and you don’t have the power to stop them. If we can’t find a solution to stop them, they will destroy this universe, and far more people will suffer than those Earthlings. By the way, can you defeat the Chaos Beast?"
"Did Ling’er tell you about the Chaos Beast?"
"Yes."

"That Chaos Beast was born at the same time as this universe, so you could say that he’s my blood brother, and his strength is equal to mine. If the two of us were to fight in the future, our fight would be dangerous for this universe."

Feng Yao’s statement left Zhang Fei dumbstruck, as he had never considered that possibility before. After all, she was the embodiment of the core of this universe, and the Chaos Beast was born at the same time as the universe, so they were like siblings. "Can you persuade the Chaos Beast to hand over the Chaos Flame to me?"

"I’m not sure the Chaos Beast will listen to me," Feng Yao sighed in disappointment. "He’s simply too powerful, and no living creature in this universe can defeat him. I can match him in battle, but I’m not confident I can defeat him. If you want to obtain the Chaos Flame, I’ll take you there in the future, but you’ll have to persuade him to obtain the flame yourself."
"Do you think I can persuade him?"
"I don’t have an answer to that because he’s too arrogant, so you’ll have to find a way to persuade him, and I’ll protect you if he tries to attack you."
"Forget it for now, and I’ll think about it in the future."
"Alright." Feng Yao nodded. "Do you want to dual cultivate here first?"
"Naturally, I’d love to dual cultivate with you, but we can’t waste time here. I want to explore all areas of this place, especially the locations of their techniques."
Feng Yao pointed to an area to their left. "That place is their main library, and you can find their techniques there."

"Hmm?" Zhang Fei directed his senses towards the area, and he found that most of the place was already destroyed. However, he found several things there, and he couldn’t wait to check them out. "Let’s go there now."

Feng Yao immediately got up from Zhang Fei’s lap, and the formation automatically disappeared after their bodies were no longer connected. After they got dressed, they went straight to the library location.
When they arrived there, Zhang Fei saw many scrolls scattered on the ground, but most of them were destroyed and unreadable. "The past disaster must have been terrible to destroy this place."
"Yes." Feng Yao picked up one of the scrolls on the ground, brushed off the dirt, and opened it. "This technique is the Taiji Formation Array, and this formation uses the principles of Yin and Yang."
"Is that formation good, Yao’er?" Zhang Fei asked as he looked for a technique scroll that was still intact.
"This technique isn’t bad, but it’s not great either." Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao. "This array is almost similar to the sixth effect of your lust domain."
"Illusion?"
Feng Yao nodded. "The illusion produced by the Taiji Formation Array is extremely powerful, and all cultivators trapped within it will die due to the depletion of the qi in their bodies."
"What if I use that formation in the sect?"
"I don’t recommend that, husband. If you want to use this formation, you must set it up outside the sect."
"Is the formation so sensitive as to affect the people in the sect?"
"This formation is too sensitive, and the people of your sect will be affected by it. If that happens, they will die inside the formation."
"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding as he picked up a scroll from the ground. He brushed the dirt off it and opened it. "Hmm? What kind of technique is this?"
Feng Yao walked to Zhang Fei’s side and looked at the scroll. "This technique is the Yin-Yang Suppression Art."

chapters.title: Chapter 1712: Forbidden Dual Cultivation Techniques
paragraphs: "The Yin-Yang Suppression Art."
Feng Yao explained to Zhang Fei the details of the technique.

The Yin-Yang Suppression Art is an ancient technique that manipulates the opposing qi of yin and yang. In the first stage, the user can weaken soul attacks, seal cultivation, and disrupt elemental techniques.

As the second stage, the user can release waves of alternating cold yin qi and scorching yang qi, creating a powerful pressure that crushes weaker opponents in both body and soul. Yin qi freezes meridians and slows movement, while yang qi ignites blood essence and shakes defensive barriers.

In the final stage, the user can create a massive Yin-Yang Suppression Domain, where all qi within the area is forcibly weakened. Within the domain, all enemy techniques lose stability, and everything is suppressed under the overwhelming pressure of Yin-Yang.
"There are only three stages, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "I feel that the first stage of the technique isn’t very useful, but the second and third stages are quite useful."

Feng Yao nodded at him. "The first stage of this technique isn’t that useful to you because you have many techniques with similar effects, and they are much better than this technique. Even so, this technique is still worth learning, and it might be useful to you in the future."

"Alright, I’ll learn it." Zhang Fei rolled up the scroll and put it into the system inventory, and his clones could learn it in the pavilion. He also kept the Taiji Formation Array, but he was still confused about where to install the formation. "This place is a mess, and many techniques have been destroyed by the past disaster, making them unreadable."

"Haha," Feng Yao laughed softly. "This place was once a paradise for dual cultivators, but all that remains now are ruins of its former glory. There aren’t many techniques left here, so I think you can keep them all and put them in your sect’s library, and they might be useful for your sect’s future."

"That’s true." Zhang Fei waved his hand, and all the technique scrolls floated up on their own. He used his senses to examine all the intact techniques and separate them from the destroyed ones, storing them in the system inventory. "Where do they keep the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art, Yao’er?"

"Follow me." Zhang Fei followed behind Feng Yao until they arrived in front of a hole leading to an underground chamber with stone steps leading down. "All the techniques outside are ordinary , and they keep their forbidden techniques under there, including the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art."
Feng Yao and Zhang Fei immediately walked down the stairs. "Did they have many forbidden techniques in the past?"

"Not really." Feng Yao shook her head. "If I remember correctly, they had five forbidden techniques. Mo Shentian was truly foolish because he didn’t learn all of them, and he only chose to study the Yin Sacrifice Art."
"Five forbidden techniques?" Zhang Fei’s brows knitted together.
Feng Yao nodded at him. "Besides the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art, there are three other forbidden techniques, and one of them is truly terrifying."
"Do you know anything about that technique?"
"Are you thinking about learning it?"
"You know that I never cared whether they were evil techniques or not, right? As long as they were useful for improving myself and fighting all my enemies, I would definitely learn them."

Feng Yao could only shake her head. "Since your evil nature is already overwhelming, you won’t have any problems learning those evil techniques. However, innocent people will change if they learn those evil techniques, and they will eventually turn into evil cultivators."
"Does that mean I’m evil in your eyes?"

"Aren’t you evil?" Feng Yao gave him a side glance. "In the eyes of other cultivators, you may not seem evil, but I understand you far better than they do, so I can tell that you are an evil cultivator."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed. "I’m not really an evil cultivator, right? I’m kind-hearted, patient, and merciful, okay?"

"I admit that you are kind and patient, but you are not a merciful person, and you are truly ruthless." Zhang Fei smiled upon hearing that. "Sometimes I think that you are even more ruthless than I am, and all your actions towards your enemies are simply too terrifying."

Zhang Fei lifted his right hand and clenched his fists. "My principle is that I will be kind to those who are kind, and I will always be ruthless towards all my enemies. Many people are willing to forgive their enemies, but I cannot do the same because forgiving them would only lead to endless trouble for me; therefore, I prefer to kill them directly to avoid future headaches."
"If all cultivators acted like you, the population of this universe would surely be small. After all, there are countless evil cultivators in this universe, and they always bring trouble to others."

"That’s true." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement. "Wouldn’t that be much better, Yao’er? If the population of this universe were reduced to a small amount, the universe would be much more peaceful, right?"
Feng Yao could only shake her head. "Compared to those evil cultivators, you are far more evil and vile than them, husband."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed. "As long as they don’t bother me or those closest to me, I will never bother them, let alone kill them."
After walking down for some time, Zhang Fei and Feng Yao finally arrived at a fairly large underground chamber, where they saw a stone table with four technique scrolls neatly arranged on it.
Zhang Fei saw a technique scroll open on the ground; he immediately took it and brushed off the dirt. "This must be the Yin Sacrifice Art, right?"
"Hmm?" Feng Yao walked to his side and read the technique. "You’re right; this is the Yin Sacrifice Art. What are you going to do with this technique? Are you really going to burn it?"

"Well? I’ve memorized the details of this technique just by reading it once, so I’ll burn this scroll, and no other cultivators will be able to learn it in the future." Zhang Fei did not hesitate to burn the scroll to ashes, and he took another technique afterward. "The Yang Sacrifice Art! Female cultivators use this technique to turn male cultivators’ bodies into their cultivation furnaces. What did those ancients really think? Why did they create such techniques in the past?"

Feng Yao immediately explained to him, "Those people were aware of the existence of realms higher than the Five Celestial Realms, but they had no clear information about those stages. That’s why they created the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art, and they hoped that both techniques could help them reach the next realm. Unfortunately, their efforts were fruitless, as they would never reach the next stage in this realm, and the past disaster destroyed their sect."
"I still don’t understand why the Ancients couldn’t reach the Three God Realms, Yao’er. Was it because of you or those hidden forces?"
"I am the embodiment of the core of this universe, but I can do nothing to prevent them from reaching the Three God Realms."
"So, those hidden forces are deliberately preventing them from reaching the Three God Realms?"

"That’s right." Feng Yao nodded. "Those hidden forces hold complete control over this universe, and they adjusted everything after the destruction of the Primordial Era to prevent a repeat of that incident. Unfortunately, their actions were useless, and all the living beings after the primordials have the same attitude as their predecessors."

"I’m curious to meet those hidden forces, especially the heavens, who have repeatedly tried to kill me." Zhang Fei burned the scroll of the Yang Sacrifice Art before taking another scroll from the stone table. "What technique is this? Why doesn’t it have a name?"

"It’s the Yin-Yang Essence Devouring Technique, and its principles are almost identical to your Life-Force Absorption Ability and Essence Absorption Technique." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows. "Your two techniques are used to absorb living beings’ life force and beast essence, and this technique is used to devour the Yin-Yang Essence of other living beings."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Basically, this technique is similar to Ursula’s Devouring Art and the Demon Absorbing of the Netherworld Demon Scripture."

"You’re not wrong about that, but this Yin-Yang Essence Devouring Technique is far more terrifying than those two techniques." Feng Yao read the scroll before continuing. "You can learn this technique if you want, but I’m not sure it will be useful to you."

After reading the entire contents of the scroll, Zhang Fei immediately burned it so that no other cultivator could study it, except him. He took another scroll from the stone table and read it. "Hmm? The Yin-Yang Cauldron Art? Why did this sect create techniques with almost the same effect?"

"You’re wrong about that, husband." Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao. "The Yin-Yang Cauldron Art is almost similar to the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art, but this technique has a different effect from those two techniques."
Zhang Fei immediately read the technique.

[The Yin-Yang Cauldron Art is a sinister forbidden dual cultivation technique that treats living cultivators as cauldrons used to refine yin and yang essence. This technique forcibly extracts vitality, qi cultivation, blood essence, and soul power from the partner to strengthen the user’s cultivation at a terrifying speed.]

"Treat living cultivators as living cauldrons," Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "This technique doesn’t seem sinister compared to the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art, but after reading the details, it’s far more sinister than those two techniques. While those two techniques only reduce lifespans, this technique reduces many things for its victims, including their cultivation."

Even so, this technique is still worth learning, and it might be useful to you in the future."
"Alright, I’ll learn it." Zhang Fei rolled up the scroll and put it into the system inventory, and his clones could learn it in the pavilion.
He also kept the Taiji Formation Array, but he was still confused about where to install the formation.
"This place is a mess, and many techniques have been destroyed by the past disaster, making them unreadable."
"Haha," Feng Yao laughed softly.
"This place was once a paradise for dual cultivators, but all that remains now are ruins of its former glory.
There aren’t many techniques left here, so I think you can keep them all and put them in your sect’s library, and they might be useful for your sect’s future."
"That’s true." Zhang Fei waved his hand, and all the technique scrolls floated up on their own.
He used his senses to examine all the intact techniques and separate them from the destroyed ones, storing them in the system inventory.
"Where do they keep the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art, Yao’er?"
"Follow me." Zhang Fei followed behind Feng Yao until they arrived in front of a hole leading to an underground chamber with stone steps leading down.
"All the techniques outside are ordinary , and they keep their forbidden techniques under there, including the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art."
Feng Yao and Zhang Fei immediately walked down the stairs.
"Did they have many forbidden techniques in the past?"
"Not really." Feng Yao shook her head.
"If I remember correctly, they had five forbidden techniques.
Mo Shentian was truly foolish because he didn’t learn all of them, and he only chose to study the Yin Sacrifice Art."
"Five forbidden techniques?" Zhang Fei’s brows knitted together.
Feng Yao nodded at him.
"Besides the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art, there are three other forbidden techniques, and one of them is truly terrifying."
"Do you know anything about that technique?"
"Are you thinking about learning it?"
"You know that I never cared whether they were evil techniques or not, right?
As long as they were useful for improving myself and fighting all my enemies, I would definitely learn them."
Feng Yao could only shake her head.
"Since your evil nature is already overwhelming, you won’t have any problems learning those evil techniques.
However, innocent people will change if they learn those evil techniques, and they will eventually turn into evil cultivators."
"Does that mean I’m evil in your eyes?"
"Aren’t you evil?" Feng Yao gave him a side glance.
"In the eyes of other cultivators, you may not seem evil, but I understand you far better than they do, so I can tell that you are an evil cultivator."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed.
"I’m not really an evil cultivator, right?
I’m kind-hearted, patient, and merciful, okay?"
"I admit that you are kind and patient, but you are not a merciful person, and you are truly ruthless." Zhang Fei smiled upon hearing that.
"Sometimes I think that you are even more ruthless than I am, and all your actions towards your enemies are simply too terrifying."
Zhang Fei lifted his right hand and clenched his fists.
"My principle is that I will be kind to those who are kind, and I will always be ruthless towards all my enemies.

Many people are willing to forgive their enemies, but I cannot do the same because forgiving them would only lead to endless trouble for me; therefore, I prefer to kill them directly to avoid future headaches."
"If all cultivators acted like you, the population of this universe would surely be small.
After all, there are countless evil cultivators in this universe, and they always bring trouble to others."
"That’s true." Zhang Fei nodded in agreement.
"Wouldn’t that be much better, Yao’er?
If the population of this universe were reduced to a small amount, the universe would be much more peaceful, right?"
Feng Yao could only shake her head.
"Compared to those evil cultivators, you are far more evil and vile than them, husband."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei laughed.
"As long as they don’t bother me or those closest to me, I will never bother them, let alone kill them."
After walking down for some time, Zhang Fei and Feng Yao finally arrived at a fairly large underground chamber, where they saw a stone table with four technique scrolls neatly arranged on it.
Zhang Fei saw a technique scroll open on the ground; he immediately took it and brushed off the dirt.
"This must be the Yin Sacrifice Art, right?"
"Hmm?" Feng Yao walked to his side and read the technique.
"You’re right; this is the Yin Sacrifice Art.
What are you going to do with this technique?
Are you really going to burn it?"
"Well?

I’ve memorized the details of this technique just by reading it once, so I’ll burn this scroll, and no other cultivators will be able to learn it in the future." Zhang Fei did not hesitate to burn the scroll to ashes, and he took another technique afterward.
"The Yang Sacrifice Art!
Female cultivators use this technique to turn male cultivators’ bodies into their cultivation furnaces.
What did those ancients really think?
Why did they create such techniques in the past?"
Feng Yao immediately explained to him, "Those people were aware of the existence of realms higher than the Five Celestial Realms, but they had no clear information about those stages.
That’s why they created the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art, and they hoped that both techniques could help them reach the next realm.
Unfortunately, their efforts were fruitless, as they would never reach the next stage in this realm, and the past disaster destroyed their sect."
"I still don’t understand why the Ancients couldn’t reach the Three God Realms, Yao’er.
Was it because of you or those hidden forces?"
"I am the embodiment of the core of this universe, but I can do nothing to prevent them from reaching the Three God Realms."
"So, those hidden forces are deliberately preventing them from reaching the Three God Realms?"
"That’s right." Feng Yao nodded.
"Those hidden forces hold complete control over this universe, and they adjusted everything after the destruction of the Primordial Era to prevent a repeat of that incident.
Unfortunately, their actions were useless, and all the living beings after the primordials have the same attitude as their predecessors."

"I’m curious to meet those hidden forces, especially the heavens, who have repeatedly tried to kill me." Zhang Fei burned the scroll of the Yang Sacrifice Art before taking another scroll from the stone table.
"What technique is this?
Why doesn’t it have a name?"
"It’s the Yin-Yang Essence Devouring Technique, and its principles are almost identical to your Life-Force Absorption Ability and Essence Absorption Technique." Zhang Fei furrowed his brows.
"Your two techniques are used to absorb living beings’ life force and beast essence, and this technique is used to devour the Yin-Yang Essence of other living beings."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"Basically, this technique is similar to Ursula’s Devouring Art and the Demon Absorbing of the Netherworld Demon Scripture."
"You’re not wrong about that, but this Yin-Yang Essence Devouring Technique is far more terrifying than those two techniques." Feng Yao read the scroll before continuing.
"You can learn this technique if you want, but I’m not sure it will be useful to you."
After reading the entire contents of the scroll, Zhang Fei immediately burned it so that no other cultivator could study it, except him.
He took another scroll from the stone table and read it.
"Hmm?
The Yin-Yang Cauldron Art?
Why did this sect create techniques with almost the same effect?"
"You’re wrong about that, husband." Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao.
"The Yin-Yang Cauldron Art is almost similar to the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art, but this technique has a different effect from those two techniques."
Zhang Fei immediately read the technique.
[The Yin-Yang Cauldron Art is a sinister forbidden dual cultivation technique that treats living cultivators as cauldrons used to refine yin and yang essence.
This technique forcibly extracts vitality, qi cultivation, blood essence, and soul power from the partner to strengthen the user’s cultivation at a terrifying speed.]
"Treat living cultivators as living cauldrons," Zhang Fei muttered to himself.
"This technique doesn’t seem sinister compared to the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art, but after reading the details, it’s far more sinister than those two techniques.
While those two techniques only reduce lifespans, this technique reduces many things for its victims, including their cultivation."

chapters.title: Chapter 1713: Six Desire Heavenly Demon Sutra
paragraphs: Zhang Fei sat cross-legged on the ground.
"Are you going to learn the Yin-Yang Cauldron Art now, Husband?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei closed his eyes and started learning the technique.
Huo Ling suddenly emerged from Zhang Fei’s body. "Are you sure it’s okay for our husband to learn the technique, Master?"

"You’ve been following him with me for a long time, so you should know his character by heart, right?" Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei with a calm gaze. "Even though that technique is a forbidden evil one, I’m sure he will never be affected by it."
"I hope so."

With his comprehension, Zhang Fei managed to learn the Yin-Yang Cauldron Art in less than an hour. As soon as he used the technique, a black and white cauldron surrounded by demonic runes appeared behind him. Unlike other dual cultivation techniques, he could use it without dual cultivation, and the cauldron behind him was the key.
Zhang Fei opened his eyes and looked at the black and white cauldron behind him. "Ling’er, please help me find a beast."
"Alright." Huo Ling immediately disappeared from that place.
Within a few minutes, Huo Ling had returned to the place and thrown a female ox beast on the floor. "Do you want to use this beast to test that technique, husband?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei looked at the female beast and activated his technique. In that instant, black and white threads shot out from the cauldron, binding the female ox beast and pulling her inside. "Let’s see."

Moments later, the cauldron released black and white light, forming a Yin Yang symbol above it. Zhang Fei and the others could see half of the female ox beast’s body turning black and the other half turning white, with demonic runes covering it. "The cauldron won’t activate without a sacrifice."

"What’s special about the Yin-Yang Cauldron Art is that you can use it with or without dual cultivation, and the results will be the same." Feng Yao looked at the cauldron seriously. "If you use it without dual cultivation, the cauldron will process the sacrifice accordingly, and it will produce pills depending on the sacrifice. If you use it while dual cultivating with a woman, the results will be directly channeled into your body, so you can feel the results immediately."

"I never thought of using this technique with dual cultivation directly, and I prefer to use it without dual cultivation. If I use a male sacrifice, the pill will correspond to Yang, and the pill will correspond to Yin if the sacrifice is a female, right?"
"That’s right." Feng Yao nodded. "The pill produced is not a dual cultivation pill, and it contains the sacrifice’s vitality, qi cultivation, Yin or Yang essences, blood essence, and soul power."
Zhang Fei grinned. "If I use this technique in dual cultivation, only I will reap the benefits. If I use it without dual cultivation, I can share the pills with others."
After a few minutes, the female ox beast disappeared from the cauldron, and what appeared above it was a white pill. Zhang Fei immediately took it and examined it.

"This pill really contains the vitality, qi cultivation, Yin or Yang essences, blood essence, and soul power of the female ox beast." Zhang Fei summoned the Three-Eyed Sky Tyrant, Sha Huoyan, out from the beast space. "Try this pill, Huoyan."
Sha Huoyan felt something was off about the pill, but she knew that Zhang Fei would never harm her. She immediately swallowed the pill and dissolved it using her qi.
"How do you feel, Huoyan?"

"Hmm?" Sha Huoyan thought of the right words to describe the pill’s effects. "Master, the pill contains vitality, qi, yin essences, blood essence, and soul power, right? Although I don’t feel any significant changes in my cultivation, I do feel that some parts of me have undergone significant changes."

"Yes," Zhang Fei explained the pill’s effects to Sha Huoyan, but he didn’t tell her that it was made from a living sacrifice. "I’ll send you back to the beast space, and I’ll give you the same pill later, so some aspects of you will improve more quickly."
"Thank you, Master."

After sending Sha Huoyan back to the beast space, Zhang Fei deactivated the Yin-Yang Cauldron Art, and the black and white cauldron immediately disappeared on its own. "Although this technique is evil, I can use other sacrifices to use it, for example, those ordinary beasts, demon beasts, or demons."
"Everything is fine as long as you don’t use humans as sacrifices, husband."
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao and Huo Ling. "I will use humans as sacrifices in the future, but I will never use innocent people as sacrifices, and I will only use those who are truly evil."
"I don’t think that’s a problem." Feng Yao and Huo Ling nodded in agreement.
Zhang Fei looked at the last technique scroll, but he was thrown back as soon as he intended to pick it up. "What the hell is that?"

"This technique is different from the previous four techniques, husband." Feng Yao extended her right hand forward and sucked the technique scroll toward her. Unlike what happened to Zhang Fei, the scroll didn’t knock her back, but it did vibrate violently as it resisted her aura. "If you dare to challenge me, I will incinerate this scroll with my phoenix flames, and your existence will disappear from this universe."
The technique scroll instantly stopped shaking and no longer fought back against Feng Yao’s aura.
"Heh." Feng Yao snorted and opened the scroll, but a black shadow immediately came out of it. "As I thought, those people created you and instilled you in this technique."
Zhang Fei’s brows furrowed. "What is that black shadow, Yao’er?"
"This black shadow is the soul of this Six Desire Heavenly Demon Sutra."

"The Six Desire Heavenly Demon Sutra?" Feng Yao handed the technique scroll to Zhang Fei, and he immediately read it. "It is a notoriously forbidden dual cultivation technique, created by an ancient cultivator who sought to transform human desires into demonic cultivation power. This technique centers on the six desires—lust, greed, obsession, domination, pleasure, and possession—using them as fuel to corrupt both body and soul."

Feng Yao nodded at him. "If you use the technique on female cultivators, it will create Six Desire Demon Hearts in their hearts. They will experience constant indulgence in six desires, slowly eroding their sanity, and they will never be able to escape from you. However, this technique has huge horrific consequences, and those female cultivators will eventually turn into demons, so you must not use it carelessly."
"A dual cultivation technique that can transform living beings into demons, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered to himself. "It doesn’t just affect women; it affects men too, right?"
"It all depends on the gender of the user, husband. Since you’re a man, the effects will affect women. If a woman uses it, the effects will affect men."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Have you ever seen victims of this technique in the past?"

"Yes," Feng Yao created a qi screen that showed several women who were victims of the technique. "Can you see them? Their bodies and souls have been corrupted by that technique, and they’ve lost their sanity because of it. Only the user of that technique can control them, and they will attack everyone besides the user."
Zhang Fei took a deep breath, as the technique was extremely terrifying. "What are the long-term effects of this technique?"
"Those women will suffer cultivation regression, Qi deviation, broken meridians, loss of lifespan, and much more."
"In the end, those women will become crippled or die, right?"
Feng Yao nodded. "You can’t use this technique on all your wives, but you can use it on your enemies."
"Naturally, I don’t use such a terrifying technique on any of my wives," Zhang Fei said seriously. "Does that mean I’ll also have the Six Desire Demon Hearts if I learn this technique?"

"That’s for sure, but the effects will be different for you." Feng Yao immediately explained to him. "The Lust Heart is related to lust and the like. The Greed Heart will amplify your essence absorption rate. The Obsession Heart will bind their souls to yours. The Possession Heart can help you dominate their mentality. The Indulgence Heart will corrupt their emotions. The Domination Heart will suppress their wills, so they will submit to you completely."
"Such a terrifying technique." Zhang Fei rolled up the scroll and stored it in his system inventory. "I won’t learn it now; I’ll think about it first."
"Are you afraid of the effects of that technique, husband?" Huo Ling asked.

"Yes." Zhang Fei pulled her over and kissed her. "Even though I’m a demon, I still have my consciousness, and I should think twice about learning that technique. Since there’s nothing here anymore, we have to leave now, but where are we going next?"
"Follow me."
Within a few minutes, they had returned to the ruined library, and Feng Yao led them to another area.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei looked around. "What kind of place was this in the past?"
"Look at them." Feng Yao pointed to several alchemy furnaces to the north. "Dual cultivation is inseparable from pills, and this place is a place for alchemy."

"I see." Zhang Fei approached one of the furnaces, but it shattered as soon as he touched it. "Eh? Why did this furnace crumble by itself? Even though this place has been a ruin for many years, an alchemy furnace shouldn’t be destroyed like this, right?"
"The furnace you just touched was just an ordinary one." Feng Yao waved her hand, and a stone door was exposed before their eyes. "Let’s go in, husband! The best alchemy furnace is in that room."

chapters.title: Chapter 1714: Nine Dragon Alchemy Furnace
paragraphs: "Damn!" Zhang Fei shouted loudly. "This alchemy furnace is simply too huge!"

The furnace was enormous, standing several meters tall with a dark black-gold surface covered in ancient runes. Its lid resembled a dragon’s head, and its legs were shaped like dragon claws. Nine dragons coiled around the furnace walls, each representing a different attribute. During alchemy, nine dragons lit up one after another, surrounding the furnace while releasing tremendous dragon pressure.

"Hehe," Feng Yao chuckled. "The name of this furnace is the Nine Dragon Alchemy Furnace. It is an ancient, supreme-grade furnace forged during the Ancient Era by a legendary supreme-rank blacksmith, and he made it specifically for the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley due to a past debt of gratitude. Its body is made from Starfall Divine Iron and tempered in the flames of heavenly tribulation for ten thousand years."
Zhang Fei took a deep breath. "How many alchemists are needed to light this furnace?"
"At least ten alchemists, and each of them must have mastered the fire elemental laws to the perfection stage."

Zhang Fei had at least nine god rank alchemists by his side, and if he added Feng Yao to their group, their total would reach ten, which should be sufficient to light the furnace. "How many batches of pills can we concoct in one batch if we use this furnace?"

"At least five batches of pills, husband." Feng Yao flicked the lid open and took Zhang Fei into the furnace. "Even though this furnace hasn’t been used for a long time, its materials will never be destroyed. The furnace is equipped with an ancient formation at the bottom, and it will reduce the time needed to concoct pills by at least thirty percent."
Zhang Fei nodded slightly as he looked at the furnace’s interior. "What are the advantages of this furnace?"

"The furnace can separate and control nine layers of flame simultaneously, allowing the concoction of multiple ingredients without conflict. The pills concocted within the furnace will gain traces of dragon qi, vastly increasing potency. The furnace suppresses unstable medicinal energy, drastically reducing pill explosion risks. It can absorb surrounding fire qi, reducing the user’s qi consumption. High-tier pills refined inside have increased chances of surviving heavenly pill lightning."
"Pill lightning?" Zhang Fei was confused by it because he had never faced it since he became an alchemist.

Feng Yao nodded. "Not all pills will produce heavenly pill lightning when we concoct them. However, you will encounter heavenly pill lightning if you concoct those ancient pills, and each pill will produce pill lightning of varying strength."
"Ancient pills? Are they different from all my pills so far?"

"Honestly, the effects of your pills are beneficial, but they are not ancient pills. Xuanyuan Yue has probably improved the quality of your alchemy recipes, so your pills have effects that are as powerful as the ancient pills." Feng Yao opened her palm, and a pill recipe appeared on it. "This Lotus Rebirth Pill is one of the ancient pills, and it doesn’t exist in the Paradise Realm."
"What are the benefits of this pill?"

"The Lotus Rebirth Pill is a regeneration pill containing extremely pure qi, life essence, and vitality. It is beneficial for restoring the body, repairing cultivation damage, and revitalizing weakened cultivators. Its combination of healing, recovery, and rebirth makes it one of the most valuable survival pills." Zhang Fei’s eyes lit up, and he wanted to try concocting the pill. "Unfortunately, you can’t concoct this pill because some of the ingredients are difficult to find, and you’ll have to search all the domains in this Ancient Realm to find them. However, I don’t recommend you do that now, especially since the situation here is unsafe with the appearance of those shadowy creatures."

Zhang Fei sighed as he realized their situation. Feng Yao immediately touched his forehead, imparting many alchemy recipes into his mind. He pulled her into his embrace and kissed her. "No matter how hard I try, I feel like I’ll never be able to surpass you, Yao’er."
"Not really." Feng Yao shook his head slightly. "If there’s a living being in this universe who has the ability to surpass me in many areas, then you are the only one."
"Is that so?"
"Yes."
Zhang Fei smiled to himself, seeing the seriousness on Feng Yao’s face. "So, how are we going to take this furnace away from this place?"
"Open the portal to your training space first, and I’ll move this furnace inside."

As soon as Zhang Fei opened the portal, Feng Yao immediately moved the furnace inside. "Are there still interesting places in this domain? If nothing else, I want to go to the Frozen Yin Domain as soon as possible."

chapters.title: Chapter 1716: Puyang Clan Re-Visit
paragraphs: Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang were shocked and amazed after Zhang Fei [5] explained many things to them about the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, including all areas in that domain. "Have you two ever encountered those pill lightnings while concocting pills in the past?"
"Pill lightnings?"

Zhang Fei [5] explained to them about the pill lightnings based on Feng Yao’s previous explanation. "According to her, our pills are only mortal pills, and they are different from her Lotus Rebirth Pill, which is an ancient pill. I wanted to try concocting that pill, but she said that the ingredients are extremely rare, and they are only available in the Ancient Realm. Unfortunately, the situation there is dangerous due to the appearance of those creatures, and they seem to be targeting me, so I haven’t dared to go to the various domains there yet."
"Are those shadowy creatures targeting you because you are Hu Tianlang’s sole heir?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] sighed. "Unfortunately, I didn’t find any pill recipes there, but I’m sure Feng Yao should have many ancient pill recipes, so I’ll ask her for them in the future."

As god-rank alchemists, Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang were also impatient to study and concoct those ancient pill recipes, but they could only be patient as the situation did not allow them to do so.
Zhang Fei [5] suddenly had an idea. "What do you two think if I move this sect to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley?"
"The two of us don’t know anything about that place yet, so I can’t give you an opinion about it." Lin Jingxia said.
Tian Shuixiang said to him. "Please explain to us the details of the situation in that domain first, including the useful places there."

Zhang Fei [5] created several qi screens that displayed various locations in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and he provided explanations about those places, including the Yin-Yang Spirit River and the Dragon Phoenix Union Array.

Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang were shocked again after hearing about the benefits of the Yin-Yang Spirit River and the Dragon-Phoenix Union Array. The Twin Flames Domain possessed the Celestial Yang Lake, the Celestial Yin Lake, and the Yin-Yang River, but they felt that the benefits of these three places were incomparable to those two. However, those two places were only beneficial to dual cultivators, while the three places in their domain were beneficial to everyone.
"Zhang Fei, I think—"

"I plan to connect this domain with the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley in the future." Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang exchanged confused glances, unsure whether Zhang Fei [5] could do that since the two domains were in two different realms. "I can connect the two places using my gate ability, but it’s not convenient, so I want to think of another way to connect them."
"Please take us to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley."
"Alright."
Soon, the three of them arrived at the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley.

Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang tried to absorb the qi in the domain, and their expressions turned excited after they experienced the quality and quantity of qi there, which they felt was much stronger than in the Zenith Solar Sanctum.
"What do you two think of this domain?"
"Incredible!" Tian Shuixiang shouted. "If you move the sect to this domain, I’m sure all the disciples will experience rapid improvements in their cultivation!"

Lin Jingxia nodded in agreement. "Given the quality and quantity of qi in this domain, I believe the absence of the Celestial Yang Lake and the Celestial Yin Lake is not a significant issue. All cultivators can cultivate faster, and those dual cultivators can cultivate even faster with the help of the Yin-Yang Spirit River and the Dragon-Phoenix Union Array."

"The main issue is the destruction of all areas in this domain, which also lacks any barriers. Not to mention, the portal to this domain frequently appears in other domains, including the Paradise Realm, allowing other cultivators to invade this domain." Tian Shuixiang expressed his opinion.

"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] softly laughed. "You don’t need to worry about that portal, and I’m sure it will disappear on its own once we occupy this domain. As for the barriers, I have several formation arrays, and we also have Liao Hanxue and her Liao Clansmen, so I’m confident that we can create formidable barriers in this domain. Besides, the population in the Ancient Realm is not as large as in the Paradise Realm, and the distance between each domain here is also not as close as you two previously thought."
"Then-"

"Wait a minute." Zhang Fei [5] disappeared into the gate, but he returned a few minutes later with Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling. He explained his future plans to the two women, surprising and thrilling them. "What do you guys think about my plans? After all, you two are the sect master and vice sect master of our sect, right?"
Qing Qiu’er shook her head. "Although Feiling and I still hold the positions of sect master and vice sect master of our sect, everyone already considers you our leader, husband."
"They must think the same as us, husband." You Feiling pointed at Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang.
Lin Jingxia and Tian Shuixiang nodded slightly. "You were the one who brought us all together in our sect, so you are our leader."
"Not just the two of us, but we’re sure everyone else thinks the same as us."

Zhang Fei [5] laughed wryly because he never thought of being their leader, and he gathered them in the sect and helped them in many ways also for his own personal interests, but everyone actually considered him as their leader. "Since you guys think like that, I decided to move our sect to this domain in the future. For now, the situation in the Ancient Realm is extremely dangerous with the presence of those creatures, and they can destroy a domain too easily, so I don’t want to start rebuilding it too early. Once Feng Yao and I find a way to get rid of them, I will bring everyone here, and we will work together to rebuild everything."
"I think that’s for the best."
After they discussed some matters, Zhang Fei [5] brought them back to the Moonlit Passion Temple.

Qing Qiu’er and You Feiling left to take care of some matters. Tian Shuixiang and Lin Jingxia returned to the Alchemy Hall, but they couldn’t use the Nine Dragon Alchemy Furnace yet because they weren’t enough, and all of Zhang Fei [5]’s wives were still in the tower.

After that, Zhang Fei [5] went to meet Liao Hanxue and several others to discuss moving the sect to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley. He didn’t take them to the domain, but he showed them pictures of all the areas within it while explaining everything.
"Does that mean you’re going to move everyone in this domain there?" Liao Hanxue asked.
"No." Zhang Fei [5]’s answer confused them. "That domain isn’t as big as this one, so I’ll leave the natives of this domain here, and I’ll only bring those I brought here."

Liao Hanxue understood Zhang Fei [5]’s intention, which meant he would also bring her Liao Clan to the domain. After all, her clan was native to the Sky Pillar Domain, and she opened a branch clan in the Twin Flames Domain at his request. "Even though your plans are still far in the future, I think I should prepare a few things from now on, especially those protective barriers. Besides, you should also talk to Qiao Yisheng and the others about this matter so they can prepare the members from now on."

"I’ll go see them after this." Zhang Fei [5] thought for a moment. "Hey, I think I’ll take you to the Puyang Clan, and you can ask them about those protective barriers. Their clan has such a formidable barrier, and those creatures can’t penetrate it. If you learn from them, you can create a much stronger protective barrier for our domain."
Liao Hanxue’s eyes lit up after she heard that. "When are we going to the Puyang Clan?"
"Hey, kid! We’ll come with you two!" Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Cheng Gaoji, who had been listening to them all this time, finally spoke.
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] immediately opened the gate. "Let’s go to the Puyang Clan now."
"Wow! This clan is truly huge! Its barrier is truly powerful!" Liao Hanxue exclaimed as soon as they arrived at the Puyang Clan, her eyes scanning the barrier above them.
Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Cheng Gaoji agreed with him.
The four of them suddenly felt a powerful aura shooting toward them, causing them to palpitate and feel pressured.

Soon, Puyang Zong arrived before them. He frowned when he saw Liao Hanxue, Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Cheng Gaoji. However, his gaze fell on Zhang Fei [5]. "Oh? I didn’t expect you to come to our clan again so soon, Kid."
"Hahaha," Zhang Fei [5] cupped his hand. "Please forgive us for coming uninvited, Senior."

Puyang Zong waved his hands. "Kid, you are Senior Feng’s husband, and she is our savior. Besides, you’ve already given me so many precious pills, so there’s no need to be so formal. So, who are these four? What can I do for you all?"

"Liao Hanxue is the array master of my sect, and I brought her here to learn about formation arrays." Liao Hanxue respectfully greeted Puyang Zong. "Ji Changlan is a supreme-rank blacksmith. Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji are supreme-rank artifact crafters."

Puyang Zong nodded in understanding, but he didn’t expect Zhang Fei [5] to have so many experts by his side. "If Little Hanxue wants to learn about formation arrays, I can bring her to see Puyang Taichu and Puyang Zhiren. As for blacksmithing, we don’t have any experts in that field, but Puyang Shaodi and Puyang Linze are quite skilled at artifact crafting."

chapters.title: Chapter 1717: Meeting Puyang Yeyu Again
paragraphs: "Is your sister still in the sacred ground, Senior?"
Puyang Zong looked at Zhang Fei [5] with conflicted feelings. He had heard from Puyang Shenmi that the young man before him was interested in his sister, Puyang Yeyu.

Puyang Zong was happy to hear that there was a man interested in his sister because Puyang Yeyu was no longer young, but the problem was that Zhang Fei [5] was too young to marry her, and he was even much younger than his grandson.
’Whatever will happen, let it happen.’ Puyang Zong shook his head at Zhang Fei [5]. "My sister has fully recovered, and she has returned to her private room since last week."
"Where is her private room, Senior?"
Puyang Zong pointed west. "If you go to that area, you will meet a small house on the side of the pond, and my sister lives there. Anyways, you should stop addressing me as your senior, kid."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed awkwardly. "I will address you as my big brother then."
"That’s good." Puyang Zhong led Liao Hanxue, Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Cheng Gaoji to go meet the four people he mentioned earlier.

Since they had lived in the Moonlit Passion Temple for so many years, Liao Hanxue, Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Cheng Gaoji could immediately guess Zhang Fei [5]’s relationship with Puyang Zong’s sister. ’That kid is truly unbelievable! He also has a woman in this Ancient Realm.’
When he arrived at the small houses by the pond, Zhang Fei [5] saw Puyang Yeyu watering the colorful flowers by the pond using water from the pond. "Yeyu."
"Eh?" Puyang Yeyu froze for a moment before turning to Zhang Fei [5]. Although she was surprised by his sudden arrival, she wore a beautiful smile on her young face. "You came at last."

Since they parted almost two months ago, Zhang Fei [5] always brought Puyang Yeyu to the dream space whenever he had spare time. They spent quite a lot of time together there, which made their relationship even closer than the first time he brought her there.
Zhang Fei [5] walked in front of Puyang Yeyu, took her hand, and checked her condition.
Puyang Yeyu did not reject Zhang Fei [5] and allowed him to confirm that her condition had fully recovered. "How is the result?"
"All is well." Zhang Fei [5] pulled Puyang Yeyu to the terrace of the small house and sat down side by side. "Why did you leave the sacred ground? Wouldn’t it be better if you cultivated there?"

Puyang Yeyu shook her head and explained, "You’re not wrong about that, but my clan has its own rules, and only the injured can cultivate in the sacred ground. Where is your original body now? Are you still the Zenith Solar Sanctum?"

"My original body just left the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and he is on his way to the Frozen Yin Domain." Puyang Yeyu froze after Zhang Fei [5] said that, and her eyes widened in shock. As a native of the Ancient Realm, she naturally knew about the situation in that domain, and the Yin Demon Race controlled almost the entire area there. "You don’t have to worry about my safety, okay? Although my cultivation is still at the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, I’m not as weak as you think. Besides, I’m not going to that domain alone, but Feng Yao and Huo Ling are accompanying me, so I’ll definitely be fine there."
Puyang Yeyu breathed a sigh of relief. "Since Senior Feng and Senior Huo accompanied you to that domain, I believe you’ll be safe there. But why did you have to go to that domain?"
"I want to use the Yin Demon to improve my cultivation, and I want to meet someone there."
"Is that person a woman?"
"Are you jealous?"
Puyang Yeyu shook her head. "Only a foolish woman would be jealous of a man with over a hundred wives."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly. "That woman is Yuan Xiajie of the Ancient Nether Clan; she—"
"What? Is that woman really a member of the Ancient Nether Clan?" Puyang Yeyu asked in shock. "As far as I remember, that clan was destroyed long ago, and all its members died that day."

Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her. "The Ancient Nether Clan was destroyed long ago, and all its members were killed by the Nightmare Lord, Meng Zhou. However, Yuan Xiajie was not in her clan during the bloody incident that day, so she survived the bloody massacre."
"I see." Puyang Yeyu nodded in understanding. "Why are you looking for Yuan Xiajie?"

"Yuan Xiajie left a deep fear in my heart, so I must meet her to dispel my fear of her." Puyang Yeyu frowned deeply after she said that, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately recounted the events that happened between them in the past. "Besides that, I want to snatch the Nine Yin Soul Banner from her, and I need that artifact to do something important."

"The Nine Yin Soul Banner?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded and told Puyang Yeyu about the ancient artifact based on Feng Yichen’s story in the past. "If I remember correctly, the creator of that artifact was not a demon cultivator from the Paradise Realm but from this Ancient Realm, and the artifact once belonged to the Mo Clan from the Myriad Abyss Domain." (A/N: Chapter 857: Two Ancient Items.)
"The Mo Clan from the Myriad Abyss Domain?"
Puyang Yeyu nodded slightly. "The Myriad Abyss Domain is the most dangerous domain in this Ancient Realm, and there are many demon gods living there."
"Oh? How many demon gods are there?"

"Twenty or fifty, maybe?" Zhang Fei [5] choked hard. "I don’t know the exact number, but you don’t have to be surprised by their numbers. After all, this Ancient Realm is different from the Paradise Realm, and those demon gods are like cabbages here."
Zhang Fei [5] sighed. "I myself still have a hard time facing the demon gods in the Paradise Realm, but there are far more demon gods in this realm."

"Hehe," Puyang Yeyu laughed softly. "Since you’re a lust demon yourself, I think you won’t have any problems going to the Myriad Abyss Domain. If you go there, you might be able to find the demon items to upgrade your demon wives’ demon ranks."

Zhang Fei [5]’s eyes lit up upon hearing that because he had quite a number of demon wives, and their demon rank was still stuck at the Empress Rank. He had already asked Wu Zu to look for those demon items, but she had a difficult time getting them. "I think I should go to that domain to look for those demon items so I can help all my demon wives to upgrade their demon rank to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks, but I will discuss this matter with Feng Yao and Huo Ling first."

"Since they are both your wives, and they are much stronger than you, you can ask for their help in that matter." Then, Puyang Yeyu asked him. "What brings you to my clan today? You didn’t come here just to see me, did you?"

"I brought four people with me, and I want them to learn from your clan members." Zhang Fei [5] told Puyang Yeyu about Liao Hanxue and the three men. "I plan to rebuild the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and I will move my sect and all my close friends to that domain in the future. However, that domain doesn’t have any powerful barriers yet, and Liao Hanxue is the best array master I know."

"The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley." Puyang Yeyu murmured and nodded. "I’ve been to that domain in the past, but I didn’t have time to go to all the places, and I only went to the Yin-Yang Spirit River. Unfortunately, I didn’t have a lover, let alone a husband, so my adventures in that domain ended in vain."

"Do you want to go to that domain with me?" Puyang Yeyu was stunned before lowering her head, not knowing what to reply to Zhang Fei [5]. Although their relationship had significantly improved after spending a considerable amount of time together in the dream space, and she felt comfortable with his presence, she still did not have romantic feelings for him. "Forget it, I will take you to that domain when you fall in love with me, and I will take you as my wife at that time."
"How can you be so confident that I will fall in love with you?"
"I’m just confident."
"Are you sure about that?"

"I’m sure you’ll fall in love with me someday." Puyang Yeyu fell silent, and Zhang Fei [5] held her hand, gently rubbing it. "Isn’t this an example? If you didn’t have any interest in me, you wouldn’t let me hold your hand like this, right?"
Puyang Yeyu’s cheeks reddened, but she did not withdraw her hand from Zhang Fei [5]’s grasp; instead, she enjoyed the action of rubbing her hand.
Zhang Fei [5] smiled seeing the blush on Puyang Yeyu’s cheeks. "Yeyu."
"Hmm?"
"Give me a chance to get into your heart, okay?"
Puyang Yeyu smiled faintly. "I’ll give you a chance, but you have to find the key to unlock my heart yourself."
"I will definitely find it, and then I will stay in your heart forever."
"Cheesy!"
While Zhang Fei [5] was enjoying his time with Puyang Yeyu, Liao Hanxue was seriously discussing with Puyang Taichu and Puyang Zhiren about formation arrays.

At first, Puyang Taichu and Puyang Zhiren didn’t want to teach Liao Hanxue because they felt it would just waste their time, but Puyang Zong told them that she was a good friend of Feng Yao’s husband. Moreover, they had already enjoyed the benefits of Zhang Fei [5]’s pills, so they decided to accept her presence.
