’Whatever will happen, let it happen.’ Puyang Zong shook his head at Zhang Fei [5].
"My sister has fully recovered, and she has returned to her private room since last week."
"Where is her private room, Senior?"
Puyang Zong pointed west.
"If you go to that area, you will meet a small house on the side of the pond, and my sister lives there.
Anyways, you should stop addressing me as your senior, kid."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed awkwardly.
"I will address you as my big brother then."
"That’s good." Puyang Zhong led Liao Hanxue, Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Cheng Gaoji to go meet the four people he mentioned earlier.

Since they had lived in the Moonlit Passion Temple for so many years, Liao Hanxue, Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Cheng Gaoji could immediately guess Zhang Fei [5]’s relationship with Puyang Zong’s sister. ’That kid is truly unbelievable!
He also has a woman in this Ancient Realm.’
When he arrived at the small houses by the pond, Zhang Fei [5] saw Puyang Yeyu watering the colorful flowers by the pond using water from the pond.
"Yeyu."
"Eh?" Puyang Yeyu froze for a moment before turning to Zhang Fei [5].
Although she was surprised by his sudden arrival, she wore a beautiful smile on her young face.
"You came at last."
Since they parted almost two months ago, Zhang Fei [5] always brought Puyang Yeyu to the dream space whenever he had spare time.
They spent quite a lot of time together there, which made their relationship even closer than the first time he brought her there.
Zhang Fei [5] walked in front of Puyang Yeyu, took her hand, and checked her condition.
Puyang Yeyu did not reject Zhang Fei [5] and allowed him to confirm that her condition had fully recovered.
"How is the result?"
"All is well." Zhang Fei [5] pulled Puyang Yeyu to the terrace of the small house and sat down side by side.
"Why did you leave the sacred ground?
Wouldn’t it be better if you cultivated there?"
Puyang Yeyu shook her head and explained, "You’re not wrong about that, but my clan has its own rules, and only the injured can cultivate in the sacred ground.
Where is your original body now?
Are you still the Zenith Solar Sanctum?"
"My original body just left the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and he is on his way to the Frozen Yin Domain." Puyang Yeyu froze after Zhang Fei [5] said that, and her eyes widened in shock.
As a native of the Ancient Realm, she naturally knew about the situation in that domain, and the Yin Demon Race controlled almost the entire area there.
"You don’t have to worry about my safety, okay?
Although my cultivation is still at the 1-Sun Celestial Emperor Realm, I’m not as weak as you think.
Besides, I’m not going to that domain alone, but Feng Yao and Huo Ling are accompanying me, so I’ll definitely be fine there."
Puyang Yeyu breathed a sigh of relief.
"Since Senior Feng and Senior Huo accompanied you to that domain, I believe you’ll be safe there.
But why did you have to go to that domain?"
"I want to use the Yin Demon to improve my cultivation, and I want to meet someone there."
"Is that person a woman?"
"Are you jealous?"
Puyang Yeyu shook her head.
"Only a foolish woman would be jealous of a man with over a hundred wives."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed softly.
"That woman is Yuan Xiajie of the Ancient Nether Clan; she—"
"What?
Is that woman really a member of the Ancient Nether Clan?" Puyang Yeyu asked in shock.
"As far as I remember, that clan was destroyed long ago, and all its members died that day."
Zhang Fei [5] nodded at her.
"The Ancient Nether Clan was destroyed long ago, and all its members were killed by the Nightmare Lord, Meng Zhou.
However, Yuan Xiajie was not in her clan during the bloody incident that day, so she survived the bloody massacre."
"I see." Puyang Yeyu nodded in understanding.
"Why are you looking for Yuan Xiajie?"

"Yuan Xiajie left a deep fear in my heart, so I must meet her to dispel my fear of her." Puyang Yeyu frowned deeply after she said that, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately recounted the events that happened between them in the past.
"Besides that, I want to snatch the Nine Yin Soul Banner from her, and I need that artifact to do something important."
"The Nine Yin Soul Banner?" Zhang Fei [5] nodded and told Puyang Yeyu about the ancient artifact based on Feng Yichen’s story in the past.

"If I remember correctly, the creator of that artifact was not a demon cultivator from the Paradise Realm but from this Ancient Realm, and the artifact once belonged to the Mo Clan from the Myriad Abyss Domain." (A/N: Chapter 857: Two Ancient Items.)
"The Mo Clan from the Myriad Abyss Domain?"
Puyang Yeyu nodded slightly.
"The Myriad Abyss Domain is the most dangerous domain in this Ancient Realm, and there are many demon gods living there."
"Oh?
How many demon gods are there?"
"Twenty or fifty, maybe?" Zhang Fei [5] choked hard.
"I don’t know the exact number, but you don’t have to be surprised by their numbers.
After all, this Ancient Realm is different from the Paradise Realm, and those demon gods are like cabbages here."
Zhang Fei [5] sighed.
"I myself still have a hard time facing the demon gods in the Paradise Realm, but there are far more demon gods in this realm."
"Hehe," Puyang Yeyu laughed softly.
"Since you’re a lust demon yourself, I think you won’t have any problems going to the Myriad Abyss Domain.
If you go there, you might be able to find the demon items to upgrade your demon wives’ demon ranks."
Zhang Fei [5]’s eyes lit up upon hearing that because he had quite a number of demon wives, and their demon rank was still stuck at the Empress Rank.
He had already asked Wu Zu to look for those demon items, but she had a difficult time getting them.

"I think I should go to that domain to look for those demon items so I can help all my demon wives to upgrade their demon rank to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks, but I will discuss this matter with Feng Yao and Huo Ling first."
"Since they are both your wives, and they are much stronger than you, you can ask for their help in that matter." Then, Puyang Yeyu asked him.
"What brings you to my clan today?
You didn’t come here just to see me, did you?"
"I brought four people with me, and I want them to learn from your clan members." Zhang Fei [5] told Puyang Yeyu about Liao Hanxue and the three men.
"I plan to rebuild the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and I will move my sect and all my close friends to that domain in the future.
However, that domain doesn’t have any powerful barriers yet, and Liao Hanxue is the best array master I know."
"The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley." Puyang Yeyu murmured and nodded.
"I’ve been to that domain in the past, but I didn’t have time to go to all the places, and I only went to the Yin-Yang Spirit River.
Unfortunately, I didn’t have a lover, let alone a husband, so my adventures in that domain ended in vain."
"Do you want to go to that domain with me?" Puyang Yeyu was stunned before lowering her head, not knowing what to reply to Zhang Fei [5].

Although their relationship had significantly improved after spending a considerable amount of time together in the dream space, and she felt comfortable with his presence, she still did not have romantic feelings for him.
"Forget it, I will take you to that domain when you fall in love with me, and I will take you as my wife at that time."
"How can you be so confident that I will fall in love with you?"
"I’m just confident."
"Are you sure about that?"
"I’m sure you’ll fall in love with me someday." Puyang Yeyu fell silent, and Zhang Fei [5] held her hand, gently rubbing it.
"Isn’t this an example?
If you didn’t have any interest in me, you wouldn’t let me hold your hand like this, right?"
Puyang Yeyu’s cheeks reddened, but she did not withdraw her hand from Zhang Fei [5]’s grasp; instead, she enjoyed the action of rubbing her hand.
Zhang Fei [5] smiled seeing the blush on Puyang Yeyu’s cheeks.
"Yeyu."
"Hmm?"
"Give me a chance to get into your heart, okay?"
Puyang Yeyu smiled faintly.
"I’ll give you a chance, but you have to find the key to unlock my heart yourself."
"I will definitely find it, and then I will stay in your heart forever."
"Cheesy!"
While Zhang Fei [5] was enjoying his time with Puyang Yeyu, Liao Hanxue was seriously discussing with Puyang Taichu and Puyang Zhiren about formation arrays.

At first, Puyang Taichu and Puyang Zhiren didn’t want to teach Liao Hanxue because they felt it would just waste their time, but Puyang Zong told them that she was a good friend of Feng Yao’s husband.
Moreover, they had already enjoyed the benefits of Zhang Fei [5]’s pills, so they decided to accept her presence.

chapters.title: Chapter 1718: Myriad Abyss Domain - Mo Qingwen
paragraphs: Just like Puyang Taichu and Puyang Zhiren, Puyang Shaodi and Puyang Linze were initially reluctant to accept Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji, but Puyang Zong managed to persuade them by mentioning Feng Yao’s name.
As for Ji Changlan, there were no blacksmith experts in the Puyang Clan, so he joined Gong Ren and Cheng Gaoji to learn new things, especially about artifact crafting.
After he sent the four people off, Puyang Zong went to his sister’s place. When he arrived there, he saw Zhang Fei [5] and Puyang Yeyu talking and joking with laughter.

Puyang Zong was delighted to see his sister laughing so happily, proving that Zhang Fei [5]’s presence brought happiness to Puyang Yeyu. He didn’t want to disturb their time, so he left the place and went somewhere else.
"Hey." Puyang Zong turned to Puyang Shangren. "Did that kid really come here?"
Puyang Zong nodded. "That kid was in my sister’s private residence, and she seemed pleased with his presence, so I didn’t disturb them.

Puyang Shangren directed his senses to Puyang Yeyu’s personal residence, and he found her delighted with Zhang Fei [5]’s presence, so he withdrew his senses immediately. "Hahaha! Looks like you’ll be getting a young brother-in-law soon, Zong."

"I can’t help it, right?" Puyang Zong replied helplessly. "That kid is much younger than us, but my sister clearly likes him, and she’s also comfortable around him. However, I believe that she won’t fall in love with him that easily, and I might still have to wait quite a while to see them get married."
"What exactly is the purpose of that kid coming to our clan today?"

"He brought four people with him." Puyang Zong explained to Puyang Sangren about Liao Hanxue and the other three men. "According to them, that kid wants to move his sect and those closest to him to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley in the future, so he brought them here to learn a few things, especially formation arrays."

"The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley." Puyang Shangren raised an eyebrow. "That domain was a paradise for dual cultivators, but it was destroyed long ago, and not everyone can enter its ruins without finding the portal."
"That kid has Senior Feng by his side, remember? She brought him to that domain before, and he can move realms easily."

Puyang Shangren sighed. "His ability as Hu Tianlang’s sole heir is indeed terrifying, especially his gate ability. No one can stop him from traveling to all domains, especially those he has already visited."
"I will meet our ancestor first."
"Alright."
As soon as he arrived at the sacred ground, Puyang Zong went to Puyang Shenmi and informed her of the arrival of Zhang Fei [5] and the four people, slightly surprising her. "Is he with Yeyu now?"
"Yes, Ancestor."

Puyang Shenmi nodded slightly. "Although Yeyu doesn’t want to admit it, I can see that she likes him, and I believe she will be his wife in the future. He is much younger than her, but I think she will be happy with him."
"Are you sure about that, Ancestor?"

"Didn’t you see for yourself that Senior Feng was happy with him some time ago?" Puyang Zong smiled wryly. "If a woman as great and powerful as Senior Feng is happy with him, I’m sure Yeyu will be happy with him too. It’s just that she still has a lot on her mind about the number of his wives, and she’s still having a difficult time accepting that, so I’m sure it will still take them quite some time to become a couple."
Puyang Zong sighed. "Among all our generation, my sister is the only one who hasn’t found her soulmate, so I hope she will find one soon."
"Yeyu’s future is clear, and she will be his wife when the time comes. At that time, our clan must hold a grand feast for their wedding, and I am confident that he will bring our clan prosperity."
"I hope so, Ancestor."

After Puyang Zong left, Puyang Shenmi waved her hand, and a qi ball appeared in front of her. A few seconds later, Zhang Fei [5] and Puyang Yeyu appeared inside the qi ball. "I’m happy for you, Yeyu. I believe you have found your happiness, and time will make it happen for you."
Puyang Shenmi waved her hand again, and the qi ball revealed Liao Hanxue, Ji Changlan, Gong Ren, and Cheng Gaoji, who looked serious about learning formation arrays and artifact forging.

"The abilities of those people by that kid’s side are truly no joke, and they possess excellent abilities in their fields. A rank-10 array master, a supreme-rank blacksmith, and two supreme-rank artifact crafters. I’m sure those four are just a small part of the people by his side, and he still has many others who excel in various different fields." Puyang Shenmi thought about Puyang Zong’s previous words, especially about Zhang Fei [5]’s wish to move his sect and his closest people to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley. "If he becomes part of my Puyang Clan, this clan will also prosper in the future."

Inside the void, Zhu Shanniang had already fallen asleep from exhaustion after dual cultivating with Zhang Fei for so long. He couldn’t hold himself back, mainly because he hadn’t seen the female vermilion bird for almost six years.
Zhang Fei turned to Feng Yao, pulled her onto his lap, and informed her of several matters.

Feng Yao wasn’t surprised by any of this, and she had guessed from the start that Zhang Fei would make such a decision. "I think you made the right decision by bringing those four into the Puyang Clan, and their abilities in their respective fields will improve even more."
"Yes," Zhang Fei agreed with that. "Yao’er, I have decided to go to the Myriad Abyss Domain, and I will leave there after we return from the Frozen Yin Domain."
"Do you want to look for those demon materials in that domain?"

Zhang Fei nodded. "I have many demon wives, and their demon ranks have been stuck at the Empress Rank for so long. Moreover, Wu Zu is having trouble finding the other materials, so I decided to go to that domain to look for them, and all my demon wives will be able to upgrade their ranks to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks."

"I think it’s fine if you want to do that." Feng Yao created a qi screen that displayed the situation in the Myriad Abyss Domain. "That domain is more similar to the Netherworld Realm, husband. There are dozens of demon gods there, but there is only one leader there. If I remember correctly, their leader is Mo Qingwen, and he is the strongest among them. If you think that Mo Shentian is strong, I can say that he is nothing compared to him."
"Is Mo Qingwen really that powerful?"

Feng Yao waved her hand, and the image on the qi screen changed to a male demon. "People in the Ancient Realm gave Mo Qingwen the nickname the Absolute Supreme Demon God because of his peerless strength, and he could kill all the demon gods from the Paradise Realm with a snap of his fingers."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei was a little shocked by that. "Do you have any detailed information about Mo Qingwen’s abilities?"

Feng Yao shook her head. "I’ve heard of him, but I’ve never met him in person because I was too lazy to go to the Myriad Abyss Domain in the past. However, you don’t need to worry about him because he’s not as ambitious as Mo Shentian, and he has a fairly wise and , so you won’t have any problems with him directly. However, you have to be careful of the other demon gods under him because some of them are far more arrogant than Mo Shentian, and they won’t hesitate to kill you."
"If they dare to attack our husband, I will burn their bodies to ashes, and I will also destroy their souls so that they cannot be reincarnated again." Huo Ling said decisively.
"Haha," Feng Yao laughed out loud at that. "Ever since she became your wife, Ling’er has changed completely, and she wants to spoil you all the time."
Zhang Fei looked at Huo Ling and nodded. "Ling’er is much cuter like this than the grumpy her in the past. Look at her; she can be blushing and shy now."
"Humph." Huo Ling softly snorted. "Husband, you should dual cultivate with my master now, and I will dual cultivate with you after."
"Impatient, aren’t you?" Zhang Fei didn’t tease Huo Ling anymore, and he began to dual cultivate while dual soul cultivating with Feng Yao.

Since his fifth clone was in the Puyang Clan, Zhang Fei [4] picked up Mo Zainan in the Endless Domain before bringing him back to the training space. "Have you had enough of reuniting with Mo Tiansher for two weeks?"
"Hehe," Mo Zainan laughed softly as she nodded. "I haven’t seen him in hundreds of thousands of years, so I have a lot to share with him. What about the situation in the Celestial Domain?"
"Do you miss your domain?"
"A bit," Mo Zainan sighed. "After all, I’m a Celestial Demon, and I haven’t been away from my domain for this long, so I miss my home domain."

Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding. "I wanted to take you back there, but the situation there is uncertain right now, and your husband seems to have gone mad after being imprisoned in the tunnel for so many years."

"That’s true." Mo Zainan’s expression turned grim. "He continued to dual cultivate with my doll for the past two weeks, and he also dual cultivated with the others nonstop. Besides, his eyes looked strange, and I felt that something was controlling him. Could it be because of his dual cultivation technique?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1719: Explain To Mo Zainan
paragraphs: "Yes," Zhang Fei [4] nodded at Mo Zainan. "I’ve obtained your husband’s dual cultivation technique, and it’s called the Yin Sacrifice Art."
"The Yin Sacrifice Art? How did you find out about it? Where did you get it?" Mo Zainan asked in a suspicious tone.

Zhang Fei [4] touched Mo Zainan’s forehead, sharing a few things with her. "That place is the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, which is one of the domains in the Ancient Realm. That domain was a paradise for dual cultivators, but it was destroyed by a past disaster. Mo Shentian accidentally discovered the portal that took him there, and he found the technique there."

Mo Zainan remembered that Mo Shentian had mentioned something about the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley to her doll, but he hadn’t mentioned the name of the technique. At first, he hadn’t wanted to learn the technique because he was afraid it would affect him, but he changed his mind after being imprisoned in the tunnel for so many years. Since then, his character began to change, and he began dual cultivating with their two daughters’ doll and several other women. "Why did you only show me the name of the technique?"
"The Yin Sacrifice Art is an evil dual cultivation technique, okay? That’s why I burned the original manuscript so no one can learn that technique in the future."
Mo Zainan nodded in understanding. "Did you find other techniques in that place?"

"The Yang Sacrifice Art." Mo Zainan raised an eyebrow. "If the Yin Sacrifice Art is used by male cultivators to transform a woman’s body into a cultivation furnace, then the Yang Sacrifice Art is the opposite, and it’s used by female cultivators to transform a man’s body into a cultivation furnace."
"Anything else?"

"Besides those two evil techniques, I also discovered many other techniques, such as the Taiji Formation Array, the Yin-Yang Suppression Art, and many more." Zhang Fei [4] explained to Mo Zainan about the two techniques. "As for the rest of those techniques, I haven’t read them yet, but I’ve taken all the techniques there, and I’ll keep them in my sect."

Mo Zainan naturally remembered that Zhang Fei [4] was the mastermind behind the transformation of the Moonlit Passion Temple. "Why do you think that dual cultivators are willing to dual cultivate in front of others?"
"Isn’t that right? The majority of dual cultivators are shameless people, and they don’t care if their activities are seen by others."

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed at that. "Well? You’re not wrong about that. However, I’m different from them, and I will never allow other men to see my wives naked. If they dare peep at my wives, I’ll gouge out their eyes. My wives’ bodies are my private property, and I’m the only man who has the right to enjoy the beauty of their bodies."
"Why are you so shameless?"
"Why should I feel embarrassed about it?"
"I give up." Puyang Yeyu shook her head. "So, what are your plans for this river?"
Zhang Fei [5] thought mischievously. "I plan to set up some formations on this river so they can’t peek at each other during their dual cultivation sessions."
"What formations?"
"I plan to set up a separation formation and a disguise formation."
"A disguise formation?"

Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "When the formation is activated, their area will be covered by a mist impenetrable to their senses, so they won’t be able to peek at each other. If I don’t set up such a formation, only dual cultivators can utilize this river, and the situation in this domain will become unbalanced in the future."
"I think that’s a good idea," Puyang Yeyu agreed. "If you set up a formation like that on this river, they won’t have to worry about other people peeping on them."

sentences.text: "Do you have any important matters in your clan?"
Puyang Yeyu lifted her head slightly.
"All the clan’s affairs are handled by my brother and the others, and I only move when they need me, so I have a lot of free time."
"Why do I feel like you’re the princess of the Puyang Clan?"
Puyang Yeyu simply smiled.
"Do you want to take me somewhere else?"
"I plan to clear the debris in the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, and I’d like to take you there to spend some time together."
"Did those creatures really not invade that domain?"
"No."
Puyang Yeyu hurriedly sat down and sent a voice transmission to Puyang Zong.
"My brother said I can go with you, so we will go to that domain now."
"Let’s go."
Puyang Yeyu shook her head after they exited the gate.
The distance between her home domain and The Yin-Yang Immortal Valley was simply too far, but they arrived there in a matter of seconds thanks to Zhang Fei [5]’s gate.
"Does this mean you can go to all domains from the Three Mortal Realms to the Ancient Realm?"
"I can go to all the domains I’ve been to before." Zhang Fei [5] closed the gate and looked around the surrounding areas.
"At first, I wanted to clean up this domain after I defeated those creatures, but I have nothing else to do right now, so I’ll start cleaning up the debris today."
Puyang Yeyu thought for a moment.
"Even though this domain isn’t that large, it will take a long time for the two of us to clear everything, so I think you should bring other people here."
"One of my clones will talk to the natural races in my sect about this matter, and he will send them to this domain soon." Zhang Fei [5] brought Puyang Yeyu to the Dragon Phoenix Union Array.
"This place has the Dragon Phoenix Union Array, and it is one of the best places in this domain besides the Yin-Yang Spirit River."
"Dragon and phoenix," Puyang Yeyu muttered to himself.
"Does that mean the formation is specifically for dual cultivation?"
Zhang Fei [5] nodded.
"I’ve tried dual cultivating with Yao’er here, and the number of her Yin Qi has increased tenfold."
"Tenfold?" Puyang Yeyu was shocked.
"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] looked towards the distance where the gate was open.
"They’re here."
Puyang Yeyu also looked in that direction, finding people from the natural races walking out of the gate.
Since Zhang Fei’s other clone had already given them instructions beforehand, they immediately spread out to various areas of the domain and began clearing the debris there.
Soon, Ju Jushen, Lu Wangyi, and Jia Leixuan appeared before them.
They looked at Puyang Yeyu, who was standing quietly by Zhang Fei [5]’s side.
Even though their cultivation was at the same level, they could feel that the woman in front of them was still stronger than them.
Zhang Fei [5] chuckled at their reactions.
"Her name is Puyang Yeyu, and she is a member of the Puyang Clan."
"The Puyang Clan," Jia Leixuan muttered softly.
"I’ve met a member of the Puyang Clan in the Forbidden Land in the past, and if I remember correctly, his name was Puyang Zong."
"Puyang Zong is my brother," Puyang Yeyu said with a smile.
"Ah!" Jia Leixuan cupped his hand to Puyang Yeyu.
"I’m pleased to meet you, Senior!
If it weren’t for the healing pill I bought from Senior Zong back then, I would have died long ago because my injuries were too severe, and no healer in the Paradise Realm could cure me."
Puyang Yeyu shook her head.

"The population in the Ancient Realm has decreased significantly compared to the past, so the remaining clans in this realm agreed to descend to the Paradise Realm and sell items that might be useful to cultivators there."
"I see." Jia Leixuan nodded in understanding.
"Is this senior your wife, Zhang Fei?" Lu Wangyi asked.
Puyang Yeyu wanted to deny Lu Wangyi’s question, but Zhang Fei [5] spoke to the woman first.
"She’s not my wife yet, but she will be one in the future."
"Hahaha," Lu Wangyi softly laughed, noticing the blush on Puyang Yeyu’s cheeks.
"I still find it hard to believe that you have gone to this Ancient Realm, and you also got a beautiful future wife."
Puyang Yeyu felt embarrassed after Lu Wangyi said that, but she no longer intended to refute her words.
Even though she had not accepted Zhang Fei [5], the relationship between them was clearly more than senior and junior.
Ju Jushen looked at Zhang Fei [5].
"Are you serious about bringing all the natural races to this domain?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] replied with a nod.
"You three should be able to sense the strength and quantity of qi in this domain, right?
I don’t have any plans to bring all the people from the Twin Flames Domain here, but I do plan to bring all the natural races here.
I brought my people here to clear this domain of debris, but I won’t be moving them anytime soon because those creatures could appear at any moment."
Ju Jushen and the other two nodded in understanding of Zhang Fei [5]’s worries.
They themselves were still worried that those creatures would suddenly invade the Paradise Realm, and they didn’t have enough strength to defeat them.
"For now, I want them to clear out all the areas in this domain, and we will gradually rebuild it.
Once I find a solution to rid them of those creatures, I will bring them all to this domain, and they will be able to cultivate much faster."

"This entire area is a formation array, and this stone platform is the key."

chapters.title: Chapter 1723: A Month Later
paragraphs: After Zhang Fei [5] took Puyang Yeyu to see the entire Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, he brought her back to the Puyang Clan. "Are you leaving now?"
"No," Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "As I said before, I don’t have much business in the Paradise Realm right now, and I want to take you somewhere else."
"Where are you taking me away?"

"My private training space." Puyang Yeyu was curious about this because Zhang Fei [5]’s growth as a cultivator was too frightening, and she was truly curious about how he had improved his abilities. As for his cultivation speed, she was no longer surprised by it because he had already told her the identities of his over one hundred wives. "Actually, I wanted to take you there after you agreed to become my woman, but I changed my mind about that. If you train there for a few years, you might become the strongest in your clan, surpassing Ancestor Shenmi."
"Can I really surpass my grandmother?" Puyang Yeyu asked doubtfully.
"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] nodded seriously. "You might not be able to surpass her in cultivation, but you will surpass her in other areas."
Puyang Yeyu thought for a moment before contacting her brother and others. "Let’s go now."
"Let’s go."

Puyang Yeyu was shocked when Zhang Fei [5] brought her into the training space. In her entire life, she had never heard of a cultivator who had such a private space, but she was a little confused to find the place empty. She looked at the pavilion. "Do all your wives live there?"

"They usually stay in my sect, but I bring them here every time we go into seclusion." Zhang Fei [5] explained to Puyang Yeyu about the function of the device in the middle of the training space, but he did not tell her about its origin. "Let’s go."

Puyang Yeyu couldn’t wait to train in the training space, but she was also curious about the pavilion, so she let Zhang Fei [5] lead her inside. She froze as soon as they arrived inside, and her face turned beet red after she heard a woman’s loud moans. "Who is that woman?"

"Mo Zainan is dual cultivating with my third clone." Zhang Fei [5] informed Puyang Yeyu about the identity of the female demon, which shocked her. "Her ex-husband went crazy after he was imprisoned for years in the tunnel connecting the Paradise Realm and the Three Mortal Realms, and he used the Yin Sacrifice Art belonging to the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley on female demons in his domain, including his two daughters."

As a cultivator from the Ancient Realm, Puyang Yeyu had heard of the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yang Sacrifice Art. She knew that both techniques were evil dual cultivation techniques, but she never expected that one of them would fall into the hands of a demon from the Paradise Realm and he would use it on his two daughters. "No wonder his wife chose to leave him!"
"You’re wrong about that, Yeyu."

"Hmm? What do you mean by that?" Zhang Fei [5] explained to Puyang Yeyu about the triangular relationship between Mo Shentian, Mo Tianshen, and Mo Zainan. "So, what you’re saying is that her husband never loved her, and he only needed her as his tool, right?"

"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] took Puyang Yeyu around inside the pavilion, and he also showed her the Celestial Spring Pool. Seeing that she was curious about the poll, he asked her. "Do you want to try soaking in it?"

Puyang Yeyu was tempted to try the Celestial Spring Pool, but she felt awkward about soaking with Zhang Fei [5]. After all, their relationship wasn’t official yet, and she hadn’t really fallen in love with him, so she didn’t want to be naked in front of him.

"You can try soaking in it, and I’ll go to the alchemy room to concoct some pills." Puyang Yeyu was surprised by Zhang Fei [5]’s decision, and she had previously thought that he wanted to soak with her. "As I told you when I brought you to the dream some time ago, I will never touch you or force you before you are ready, and I will wait until you are ready to be my wife."
"Thank you."
"No need." Zhang Fei [5] quickly disappeared from Puyang Yeyu’s sight.

After removing her dress, Puyang Yeyu hurriedly entered the Celestial Spring Pool. Although she couldn’t yet feel the pool’s effects for dual cultivation, she could sense that it was no ordinary pool. "Where exactly did he get all this from? The training space’s timeflow is four times faster than the outside world, and he also installed several formations here. With the help of all the facilities in this place, I am confident that I can surpass my grandmother in some ways, and I will give her a surprise in the future."
Puyang Yeyu didn’t spend too long soaking in the Celestial Spring Pool, and she went to the training ground to practice after she was satisfied with it.

Several days passed quickly in the training space, and Mo Zainan had already finished dual cultivation with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. After that, she immediately went to the training ground to practice, but she was surprised to find Puyang Yeyu there.

Since Puyang Yeyu was busy with her training, Mo Zainan didn’t disturb her, and she started her own training in another area. She had already become one of Zhang Fei’s wives, and some of his wives were stronger than her, such as Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran, so she wanted to catch up with them.

In the Celestial Domain, Mo Shentian was furious because his cultivation progress wasn’t as fast as he had expected, even though he had used many female demons to help him, including his fake daughters and daughters-in-law.
Unfortunately, Mo Shentian still didn’t realize that Mo Zainan, Mo Anqi, Mo Yousha, and Shang Xueli, who were with him, were just artificial dolls.
"What should I do to improve my cultivation faster?"

Mo Shentian thought of many ways, but he couldn’t come up with any ideas. At first, he truly believed that his cultivation would improve much faster if he used the Yin Sacrifice Art, but the results were the opposite of his expectations.

Mo Shentian wanted to contact his three sons to inquire about their location, but he remembered that the journey to the Endless Domain took two months from their domain, and they had only departed a month ago, so he would have to wait another month for them to arrive there.
Mo Shentian decided to get dressed, leave his seclusion, and summon his five trusted demons. One of them informed him that Qi Qingxiu’s domain was very close to Wu Mian’s domain.

"Qi Qingxiu, huh?" Mo Shentian muttered to himself. "She’s a demon god like me, so she’s much stronger than those useless female demons. If I can get her and use that technique on her, my cultivation might increase even faster, and I’ll have one less opponent."

After some serious thought, Mo Shentian decided to head to Qi Qingxiu’s domain. "I want you to immediately locate the domains of the Soul-Devouring Demon Race and the Eternal Night Demon Race! Once you find one, you must inform me immediately."
"Yes, Demon God."
After his five trusted demons left, Mo Shentian hurriedly left his domain to head to Qi Qingxiu’s domain.

Shortly after Mo Shentian left, a male demon appeared inside the Celestial Demon Royal Palace. The male demon was none other than one of Wu Mian’s substitute bodies, which he deliberately left in that domain.
Wu Mian went straight to Mo Shentian’s seclusion, but the sight that greeted him there was quite terrifying, even for a demon god like him.
"That man has gone mad! Zhang Fei already told me the effects of the Yin Sacrifice Technique, but I didn’t expect it to be so terrifying."
Shortly after Wu Mian contacted him, Zhang Fei [5] arrived at the scene.
"What are you going to do with them, kid?"
"At first, I wanted to keep these five puppets here, but I changed my mind, and I’m going to take them away."
"Are you really going to do that? What about Mo Shentian?"

"I don’t need to think about Mo Shentian anymore." Zhang Fei [5] approached the fake Mo Zainan, Mo Anqi, Mo Yousha, Shang Xueli, and Nalan Wangzi, sending them into the training space. "I have Mo Zhejun here, and he is that crazy demon’s master, so I can still keep an eye on him."
Wu Mian nodded in understanding. "What about the Seven Emotions Demon Race? Mo Shentian wants to attack them to capture Qi Qingxiu."

"One of my clones has already gone there, and I will move all the demons in that domain to another domain, so Mo Shentian’s trip there will be in vain." Zhang Fei [5] paused. "As for the Soul-Devouring Demon Race and the Eternal Night Demon Race, he hasn’t managed to find both of their domains, so I don’t need to worry about them now."
"In that case, I will help you monitor those two domains, and I will notify you if Mo Shentian comes there."
"I’ll leave that matter to you." After that, Zhang Fei [5] and Wu Mian left the Celestial Demon Royal Palace.

Time passed quickly, and a month had already passed in the outside world. Zhang Fei [5] went to the Heavenly Cloud Domain, but he didn’t stay long there, and he moved all the Wang Clan members to the Twin Flames Domain.
After leaving the clan members in their new residence, Zhang Fei [5] took Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi to the Moonlit Passion Temple.

chapters.title: Chapter 1724: Talk With The Wang Siblings
paragraphs: "Brother Zhang, thank you for moving our clan here and taking us in," Wang Yusheng said sincerely.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly. "Brother Wang, you don’t need to thank me; I helped you two simply because you deserve it. Wang Tieshan and the Divine Samsara Sect are truly shameless and insolent, and Liang Huizhong targeted me even though we never had any problems in the past."

"Haha," Wang Yusheng laughed. "They’re targeting you for a few reasons, Brother Zhang. They must have heard about the sect’s changes, and they’ve also heard about your actions in the tower from Li Guangyu. You’re obviously still junior compared to me and my big sister, but you’ve done a lot of things that neither of us can do, so I’m not surprised that Liang Huizhong is targeting you."

Zhang Fei [5] sighed. "Honestly, I never wanted to have anything to do with the Divine Samsara Sect, and I transformed this sect into a universal one for the benefit of everyone on my side. Unfortunately, human greed knows no bounds, and they targeted me because they feared that this sect would surpass them and replace their position."

"Unfortunately, it’s already too late, right?" Zhang Fei[5] nodded to Wang Jingzhi. "For a long time, the Divine Samsara Sect has been suppressing all human clans and sects because Huang Tianzhun is the strongest human cultivator, and the Huang Clan possesses strength that cannot be underestimated. Besides them, I heard that Ouyang Xuening and the Ouyang Clan are no less powerful than them, and they can pressure Yue Ningxue to hand over her position in the sect to them."

"I’ve heard about the Huang and Ouyang Clans from Feng Yao, and she told me that they are indeed powerful." Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng looked at Zhang Fei [5], curious about his relationship with the female fire phoenix. "Although I’m not afraid of those two clans, I don’t dare underestimate them because they have several cultivators at the 3-Sun Celestial Venerable Realm. Since three months ago, Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening have been trying to find the location of this domain, but they haven’t succeeded."
"Huh? Is it true that Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening personally took action to search for the location of this domain?" Wang Yusheng asked in shock.
Wang Jingzhi knitted her brows, asking. "How did you know about their movements?"

"Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening decided to search this domain themselves because of Feng Yao." Zhang Fei [5] told the Wang siblings about the events three months ago at the Divine Samsara Sect, and he also told them that Yue Ningxue had already left that sect to rejoin the Celestial Moon Sect, which shocked them. "As for how I was able to know their movements, Feng Yao implanted something into their bodies at that time, so she was able to monitor their movements."

If Zhang Fei [5] had mentioned that someone else was watching over the people from the Divine Samsara Sect, Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng wouldn’t have believed it. However, Feng Yao was different from ordinary cultivators, and she was the reincarnation of the infamous Empress Huo Yanling.

Wang Yusheng hesitantly asked. "Brother Zhang, is Empress Huo your wife? Although I don’t know her personally, I’ve heard a lot about her past actions. She was an aloof and ruthless woman in the past, and no cultivators had ever managed to get close to her back then, but she was very protective of you and those closest to you."

Wang Jingzhi was also curious about Zhang Fei [5]’s relationship with Feng Yao, especially after she witnessed the female fire phoenix in action at the Tower of Eternity, which was much different from her past character. Unlike her brother, she didn’t dare ask about it directly because it wasn’t her business.

"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] nodded slightly. "Actually, my relationship with Feng Yao was previously just that of good friends, and she helped me a lot when my cultivation was still in the Body Realm; however, she has been my wife for the past three and a half months."
"Woah! You’re truly amazing, Brother Zhang! You’ve managed to win Empress Huo’s heart!" Wang Yusheng exclaimed with admiration.

On the other hand, Wang Jingzhi was shocked after hearing that Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Yao’s relationship had been going on for so long. "Have you and Empress Huo really known each other for that long?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei [5] told them about his meeting with Feng Yao years ago. "At that time, I knew her through one of my wives, and our relationship wasn’t that close. The beginning of the change in our relationship was after the incident in the Netherworld Realm, and our relationship continued to improve after she followed me to the Nine Stars Realm. She hid her true identity from me at that time, and I started to know everything after I ascended to this Paradise Realm."
"Empress Huo probably deliberately hid her identity at that time because you were still too weak to know everything."

"You’re right," Zhang Fei [5] agreed with Wang Jingzhi. "At that time, I had only cultivated for a few years, and my cultivation had only just broken through to the Earth Realm. On the contrary, she is the reincarnation of Huo Yanling who was feared and respected by all cultivators in this Paradise Realm."
As they looked around those halls, Zhang Fei [5] chatted with Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng about many things, but he did not tell them about matters that were too sensitive and private.

Although they had accepted Zhang Fei [5]’s offer to become elders of the Moonlit Passion Temple, Wang Jingzhi had not yet decided to join any hall, but Wang Yusheng decided to join the Sword Hall because of Jian Kuang.
"Anyways, I have drawn up a long-term plan for this sect, and I will move it to another realm in the future."
"What do you mean by another realm, Brother Zhang?"
"Is there a realm higher than this Paradise Realm?"
"Do you two remember the stone gate on the third floor of the Tower of Eternity?"
Naturally, Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng remembered the gate, but they didn’t know anything about it, let alone the realms higher than the Paradise Realm.
"If we open the gate, we’ll arrive at the tower in the Zhanlu Domain, which is one of the domains in the Ancient Realm."
"What?" Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng cried out in shock. "The Zhanlu Domain in the Ancient Realm? Are you serious about that, Brother Zhang?"
"Did Empress Huo tell you all that?"

"I’m serious about that, Brother Wang." Zhang Fei [5] nodded. "You’re right, Feng Yao told me about all that, Sister Wang. In fact, I’ve already found the key to open the gate, but I didn’t dare open it because those creatures have taken over the tower in that domain."
"I remember your conversation with Empress Huo and the others back then, especially regarding those shadowy creatures."

"Those shadowy creatures are simply too powerful, and their numbers are far greater than we previously imagined; even Feng Yao had difficulty defeating them." Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen that showed their battle with those creatures in the Cangxuan Domain. "See? We’re having trouble killing them even though we’re fighting at full strength."

Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng took a deep breath as they watched Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Yao fight against those shadowy creatures on the qi screen, not expecting that those creatures could withstand such powerful attacks. Even though they were not present in the domain when the fight took place, they knew that both of them used their full power when fighting those creatures.
"Is there no way to defeat those creatures? Will they invade this Paradise Realm in the future?"

"The possibility of them invading this Paradise Realm exists, and we haven’t found a solution to defeat them." Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng’s expressions turned serious as soon as Zhang Fei [5] said that because the situation in the Paradise Realm would be dire if those shadowy creatures managed to invade their realm. "For now, you two don’t need to think about them, and I want you to completely focus on your cultivation."

Wang Yusheng smiled bitterly. "How could we not think about them, Brother Zhang? Those creatures are simply too powerful; even cultivators as strong as Empress Huo have difficulty killing them, let alone cultivators at our level."
"Can you take us to the Ancient Realm?" Wang Jingzhi asked.

"I can." Zhang Fei [5] paused as he looked at them. "Actually, I discovered a deserted domain in the Ancient Realm, and my subordinates have cleared it of the debris of the past that remained there for the past month."
"Please bring us there."
"Alright."

As soon as they arrived at the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley, Wang Yusheng and Wang Jingzhi immediately tried to absorb the qi within the domain. Their expressions turned to joy after they experienced the power of Qi there for themselves.

Unlike a month ago, the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley appeared much cleaner due to the efforts of the natural races who had been cleaning the domain, and new trees were growing there thanks to the abilities of the Dryad Race.
Wang Jingzhi spread her senses across the domain, discovering several things that caught her attention.
"This Yin-Yang Immortal Valley was a paradise for dual cultivators in the past, but a past disaster destroyed most of it and wiped out all its inhabitants."
"The past disaster?"

"Feng Yao hasn’t told me about it, so I can’t tell you two anything about it." Zhang Fei [5] informed them about several areas of the place and his future plans. "Once I find a solution to eliminate those creatures, I will move my sect and my people to this domain."

chapters.title: Chapter 1725: Third Rank Seven Profound Treasures: Mirror of Eternity
paragraphs: After their conversation, Wang Yusheng decided to explore the Yin-Yang Immortal Valley himself, leaving Zhang Fei [5] and Wang Jingzhi behind.

"If I’m not mistaken, you’re the owner of the Mirror of Eternity, right?" Wang Jingzhi frowned, but Zhang Fei [5] quickly explained. "I didn’t mean to snatch the mirror from you because I also possess one of the Seven Profound Treasures, the Sealed World Pearl."
"Huh?" Wang Jingzhi did not expect that Zhang Fei [5] would possess one of the Seven Profound Treasures. "If I remember correctly, the Sealed World Pearl is a rank seven treasure, right?"
"That’s right." Zhang Fei [5] gave her a light nod. "Unlike the Mirror of Eternity, the Sealed World Pearl has already fused with me, so I can’t show it to you."

"Fused with your body?" Wang Jingzhi was confused by that, but Zhang Fei [5] touched his forehead, and the symbol of the Sealed World Pearl appeared there. "I know the name of every artifact of the Seven Profound Treasures, but I have no information about the others except for my mirror."
"Can you take out the mirror?"
Wang Jingzhi was hesitant to do that, but she remembered that Zhang Fei [5] had already ensured the safety of her Wang Clan, so she immediately summoned the Mirror of Eternity.
As soon as the Mirror of Eternity appeared, it vibrated strongly as if detecting something, followed by a ray of light shooting out from Zhang Fei [5]’s forehead.

The Mirror of Eternity appeared ancient and beyond comprehension. Its surface resembled still water mixed with a galaxy of floating stars, while faint ripples of silver light rippled across it. It radiated a vast, cold, and eternal aura.
"Same reaction."
"What do you mean by the same reaction?"

"Many years ago, one of my wives obtained the Sky-Severing Sword from a cultivator from the Ancient Realm; the sword and the pearl inside my body gave off the same reaction as if they were connected to each other."
Wang Jingzhi tried to recall a few things. "Did your wife get the Sky-Severing Sword in the Forbidden Land the last time it opened?"
"You’re right about that, and Senior Puyang gave the sword to my wife after it chose her to be its master."

"I see." Wang Jingzhi nodded in understanding. "The last time the portal opened, I also wanted to go to the Forbidden Land, but the situation in my clan wasn’t conducive at the time, so I canceled my plans. As for the Mirror of Eternity, I obtained it on the third floor of the Tower of Eternity several decades ago, and it’s been with me ever since."
"Have you unlocked all the functions of the Mirror of Eternity?"

"Not yet." Wang Jingzhi looked disappointed. "The mirror has been with me for decades, but only two of its main functions have been unlocked, and the rest are still sealed. Even so, I can use some of its minor functions, and they are very helpful to me."
"What are those two main functions?"
"The first function relates to illusions, and the second to the soul. Overall, the mirror has seven functions in total, but I haven’t been able to unlock the others."
Zhang Fei [5] could more or less guess the first function of the Mirror of Eternity, but he was curious about the second function. "What do you mean by soul function?"

"I can’t explain it in words, but I know it’s related to the soul, including soul strength, soul repair, and others." Zhang Fei [5] asked Feng Yao about it through his real body, but she said that it couldn’t be used by anyone else, and only Wang Jingzhi could use it. "What about your Sealed World Pearl? Have you fully unlocked that artifact?"
"I’ll take you in there so you can see for yourself."
"Alright."

Wang Jingzhi was amazed by the situation inside the Sealed World Pearl because it was like a secondary world separated from the real world, and she could see so many types of herbs in the first area. She remembered that Zhang Fei [5] was a god-rank alchemist, so she was no longer surprised to see those herbs.
Wang Jingzhi looked at the second area, finding so many beasts roaming there. Moreover, those beasts weren’t weak, and most of them had already reached the Five Celestial Realm.

"This artifact has five other areas besides this farm area, but I can only open the second area, which is the area where those beasts live." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly had another idea, but he decided to put it off for now, and he would do it when he had spare time.

"The world inside the Sealed World Pearl is truly impressive, but it still small because not all areas have been opened yet." Wang Jingzhi returned his gaze to those herbs. "How did you grow them? I’m not an alchemist, but most of these herbs are quite rare in the outside world, and some of them are exorbitant prices."
"Did you forget that I have many members of the Dryad Race by my side?"

"Oh." Wang Jingzhi nodded. "I don’t know much about the abilities of members of the Dryad Race, but I’ve heard that they can grow all kinds of plants quickly. Since you’re an alchemist, you’re truly fortunate to have them by your side, and you won’t have to worry about running out of herbs."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "Besides those Dryads, one of my wives is an azure dragon, and her wood element helps me a lot."

"An azure dragon, huh?" Wang Jingzhi muttered to herself. "I remember you’re a nine-tailed fox, and you have a good relationship with Emperor Long, so it’s no wonder you could persuade a female dragon to become your wife."
"You seem to have extensive knowledge of all the powerful cultivators in this Paradise Realm." Wang Jingzhi turned sad, confusing Zhang Fei [5]. "Why is your reaction so strange?"

Wang Jingzhi shook her head slightly. "My late parents were explorers in the past, and they have been to almost all domains, except those demon domains. They often recounted all their adventures since I was little, including those in the Divine Origin Main Domain in the past. They once met Emperor Long, Senior Tianshi, Senior Xukong, and many others."
"Why don’t you follow in your late parents’ footsteps and go to those domains?"

Wang Jingzhi smiled bitterly. "I don’t have the courage of my late parents, and my Wang Clan has been in decline since the deaths of many of our core members. As a younger generation, I focused on my cultivation, and I dreamed of restoring my clan to its former glory. Regretfully, my clan’s decline persisted year after year despite my best efforts."

"I see." Zhang Fei [5] remembered Feng Yao’s stories about the disaster that befell the Wang Clan in the past, and he also remembered the cause of Wang Jingzhi’s parents’ death. "Your clan has settled into my domain now, and I will support it from now on."

Wang Jingzhi looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a complicated gaze, still confused about his reasons for helping her clan, as they had not known each other before the Tower of Eternity. "Why are you willing to help us? What do you want from us?"
"Would you believe me if I said I don’t want anything from your clan?"
"No," Wang Jingzhi shook her head in disbelief. "There’s no such thing as a free lunch, so I don’t believe you have any ulterior motives for helping us."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed. "Do you think your Wang Clan has everything I need with your conditions like that?"
"My Wang Clan is too poor for you."

"You said that yourself." Wang Jingzhi just smiled in response to Zhang Fei [5]. "In fact, I already have almost everything I need, so I don’t need your Wang Clan’s help, and I helped you because I like your brother’s character."
"Is that all your reason for helping us?"

"Believe it or not, that is my sole reason." Wang Jingzhi fell silent, still not believing Zhang Fei [5]. "I have nine alchemy gods, two supreme-rank blacksmiths, two supreme-rank artifact crafters, two rank ten array masters, and several others by my side. With their presence, I dare say that my sect is far superior to the Divine Samsara Sect."

Wang Jingzhi did not deny that the Moonlit Passion Sect was superior to the Divine Samsara Sect now, and that was her main reason for deciding to accept Zhang Fei [5]’s offer two months ago. Furthermore, he was Empress Huo’s husband, and he also has a close relationship with those powerful cultivators, such as Emperor Long and others. Thus, she firmly believed that her Wang Clan would be able to prosper again if she followed him.

Wang Jingzhi took a deep breath, looked at Zhang Fei [5] intensely, and asked him, "What can I do to repay your kindness to my clan? As long as you are willing to help my clan prosper like in the past, I will fulfill whatever you want."

"Sigh!" Zhang Fei [5] sighed and patted Wang Jingzhi’s head. "I understand your hope for your clan to prosper again, but you don’t have to sacrifice yourself for it. Besides, I haven’t done anything for your clan yet, so you don’t have to think about repaying me now. If your clan has prospered again, we’ll talk about this matter then."

"Alright." Wang Jinzhi nodded in agreement. "I don’t have anything valuable to repay you with now, but I will definitely repay you when my Wang Clan is prosperous again in the future, and you can ask me for anything at that time."
"Let’s get out."
"Yes."

She remembered that Zhang Fei [5] was a god-rank alchemist, so she was no longer surprised to see those herbs.
Wang Jingzhi looked at the second area, finding so many beasts roaming there.
Moreover, those beasts weren’t weak, and most of them had already reached the Five Celestial Realm.

"This artifact has five other areas besides this farm area, but I can only open the second area, which is the area where those beasts live." Zhang Fei [5] suddenly had another idea, but he decided to put it off for now, and he would do it when he had spare time.
"The world inside the Sealed World Pearl is truly impressive, but it still small because not all areas have been opened yet." Wang Jingzhi returned his gaze to those herbs.
"How did you grow them?
I’m not an alchemist, but most of these herbs are quite rare in the outside world, and some of them are exorbitant prices."
"Did you forget that I have many members of the Dryad Race by my side?"
"Oh." Wang Jingzhi nodded.
"I don’t know much about the abilities of members of the Dryad Race, but I’ve heard that they can grow all kinds of plants quickly.
Since you’re an alchemist, you’re truly fortunate to have them by your side, and you won’t have to worry about running out of herbs."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled.
"Besides those Dryads, one of my wives is an azure dragon, and her wood element helps me a lot."
"An azure dragon, huh?" Wang Jingzhi muttered to herself.
"I remember you’re a nine-tailed fox, and you have a good relationship with Emperor Long, so it’s no wonder you could persuade a female dragon to become your wife."
"You seem to have extensive knowledge of all the powerful cultivators in this Paradise Realm." Wang Jingzhi turned sad, confusing Zhang Fei [5].
"Why is your reaction so strange?"
Wang Jingzhi shook her head slightly.
"My late parents were explorers in the past, and they have been to almost all domains, except those demon domains.
They often recounted all their adventures since I was little, including those in the Divine Origin Main Domain in the past.
They once met Emperor Long, Senior Tianshi, Senior Xukong, and many others."
"Why don’t you follow in your late parents’ footsteps and go to those domains?"
Wang Jingzhi smiled bitterly.
"I don’t have the courage of my late parents, and my Wang Clan has been in decline since the deaths of many of our core members.
As a younger generation, I focused on my cultivation, and I dreamed of restoring my clan to its former glory.
Regretfully, my clan’s decline persisted year after year despite my best efforts."
"I see." Zhang Fei [5] remembered Feng Yao’s stories about the disaster that befell the Wang Clan in the past, and he also remembered the cause of Wang Jingzhi’s parents’ death.
"Your clan has settled into my domain now, and I will support it from now on."
Wang Jingzhi looked at Zhang Fei [5] with a complicated gaze, still confused about his reasons for helping her clan, as they had not known each other before the Tower of Eternity.
"Why are you willing to help us?
What do you want from us?"
"Would you believe me if I said I don’t want anything from your clan?"
"No," Wang Jingzhi shook her head in disbelief.
"There’s no such thing as a free lunch, so I don’t believe you have any ulterior motives for helping us."
"Haha," Zhang Fei [5] laughed.
"Do you think your Wang Clan has everything I need with your conditions like that?"
"My Wang Clan is too poor for you."
"You said that yourself." Wang Jingzhi just smiled in response to Zhang Fei [5].
"In fact, I already have almost everything I need, so I don’t need your Wang Clan’s help, and I helped you because I like your brother’s character."
"Is that all your reason for helping us?"
"Believe it or not, that is my sole reason." Wang Jingzhi fell silent, still not believing Zhang Fei [5].
"I have nine alchemy gods, two supreme-rank blacksmiths, two supreme-rank artifact crafters, two rank ten array masters, and several others by my side.
With their presence, I dare say that my sect is far superior to the Divine Samsara Sect."
Wang Jingzhi did not deny that the Moonlit Passion Sect was superior to the Divine Samsara Sect now, and that was her main reason for deciding to accept Zhang Fei [5]’s offer two months ago.
Furthermore, he was Empress Huo’s husband, and he also has a close relationship with those powerful cultivators, such as Emperor Long and others.
Thus, she firmly believed that her Wang Clan would be able to prosper again if she followed him.
Wang Jingzhi took a deep breath, looked at Zhang Fei [5] intensely, and asked him, "What can I do to repay your kindness to my clan?
As long as you are willing to help my clan prosper like in the past, I will fulfill whatever you want."
"Sigh!" Zhang Fei [5] sighed and patted Wang Jingzhi’s head.
"I understand your hope for your clan to prosper again, but you don’t have to sacrifice yourself for it.
Besides, I haven’t done anything for your clan yet, so you don’t have to think about repaying me now.
If your clan has prospered again, we’ll talk about this matter then."
"Alright." Wang Jinzhi nodded in agreement.
"I don’t have anything valuable to repay you with now, but I will definitely repay you when my Wang Clan is prosperous again in the future, and you can ask me for anything at that time."
"Let’s get out."
"Yes."

chapters.title: Chapter 1726: The Spirit Of The Mirror of Eternity
paragraphs: "Empress Huo!" Wang Jingzhi shouted the moment Feng Yao emerged out of Zhang Fei [5] ’s body.

Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei [5] and Wang Jingzhi, her lips curled up into a dazzling but playful smile. "Lend me the Mirror of Eternity. Anyway, don’t call me Empress Huo anymore because she’s long dead, and the current me is the Phoenix Princess, Feng Yao."
"Huh? The phoenix princess." Wang Jingzhi struggled to process Feng Yao’s words. "Does that mean you’re a female beast now?"
"I am a female phoenix, but I’m not part of the phoenix race in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain."

Wang Jingzhi was speechless, thinking that Feng Yao’s confession was too bold. However, she remembered that many powerful cultivators in the Paradise Realm already knew her identity and her status as Zhang Fei [5]’s woman.
Wang Jingzhi took out the Mirror of Eternity and handed it to her. She wasn’t worried about doing so because Feng Yao would never take the mirror from her.
Feng Yao accepted the mirror and caressed it longingly. "Long time no see! Don’t you want to come out and meet me, Zhi Jing?"
"Eh?" Wang Jingzhi and Zhang Fei [5] were shocked. "Who is Zhi Jing, Empress—Big Sis Yao?"
"Oh? That little brat has never shown himself to you?" Wang Jingzhi was puzzled, shaking her head. "Zhi Jing, if you don’t come out now, I will force you out."

The Mirror of Eternity trembled strongly before releasing a dazzling light, followed by the appearance of a boy about ten years old. Although the boy looked very young, he was actually much older than all living beings in the universe, except the Primordials.
Wang Jingzhi was in a daze, not expecting that the Mirror of Eternity had a living spirit. She never knew that, even though the mirror had been in her hands for decades.
Zhi Jing put on an aggrieved look. "Why do you always threaten me, Big Sis Shen?"

"Shen Yuanzhi is long dead, and you can call me Feng Yao from now on." Seeing Zhi Jing’s sad look and the sorrow in his eyes, Feng Yao let out a soft sigh and patted his head. "Little Jing, do you remember what I said to you before I entered the circle of reincarnation for the first time?"
"I... I remember everything, Big Sis Yao." Zhi Jing looked at Wang Jingzhi. "That’s why I chose her as the master of the Mirror of Eternity, but she was too weak to handle the mirror’s full power."
"Huh?" Wang Jingzhi was shocked to hear that. ’So, the mirror chose me as its master because of Big Sis Yao?’

"You’re wrong about that." Wang Jinzhi looked at Feng Yao with a questioning look. "I never asked Little Jing to choose you as the mirror’s master, and I only told him about the character of the person who was suitable for it. Since he handed over the mirror to you, that means you are a suitable person to be its master."
"Oh." Wang Jingzhi nodded in understanding. "But who is Shen Yuanzhi?"
"Shen Yuanzhi is my first identity in this universe, a primordial being, to be precise."

Wang Jingzhi’s eyes nearly popped out of her sockets; she was utterly shocked after learning that Feng Yao had such an identity in the past. She glanced at Zhang Fei [5], who confirmed it with a slight nod.

Zhang Fie [5] looked at Zhi Jing before asking Feng Yao. "Does that mean all the Seven Profound Treasures have spirits, Yao’er? Zhi Jing is the spirit of the Mirror of Eternity, and Ling is the spirit of the Sky-Severing Sword."
"Huh? Have you met Ling before, Little Brat? Where—Ouch!" Zhi Jing shuddered when he saw the look in Feng Yao’s eyes. "Why... why did you smack my head so hard, Big Sis Yao?"
Feng Yao glared at him. "If my husband is a little brat, doesn’t that mean I’m a little brat too?"
"What?" Zhi Jing gulped hard, looking at Zhang Fei [5] and Feng Yao alternately. "Cough! Is... is this little—this man really your husband?"
"He is Zhang Fei, and he is the only living being worthy of being my husband."
"Haha," Zhi Jing laughed happily as he sat on Zhang Fei [5]’s shoulder. "Big Brother Fei, how did you manage to conquer Big Sis Yao’s heart?"
Zhang Fei [5] rubbed his nose. "I didn’t conquer her heart, but she conquered mine."
Zhi Jing and Wang Jingzhi were both stunned after hearing Zhang Fei [5]’s words, which indicated that Feng Yao took the initiative to be with him. They looked at her, but she simply smiled at them.
Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei [5]. "The Sealed World Pearl also has a spirit, but he is still deep in sleep, and you will meet him after you unseal the last area."
"The last area?"

"Yes." Feng Yao nodded. "Zhen Zhu is different from the other spirits of the Seven Profound Treasures. His character is a little unique, and you will learn more about him when you meet him in the future."

Zhang Fei [5] could only sigh after hearing that. The Sealed World Pearl still had four sealed areas, and decades had passed since he unlocked the second area, but the other four areas were still sealed to this day.
"You don’t need to think too much about those areas for now, husband. When the time comes, all those areas will open up on their own, and you’ll meet Zhen Zhu then."
"Is Zhen Zhu as unique as you said?"

"Big Brother Fei, the Sealed World Pearl is indeed the seventh rank of the Seven Profound Treasures, but Zhen Zhu is the most powerful spirit among us." Zhang Fei [5] looked at Zhi Jing. "Since Big Sis Yao asked you to wait, I won’t say anything about him, and you will know everything when you meet him in the future."
"Alright." Zhang Fei [5] didn’t want to dwell on the matter, and he decided to wait for the last four areas of the Sealed World Pearl to open by themselves so he could meet Zhi Jing then.

Feng Yao looked at Zhi Jing. "Since you’ve chosen Wang Jingzhi as your master, you must teach her more about the Mirror of Eternity, and you must help her unlock the last four features as soon as possible."
"Why is that, Big Sis Yao? My master isn’t ready to open the third feature, and she will die from qi depletion if it opens."

"This universe has changed, and the appearance of those creatures worries me." Zhi Jing already knew about those creatures since Zhang Fei [5] told Wang Jingzhi about them, but he didn’t have clear information about them. "I won’t say much for now, and you just need to focus on helping her unlock the last four features. Do you understand?"
"I understand, Big Sis Yao." Zhi Jing nodded helplessly. "So, where is Ling now? Why didn’t you bring him here, Big Brother Fei?"

"My wife, Xian Xianqin, is the owner of the Sky-Severing Sword, so she is Ling’s Master. They are in the Tower of Eternity now, but you will meet them soon." Zhi Jing was overjoyed after Zhang Fei [5] said that. "Hmm?"
"What happened, husband?" Feng Yao asked.
"You should check out the Seven Emotions Demon Domain, Yao’er."

Feng Yao raised an eyebrow for a moment before examining the domain. "Mo Shentian is almost there, husband. Fortunately, you’ve already moved all the members of the Seven Emotions Demon Race into the Soul-Devouring Demon Domain, so he won’t be able to find anyone there."
"What is your relationship with the Seven Emotions Demon Race, Zhang Fei?"
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Wang Jingzhi, chuckling at the curious look on her face. "Demon God Qi Qingxiu is one of my wives."
"Hiss!" Wang Jingzhi took a deep breath, staring at Zhang Fei [5] in shock.
"Hehe," Zhang Fei [5] chuckled. "Besides Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran is also my wife, and Nalan Shizhe is my mother-in-law."

"You leave me speechless." Wang Jingzhi didn’t know what to say about Zhang Fei [5]’s relationship with the three female demon gods. "Since you have important matters, you should send me and my brother back to the Moonlit Passion Sect, and we will meet Sect Master Qing afterward."
"Alright."

After Zhi Jing entered the Mirror of Eternity and Feng Yao entered his body, Zhang Fei [5] sent Wang Jingzhi and Wang Yusheng back to the Moonlit Passion Temple. He went to the Zenith Solar Sanctum because Qi Qingxiu was cultivating there with the others, and he took her to the Seven Emotions Demon afterward.
As soon as Zhang Fei [5] and Qi Qingxiu arrived at the Seven Emotions Demon Domain, Wu Mian immediately appeared in front of them using the body of a female demon.
"You are more suitable to be a woman, Wu Mian."

"Tch." Wu Mian’s lips twitched. "If I had any other choice, I wouldn’t be using a female demon’s body. Mo Shentian will arrive soon. Are you sure you want to fight him? Even if the three of us join forces and attack him at the same time, we won’t be able to defeat him."

Zhang Fei [5] smiled calmly. "We might not be able to defeat Mo Shentian, but you should remember that Feng Yao and Huo Ling are by my side. However, I’m forbidding them from coming out for now, and I want to test the Celestial Demon God’s abilities so I can better prepare myself to fight him in the future."
"Oh? Do you really want to have a serious fight with Mo Shentian?"
"I have no other choice, and I must defeat Mo Shentian with my own abilities to achieve my one goal." Zhang Fei [5] looked outside the domain. "Here he comes."

chapters.title: Chapter 1727: Testing Mo Shentian’s Abilites And Strength
paragraphs: [Quest: Meet the Celestial Demon God.]
[Quest rank: Medium]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: Medium gift pack x1 sent to the inventory]
At the same time as the notification appeared, Mo Shentian appeared in front of Zhang Fei [5], Qi Qingxiu, and Wu Mian.
Zhang Fei [5] ignored Mo Shentian’s hostile gaze and focused on reading his status.
Name: Mo Shentian
Gender: Male
Race: Celestial Demon
Rank: Demon God
Cultivation: Celestial God Realm
Elements:
- Darkness [Peak Stage]
- Space [Peak Stage]
Elemental Laws:
- Darkness [Perfection Stage]
- Space [Perfection Stage]
Physique: Celestial Demon God Body
Abilities: ???
Strong: Darkness + Space
Weak: Light + Void

Zhang Fei [5]’s brows knitted together because the system scan couldn’t detect Mo Shentian’s abilities. He didn’t think that he had the space element, just like him. He informed Qi Qingxiu and Wu Mian to be careful, especially since their enemy possessed the space element. ’It looks like it won’t be easy to face him.’
Qi Qingxiu and Wu Mian were shocked to hear that; they had never heard that Mo Shentian possessed the space element and mastered the space elemental law to the perfection stage.
After he detected Zhang Fei [5]’s cultivation, Mo Shentian sneered in disdain before looking at Wu Mian. "I never expected to see you in this domain."
"Haha," Wu Mian laughed. "What are you going to do to me after seeing me in this domain?"
"Do you think I can’t kill you even though this isn’t your real body?" Mo Shentian sharpened his gaze.

"You can’t kill me," Wu Mian replied confidently. "Even if you kill this body, I won’t suffer any injuries, let alone die. By the way, how do you feel after being trapped in the tunnel for several years?"
Mo Shentian frowned, not expecting that Wu Mian knew about the incident several years ago. "Where did you get that news?"
"It doesn’t matter where I get the news, right?" Mo Shentian clenched his fist, eager to attack Wu Mian. "Are you still unaware of the situation in this domain?"

Mo Shentian hurriedly checked all areas of the domain, but he couldn’t find anyone else, apart from Zhang Fei [5], Qi Qingxiu, and Wu Mian. "Did you move all the members of your race to another domain, Qingxiu?"
"Do you think I’ll let you kill all the members of my race, Mo Shentian?" Qi Qingxiu returned the question with a sneer. "I know you came here to capture me, but you’ll never succeed in doing so."

"Whether I will successfully capture you or not, you already know the answer." Mo Shentian stretched his hand forward and used the space element to lock down Zhang Fei [5], Qi Qingxiu, and Wu Mian. However, his confidence crumbled when his space lock was destroyed all of a sudden. "Oh? A lust demon like you also has the space element, huh? Since you were able to destroy my technique, your space elemental law must have reached the perfection stage."
"You can say it like that."

Mo Shentian thought about killing Zhang Fei [5] because his space elemental law was troublesome, but his expression turned to shock as his cultivation skyrocketed. "Impossible! How could your cultivation suddenly reach the Celestial Demon God, especially with your low demon rank?"
Zhang Fei [5] just smiled. "For a demon god, you talk too much."

"You—" Mo Shentian crossed his arms in front of his chest as soon as Zhang Fei [5] disappeared from his sight. A second later, a powerful punch landed on his face and sent him rolling backward in the air several times. "You—"
"You what?" Mo Shentian was utterly shocked by Zhang Fei [5]’s speed and punch power. "If you feel my punch just now wasn’t enough, I can give you a few more."
"Heh!" Mo Shentian snorted. "Do you think borrowing someone else’s strength and your speed is enough to stop me? I am a demon god, and I am the strongest among the ten demon gods."

"Is that so?" Zhang Fei [5] smirked. "If you truly believed you were that powerful, you would never have used the Yin Sacrifice Art or sacrificed your wife, your two daughters, and your two daughters-in-law."
"How—"

"Are you surprised that I know everything?" Zhang Fei [5] created a qi screen that showed scrolls of the Yin Sacrifice Art and the Yin Sacrifice Art. "See? You’re not the only one who has those techniques because I have them too, but I will never learn evil techniques like those two."
"Bastard!"

Mo Shentian flew towards Zhang Fei [5], who was also flying towards him. In an instant, their fists collided against each other, producing a loud explosion and a powerful wind wave that swept through almost the entire area of the domain.
Mo Shentian was shocked because Zhang Fei [5]’s punch threw him far back, but the latter didn’t move an inch from his spot. "How is this possible? How can a lust demon like you match my strength?"

"Nothing is impossible in this universe as long as we are willing to work hard to achieve our dreams." Zhang Fei [5] disappeared again, but he suddenly felt an extreme change in the area around him, which was due to the effects of Mo Shentian’s abilities. "Bending reality, huh?"
"Hahaha," Mo Shentian laughed triumphantly. "I didn’t expect a lust demon like you to know about my ability to bend reality, but your fate was sealed the moment you fell into my technique!"
"Are you sure about that?"
