chapters.title: Chapter 1728: Zhang Fei’s Next Plans
paragraphs: "How did your cultivation reach the Celestial Demon God realm?"
Zhang Fei [5] looked at Wu Mian. "I can borrow the strength of all the beasts in my beast space, and Feng Yao is a fire phoenix. So, you already know the answer, right?"
"I see." Wu Mian nodded in understanding. "With Empress Huo by your side, there’s nothing you can’t do, and you’ll automatically become the strongest cultivator in the Paradise Realm."

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head. "What’s the point of becoming the strongest with borrowed power? I can’t fight cultivators at the Celestial God Realm with my strength right now, but I’ll definitely reach that level in the future. By the way, I want to take you two to the Myriad Abyss Domain soon, so you should prepare now."
"The Myriad Abyss Domain?"

"The Myriad Abyss Domain is a demon domain in the Ancient Realm, and there are dozens of demon gods there." Wu Mian and Qi Qingxiu took a deep breath after Zhang Fei [5] said that. "The strongest among them is Mo Qingwen, and Feng Yao said that he is much stronger than Mo Shentian, but she has no information about his abilities. Before we go there, I will go to the Frozen Yin Domain to look for those of the Yin Demon Race, and I will use them to improve my cultivation."
"The Yin Demon Race?" Qi Qingxiu and Wu Mian were demon gods, but they had never heard of that demon race.

Zhang Fei [5] explained to Qi Qingxiu and Wu Mian about the Yin Demon Race. "As you both remember, the crystal core we found in Ku Shenzu’s palace belonged to a Yin Demon, and the Yin Qi within it is extremely powerful. If I can capture many of those female demons, I’m sure it will boost my strength."
"Won’t that be dangerous for you?"

"No," Zhang Fei [5] replied with a shake of his head. "I’ve often used my ability to absorb other people’s cultivation in the past, and it had no other effect on me besides increasing my own. Actually, I didn’t want to use that ability again, but I had no other choice due to the appearance of those creatures. Their main target is me, so I have to improve myself as soon as possible, and I will use any means to do so."

Qi Qingxiu grabbed Zhang Fei [5]’s hand. "I can understand your worries, but you must be careful in using that technique. If you become dependent on it, it will only harm your future, and we will suffer because of it. Do you understand?"

"You know that I’m always cautious in all my actions, right? I already know the risks, but I assure you that it won’t happen to me." Zhang Fei [5] opened the gate to the Zenith Solar Sanctum. "For now, you should return to that domain and cultivate, and I’ll take you to the Myriad Abyss Domain once I’m ready."
"Okay." Qi Qingxiu immediately disappeared into the gate.
"Do you want to go to that domain?"
"No," Wu Mian rejected Zhang Fei [5]’s offer. "The situation here is still uncertain, so I’ll stay in my domain to monitor everything, and I’ll contact you if I can’t handle it."
"Alright, then." Zhang Fei [5] closed the gate and opened another one. "I will return to my sect now, and you can contact me directly if you need my help."
"I will." After Zhang Fei [5] left, Wu Mian also left the Seven Emotions Demon Domain.
"How is the result?"

"My domain is destroyed." Nalan Shizhe and Ye Mingran exchanged looks of shock, and Qi Qingxiu immediately explained the situation to them. "If it weren’t for the appearance of those creatures, Big Sis Ling would have already killed Mo Shentian, and the situation would have been much calmer without that foolish demon god’s presence. Although I’m disappointed that my domain was destroyed, I feel much better because my race is safe, and I’ll rebuild it when the situation is safe. By the way, our husband wants to take us to the Myriad Abyss Domain after he finishes his business in the Frozen Yin Domain, and he asked us to prepare for it."
"The Myriad Abyss Domain?"

Qi Qingxiu explained to them about the Myriad Abyss Domain, Zhang Fei’s goal, Mo Qingwen, and the dozens of demon gods who resided there. "Although the three of us are also demon gods, they are much stronger than us, so we must be extremely cautious there."
"Those five demon materials, huh?" Nalan Shizhe understood Zhang Fei’s purpose.

Ye Mingran also understood Zhang Fei’s goal. "Those five are quite rare in the Paradise Realm, and he has many demon wives by his side. All of them have reached the Empress Rank, but he lacks the materials to help them ascend to the Seven Supreme Demon Ranks."

"Let’s not think about that matter and focus on cultivating, and he will take turns taking us to dual cultivate with him." Ye Mingran and Nalan Shizhe agreed with Qi Qingxiu, and the three immediately went elsewhere to continue their cultivation.
Zhu Shanniang slumped limply in Zhang Fei’s arms, but her expression looked blissful.

Zhang Fei deliberately didn’t send Zhu Shanniang to join the others at the Zenith Solar Sanctum. She was the weakest of all his wives after her long absence. They immediately returned their souls to their bodies after ending their dual cultivation.

"Husband," Zhang Fei looked at Zhu Shanniang, who was hugging him like an octopus. "I still regret my stubbornness back then. If I hadn’t been stubborn, you wouldn’t have banished me to the Three Mortal Realms, and my cultivation wouldn’t have lagged behind the others."
"It’s good if you understand that and don’t repeat it again! If you act stubborn again, I will punish you more severely than before."
Zhu Shanniang shivered in fear because she knew that Zhang Fei would carry out his threat if she acted like before again. "I don’t dare! I won’t do it again! Don’t punish me again, husband."
"Haha! If you obey my words, I won’t punish you anymore." Zhang Fei summoned Feng Yao from his beast space. "Thank you, Yao’er."
"You’re my husband, so you don’t need to thank me." Feng Yao sat beside them. "So, what do you think of Mo Shentian? Are you confident you can defeat him in the future?"

"I can’t defeat Mo Shentian today, but I will defeat him in the future." Zhang Fei paused and thought. "His ability to bend reality is truly terrifying, and I couldn’t have broken free from it if it weren’t for Ling’er, so I have to think of something to overcome it if I want to defeat him in the future."

Feng Yao nodded. "Actually, it’s not difficult to overcome Mo Shentian’s ability to bend reality, but I won’t tell you about it, and I want you to find the solution yourself. If you can’t defeat him, you’ll never be able to defeat Mo Qingwen."
"Hmm?"
"I don’t have clear information about Mo Qingwen’s abilities, but he is much stronger than Mo Shentian. If he becomes your enemy, you will face the strongest enemy you have never faced before."

Naturally, Zhang Fei didn’t dare underestimate Feng Yao’s words, and he hoped that he wouldn’t become Mo Qingwen’s enemy. After all, making friends was much better than making enemies, and he already had plenty of them. "How long until we arrive at the Frozen Yin Domain?"
"A month." Feng Yao looked at Zhu Shanniang on Zhang Fei’s lap. "I think you should dual cultivate with your other wives, husband."
Zhang Fei agreed with Feng Yao. "I’ll bring one of my clones here, and I’ll take Luo Yunxiao and the others into the training space."
After his fourth clone arrived there, Zhang Fei took Zhu Shanniang into the training space, and his other clone sent all his wives who were in the Zenith Solar Sanctum there.
Puyang Yeyu and Mo Zainan, who had been training at the training ground for a month based on the time in the outside world, were a little surprised when they saw Luo Yunxiao and the others.
Luo Yunxiao smiled mischievously when she saw Puyang Yeyu. "I didn’t expect you to bring her here, husband."
"Unfortunately, she isn’t his wife yet." Nalan Wangzi commented, gazing at Puyang Yeyu.

"She doesn’t have feelings for me yet, so I’m in no rush with her." Zhang Fei looked at Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xun’er. "At first, I wanted to take you two as my wives after my affairs in the Ancient Realm were finished, but I’ve changed my mind, and I’ll take you both now."
Even though they had long looked forward to becoming Zhang Fei’s wives, Tianshi Shengjie and Helian Xun’er were still embarrassed to hear that.
"Let’s go now."

As soon as they entered the pavilion, Zhu Shanniang immediately went to her room to rest because she knew that Zhang Fei would be dual cultivating with Tianshi Shengji and Helian Xun’er for a long time.
Luo Yunxiao, Nalan Wangzhi, and several other women had no problem with this because the flow of time in the pavilion was much faster than in the outside world.
Helian Xun’er didn’t want to have her first experience with another woman, and Tianshi Shengjie knew Zhang Fei much earlier than her, so she gave her the first chance.
Zhang Fei didn’t mind Helian Xun’er’s wishes, and he took Tianshi Shengjie to the main bedroom.

Even though she had prepared herself for so long, Tianshi Shengjie was still nervous about becoming Zhang Fei’s wife. In her entire life, she had never felt so tense, and her heart was pounding at the thought.
"Shengjie."
"Hmm?"
"Do you still remember our first meeting?"

At that time, she told him that she was waiting for him in the Evergreen Spirit Realm, and she moved her avatar to that realm afterwards.

Tianshi Shengjie thought she would have to wait for Zhang Fei for several years in the Evergreen Realm, but her initial suspicion was wrong, as he arrived there half a year after their last meeting. What shocked her most was that he knew her real name and her dragon race, even though she had never mentioned either to him.

Back then, Tianshi Shengjie deliberately asked Zhang Fei to go to the Evergreen Spirit Realm because the Pride soul of the ten-tailed fox was hidden in that realm, and he needed it to be able to evolve into the next ten-tailed fox. However, a mischievous idea suddenly popped up in her mind, and she didn’t tell him about the natural races in that realm. She even left the realm when he entered the soul’s sealed place without waiting for him to finish, and he ended up fighting the natural races of that realm.

Their fourth meeting was two days after Zhang Fei ascended to the Paradise Realm, and Tianshi Shengjie knew of his presence because he carried her Celestial Dragon Token with him. She even brought Tian Huangjin to visit him in the Empyrean Domain, or more precisely, the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.

At that time, Tianshi Shengjie didn’t know anything about the two primordial beasts, but she knew that the ten-tailed fox was the strongest beast that ever existed; not even her father and Long Wuzhao could match him. "How could you be so sure that I would appear in the realm all those years ago?" Zhang Fei asked curiously.

Tianshi Shengjie nodded. "All Celestial Dragons are white, including our hair. Actually, I myself am confused about why I was born with golden hair, especially since my parents and two brothers have white hair."
"Why should you be confused by that? The combination of white and golden makes you unique, so you should be proud of it."
"I’ve always been proud of myself." Tianshi Shengjie placed her hands on her waist, puffing out her breasts. "Hey, husband, transform into your half-calamity dragon form."

"Stop teasing me!" Tianshi Shengjie pouted.

Tianshi Shengjie rubbed Zhang Fei’s dragon horns. "Honestly, I don’t understand how you got your dragon form because the writing left by the ten-tailed fox clearly states that you are a human, a heavenly fox, and a lust demon."

"Hmm? Why are you apologizing to me?" Tianshi Shengji asked with a puzzled look.

If I had any objections, I would never have volunteered to search for you in the Three Mortal Realms. Moreover, you are the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox, and there is no man in this universe who is worthy to be my husband other than you."
"Hehe," Zhang Fei chuckled. "So, you’ve already made up your mind to be my wife from the start, huh?"
"I do." Tianshi Shengjie nodded. "However, I’m still thinking about one thing, but I haven’t gotten the answer yet."
"What are you thinking about?"

"Our future children." Zhang Fei stared at Tianshi Shengjie dumbfounded. "You are a human, a heavenly fox, a lust demon, and a calamity demon dragon, remember? With your four identities, I’m curious about our future children."

Zhang Fei himself had been thinking about the matter for a long time, but he hadn’t found an answer because he wasn’t ready to have children yet. "What kind of child do you want? A mix between a fox and a dragon, or a pure dragon?"

In the Endless Domain, Mo Shentian’s three sons finally arrived at the domain, but Zhang Fei didn’t bother with them, and he asked Xie Yao and Xie Yan to take care of them.
Xie Yan asked Zhang Fei’s permission to have fun with Mo Shentian’s three sons, and he agreed with her as long as they were willing to have fun with her.
With her allure, it wasn’t difficult for Xie Yan to seduce Mo Zixiao and his two brothers, and they focused on having fun afterward.
Meanwhile, Zhang Fei asked Xie Yao to be on guard in case Mo Shentian suddenly came to the Endless Domain.
Xie Yao told Zhang Fei that all the demons living in the Endless Domain would join forces to fight Mo Shentian if he dared to come to the Endless Domain, including the witch demon race.
From their previous battle, Zhang Fei knew that the two lust demon gods and the other demon races were no match for the Celestial Demon God, and Mo Shentian could crush them.
He contacted Wu Mian, and the Faceless Demon God told him not to worry because he also had a substitute body in that domain, so he could monitor the situation whenever he wanted.
Several days passed quickly in the training space, but a day only passed in the outside world.
For the past few days, Zhang Fei had been dual cultivating and dual soul cultivating non-stop.

At first, Zhang Fei wanted to take Helian Xun’er as his wife after he was done with Tianshi Shengji, but he changed his mind and brought the Celestial Dragon Princess to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.

Zhang Fei could have used one of his clones, but he felt that it would be inappropriate because Tianshi Lingyue was Tianshi Shengjie’s mother, and she wanted to discuss with them about their marriage.
When they arrived at the Celestial Dragon Palace, several people were already waiting for them there, including Long Lixuan and Long Wuzhao.
Since Zhang Fei had known Tianshi Bailong for a long time, Tianshi Shengjie introduced him to her mother, two brothers, and two sisters-in-law.

Previously, Tianshi Shengjie had told Zhang Fei some things about Tianshi Lingyue, but he felt that the woman in front of him was different from her story, and he felt that her mother was not scary at all.
As for her two brothers and two sisters-in-law, he felt that they were much better than the arrogant Long Youjia.
"Shengjie." Tianshi Lingyue grabbed her daughter’s shoulders, looking her up and down.
"My daughter, you’ve become a mature woman and a wife now, so you must not act childish like before, and you must serve your husband well.
Do you understand?"
Tianshi Shengjie was truly embarrassed to hear this.
"Mother, since when have I been so childish?
I’m even more mature than my two brothers, remember?"
Tianshi Shengjie’s two brothers turned their faces to the side as soon as Tianshi Lingyue glanced at them, not daring to face her.
"Humph!" Tianshi Lingyue snorted, looking at Zhang Fei.
"I’ve heard a lot about you from your father-in-law, and I’ve been waiting for you for a long time, but my daughter only brought you to see me today."
Zhang Fei smiled at that.
"Please forgive me, mother-in-law.
Over the years, I have been too busy with many things, including my cultivation, so I was only able to meet you today."
"I forgive you," Tianshi Lingyue said with a smile, while Tianshi Shengjie and her two brothers shook their heads helplessly at their mother’s attitude towards Zhang Fei.
"Emperor Long and my husband have told me many things about you, and all your actions are truly impressive, especially your actions against those demons.
Since you are here today, I want to discuss with you about your marriage to my daughter, and—"
"Mother-in-law, I have my own plans for my marriage with Tianshi Shengjie."
Tianshi Lingyue narrowed her eyes.
"What are your plans for your marriage to my daughter?"
"A grand wedding."
"Huh?
A grand wedding?" Not only Tianshi Lingyue was shocked by that, but also Tianshi Bailong and the others.
"Please elaborate."
Zhang Fei held Tianshi Shengjie’s hand.
"We’ve both discussed this matter, and we want to invite all races to attend our wedding, including those of the demon race."
"That’s—"
"Do you want to use your marriage to Little Shengjie to unite all races?" Long Wuzhao asked Zhang Fei.
"That’s right." Zhang Fei nodded.
"Basically, the people around me come from all races, and I have several different identities, so I want to use our marriage as a starting point to unite all races.
Some of you already know the situation in my sect, and it is an example where all races can live together in harmony.
However, I don’t want to stop there.
I want all races from all domains to live in harmony, so I will use this opportunity to gather them."
"What if they cause a riot at your wedding?" Tianshi Lingyue asked doubtfully.
"I know you managed to gather them in your sect, but it’s on a small scale.
If you invite all races to your wedding, the situation will be chaotic because some races are hostile to each other, such as the Winged Race and the Demon Race."
"If they dare to create chaos at my wedding, I will kill them on the spot, no matter which race they come from."
Tianshi Lingyue and the people present at the place frowned after Zhang Fei said that, and they felt that the man in front of them was a madman.
"Are you really going to turn your wedding into a bloody affair, kid?" Tianshi Bailong asked with a frown.
"Why not?" Zhang Fei casually asked back.
"If they want to mess up my wedding, I will never spare them, and I will kill them right then.
However, I’m sure they won’t cause a riot, and I will only invite those who have close ties with me."
"Who are the people you want to invite to your wedding?" Zhang Fei took out a scroll and handed it to Long Wuzhao, who immediately read it with Tianshi Bailong.
"From the human race, you will not invite people from the Divine Samsara Sect, the Immortal Soul Palace, and the Spirit Temple."
"That’s right." Zhang Fei nodded.
"The Divine Samsara Sect is my archenemy of the human race, and their ancestors were eager to capture me.
I have some issues with Hun Lingwu, so I won’t invite people from his sect.
The Spirit Temple is responsible for my old friend’s troubles, but I won’t take action against them for now, and I’ll wait for him to be ready to take revenge on them."
"Who?"
"Ma Kuangyu of the Ma Clan." Long Wuzhao and the others had heard of him and his clan.
"From the Winged Race, I will only invite Tian Yizu and his group because they are on my side, and Tian Huangjin is a good friend of Tianshi Shengjie.
From the demon races, I will exclude the Celestial Demon Race, the Asura Demon Race, and the Thousand Eye Demon Race because I don’t have a good relationship with them.
As for the beast races, I leave them to you, Emperor Long."
Long Wuzhao nodded.
"You don’t need to worry about the beast races, and I guarantee they won’t dare cause trouble at your wedding.
As for the natural races, I think you should meet the other races, besides the fairy, giant, and druid races."
"I’ve thought about that, and I’ll send one of my clones to meet them.
As for the demihuman race, I’ll only invite the royal family members."

chapters.title: Chapter 1734: Grand Wedding Plans
paragraphs: Zhang Fei sent one of his clones to the Floral Mirage Domain to meet with the natural race. He also contacted Jia Leixuan, Lu Wangyi, and Ju Jushen. He planned this because he still had several pending quests, so he wanted to complete them as soon as possible.

Zhang Fei sent the other clone to the Heavenly Mistveil Domain to meet with Long Huoyan and Huo Jinying, discussing his plan to invite them to his wedding. He also sent another clone to the Radiance Domain to meet Tian Yizu and the others according to his original plan.

Among all his wives, Zhang Fei only had a proper wedding banquet with Xian Xianqin, Zhou Shenxin, and Luo Yunxiao. When he married the first two women, they were still living in the Nine Stars Realm. Meanwhile, he married the latter when he ascended to the Paradise Realm for the first time, specifically in the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary.
As for his other wives, Zhang Fei married them ceremonially without a big wedding banquet. Some of them even refused to get married, such as Murong Qianying and several other women.

From the demon races, Zhang Fei didn’t bother with them, and he didn’t intend to invite all of them. Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran were his wives, Nalan Shizhe was his mother-in-law, and Wu Mian was one of his closest allies. Jiu Moze, Jiu Mozu, and Ku Shenzu were his slaves, so he just had to order them to appear at his wedding. As for Sha Mo and Sha Yuan, they were his future in-law, so it wasn’t difficult to ask them to come.

From the human race, Zhang Fei had already planned to bring most of the people in the Twin Flames Domain and the Empyrean Domain, especially Luo Yunxiao’s family members. He would also invite some others, such as people from the Emerald Bamboo Sect, the War God Pavilion, and the Sky Pillar Domain.
As for the people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain, Feng Yao had already informed Zhang Fei’s clone that she would bring everyone to attend his wedding with Tianshi Shengjie.

Tianshi Bailong and Tianshi Lingyue were speechless after listening to Zhang Fei’s explanation. His wedding with their daughter would be the largest and most lively since the Paradise Realm existed. Not to mention, it would be the first time all races would gather in one place. They weren’t afraid of those people causing a commotion at the event, but they didn’t want their daughter’s wedding to be ruined because of them.
Tianshi Bailong and Tianshi Lingyue glanced at Tianshi Shengjie, but their daughter did not say a word, and she obviously fully supported Zhang Fei’s decision.
As for their two sons and daughters-in-law, they felt that Zhang Fei’s idea was truly reckless, especially with his decision to invite those demon races.

Long Lixuan, who was sitting leisurely, also tensed up after hearing all of Zhang Fei’s explanations. She was happy because she was planning a grand wedding for Tianshi Shengjie, but she was also worried when she thought about the situation on their wedding day, especially since some races were hostile towards each other. However, she didn’t say anything, mainly because the wedding was an event of the Celestial Dragon Race.

Long Wuzhao wasn’t too worried about it because Feng Yao would be attending Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding, and her presence would put pressure on all the guests. "When do you want to hold your wedding? Based on your plan, we’ll need extensive and lengthy preparations to get everything ready, especially with such a large number of guests."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei thought for a moment. "Is a month enough to make the preparations? If you lack the men to manage the preparations, I will send many more people to help you."
"If you are going to send your people to this domain, I think less than a month is enough to complete the preparations, and we can hold your wedding next month."

"In that case, I’ll send them to this domain after I explain everything to them, and they’ll help you start all the preparations starting tomorrow." Zhang Fei thought for a moment. "In addition to the people on the list, I’ll also invite a few people from outside the list, and their presence will make the situation much safer."
"Who are the people you mean?"

"The Xuanyuan Clan." Long Wuzhao and the others gasped in shock as soon as Zhang Fei mentioned that clan. They remembered that the clan’s members were residents of the Forbidden Land, but they couldn’t leave their domain because of the barrier. "Since I can travel freely to all domains, I can certainly invite them to my wedding. Apart from members of that clan, I will invite members from the Puyang Clan."
"The Puyang Clan? Isn’t that clan—"
"Yes," Zhang Fei opened a portal to his training space, and Puyang Yeyu walked out of it a few minutes later.

Puyang Yeyu was a little surprised when she saw all the beasts in front of her, and she could immediately recognize Long Wuzhao’s identity as the one and only Five-Clawed Golden Dragon. "Hmm? The beast races from the Paradise Realm, eh?"
"Are you truly a member of the Puyang Clan from the Ancient Realm, Senior?" Long Wuzhao asked, cupping his hands in respect.

Puyang Yeyu was stunned for a moment and turned to Zhang Fei, who nodded at her. "My name is Puyang Yeyu, and my Puyang Clan is indeed located in the Ancient Realm. Normally, I cannot descend to any domain apart from the Forbidden Land, but the situation is different with Zhang Fei here."

’This kid! How could he bring a cultivator from the Ancient Realm here? Moreover, he brought a woman, and I’m sure she’s one of his women.’ Tianshi Bailong led his wife and children to respect Puyang Yeyu. "Welcome to our place, Senior."

Puyang Yeyu waved her hand. "Since you guys are Zhang Fei’s acquaintances, there’s no need to be so formal with me. Moreover, my Puyang Clan isn’t that special in the Ancient Realm, and my clan is no different from any other clan in this Paradise Realm."

"Yeyu, I plan to hold a grand wedding with Tianshi Shengjie in a month. What do you think if I invite your clan members on that day?" Puyang Yeyu looked at Zhang Fei in surprise, but then she observed the female celestial dragon. "After all, she is the Celestial Dragon Princess, so I want to hold a grand feast for our wedding, and I want to invite all my acquaintances."

Puyang Yeyu nodded slightly. "I think there’s no problem if you want to do that, and I’m sure that my grandmother will agree to it since you are Senior Feng Yao’s husband. However, they can’t stay in this realm for long, especially with those creatures still trying to destroy our barrier. Do you want me to talk to them about this matter first?"
"I think that’s a good idea." Zhang Fei opened the gate to the Puyang Clan’s domain. "Please help me talk to them, and I’ll pick you up in a day or two."
"I’ll return to my clan and meet them now."

Zhang Fei closed the gate after Puyang Yeyu disappeared inside. "With the presence of the Puyang Clan members and Feng Yao’s subordinates from the Blazing Nirvana Domain, our wedding plans should proceed smoothly, right?"
"You leave me speechless, kid," Tianshi Bailong said with a shake of his head.

"Hahaha," Long Wuzhao laughed out loud. "Even without the people from the Puyang Clan present, I’m sure your wedding guests won’t dare cause any trouble with Empress Huo present, so everything should go smoothly. Since you’ve arranged everything, I’ll order all the beast races to begin preparations, and you can send your people here to speed things up."
"Come with me! We have to prepare your wedding dress now!" Tianshi Lingyue pulled Tianshi Shengjie away with her, followed by Long Lixuan.
"Zhang Fei, I’ll invite nine other people."
"Who are those people?"

"They are the overseers of this realm, and they come from several races. You could say they are the strongest in this realm, and one of them is the Golden Phoenix Emperor, Feng Jinhuang." Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow slightly. "Empress Huo knows them, so you can ask her about their identities."
"Aren’t they going to look for trouble with those demon races?"
Long Wuzhao shook his head. "I guarantee they won’t cause any trouble, and Empress Huo will definitely stop them if they do that."
"Oh? Are they that afraid of Feng Yao?"
Long Wuzhao smiled bitterly. "Do you think any cultivator from this realm would dare to act rashly in front of Empress Huo? I can’t defeat her, let alone those people."

"I see." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "If that’s the case, you can invite them to my wedding with Tianshi Shengjie, and I hope they won’t cause any trouble on that day; otherwise, I’ll ask Huo Ling to eliminate them."
*Swoosh*

Huo Ling got out of Zhang Fei’s body and sat on his shoulder. "Leave those people to me, Husband. If they dare to cause trouble at your wedding, I will burn their bodies to ashes, and I will also eliminate their souls so they cannot be reincarnated."
’This kid!’ Tianshi Bailong was shocked again after Huo Ling addressed Zhang Fei as her husband.

Long Wuzhao could only shake his head. "I never thought that the spirit of the Primordial Flame would become one of your wives, and you would become the strongest in this realm with her and Empress Huo by your side."

"Becoming the strongest by borrowing the power of others is no accomplishment." Zhang Fei clenched his fist. "In the future, I will become the strongest not only in this realm but also in the Ancient Realm and the Primordial Realm, and I will retire when I succeed in achieving it."

chapters.title: Chapter 1735: Bring Two Dragons
paragraphs: "Retire? Do you think you can retire, son?" Tianshi Bailong asked.

Long Wuzhao spoke. "The higher our strength and reputation in the cultivation world, the less chance we have of retiring. All cultivators will continue to look up to us, and they will always be thinking of ways to overthrow us."

"Haha," Zhang Fei laughed softly. "Emperor Long, I’m different from you and my father-in-law, remember? Do I look like someone who cares about reputation in the cultivation world? For me, reputation is just an empty thing, so it means nothing to me. I only care about myself and the people around me, and I will take them away to get away from all worldly affairs after I become the strongest in this universe, so they can enjoy their retirement without any distractions."
"Are you really going to retire, husband?"
Zhang Fei smacked Huo Ling’s bottom. "Are you looking forward to enjoying your retirement?"
"Hehe," Huo Ling giggled. "I’m looking forward to it, so we don’t have to worry about anything else, and I’ll spend time with you then."

"After I reach the pinnacle of cultivation and peace returns to this universe, we will distance ourselves from everything, and we will enjoy the rest of our lives in peace together." Huo Ling’s eyes beamed, looking forward to Zhang Fei becoming the strongest in the universe. "At that time, we will live leisurely with all our descendants, and they will become the ancestors of the new universe."
"The new universe?" Huo Ling was shocked. "Do you want to create your own universe?"
"Does that matter need to be questioned, my lovely Ling’er?"

"No," Huo Ling shook her head. "If someone else had said that, I would have smashed their brains out because they don’t have the ability to do it. However, you are different from them, and I believe you will succeed in creating your own universe in the future."
"Cough... Cough..." Zhang Fei and Huo Ling turned their gazes to Long Wuzhao. "We’ve heard from Brother Xukong about your soul world. Can you take us there?"
"Sure." After Huo Ling entered his body, Zhang Fei brought Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong into his soul world.

Once they arrived at the Soul World, Tianshi Bailong took a deep breath and looked at the surrounding area. He and Long Wuzhao had been at the peak of their cultivation for a long time; at least that was what he thought before Zhang Fei appeared. The sudden appearance of his son-in-law made him feel like he was too ignorant, like a frog in a well.

With his current age, Tianshi Bailong had never met a cultivator who possessed a soul world, and Zhang Fei was the first. However, he didn’t know that his son-in-law would never have been able to do so if it were not for the intervention of a third party who completely changed his fate, which was none other than Xuanyuan Yue.
After his first death due to Xuanyuan Yue’s carelessness and being resurrected by Aunt Huang, Zhang Fei’s life continued to change, and it got better and better.

All of Zhang Fei’s women naturally knew about the two events that day, but only Zhang Lin and Zhang Chen knew about the existence of the system and Mei. As for Xuanyuan Yue as his killer and savior, only Feng Yao and Huo Ling knew about the young woman who explored all the universes.

Since four months ago, Long Xukong knew of Xuanyuan Yue’s existence and Zhang Fei’s past, but he didn’t know about the existence of the system and Mei, and Feng Yao strictly forbade him from telling others about the young woman.

Naturally, Long Xukong sealed his mouth off because he didn’t have the guts to challenge Feng Yao, but he didn’t hide the information about her past identities as the embodiment of the core of the universe, Shen Yuanzhi, or Guan Zhiyi. He told Tianshi Bailong and Long Wuzhao about her three past identities, which shocked them.
Regarding Feng Yao’s identity as the embodiment of the core of their universe, Long Wuzhao and the two dragons decided to keep it a secret so no one else would know about it.

Just like Tianshi Bailong, Long Wuzhao was also amazed by Zhang Fei’s soul world, as it was a real world separate from their universe. He was curious about his method of creating his soul world, but he was unwilling to explain anything to him.
"This soul world isn’t the final stage, right?"
Zhang Fei nodded to Long Wuzhao. "The final stage of my soul cultivation technique is to form my soul universe, but I don’t know if I’ll be able to achieve it or not."
"Is it really that hard to achieve, son?"

"Extremely difficult!" Zhang Fei grimaced. "Before I can form my soul universe, I have to form several other soul worlds. Although my soul world is almost complete, I still haven’t found the method to form my second soul world, so the soul universe is still far from my grasp."
"Is there anyone else who can form a soul world like you?"

"I don’t think so." Zhang Fei shook his head in response. "Since you two are seniors, you should already know how difficult it is to form our soul sea, right? Fortunately, I have several soul techniques and over a hundred wives, and they are soul cultivators like me, so my soul power can increase rapidly with their help."

Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong smiled bitterly upon hearing that; it was impossible to imagine themselves managing more than a hundred wives, especially for the latter. "Have any of your wives managed to form a soul world?"

"None." Zhang Fei let out a regretful sigh. "Although I shared all my soul techniques with all my wives, they only dual soul cultivated with me. They’ve successfully formed their soul seas, but they have no chance of forming their soul worlds."
"Even Empress Huo couldn’t do it?"

Zhang Fei looked at the two dragons. "Senior Xukong should have already told you two about Feng Yao’s true identity, right? She is a special existence in this universe because of her true identity, but she is no different from all the living creatures living in it, and she cannot form her own soul world."
"Does that mean you will bring everyone close to you into this soul world in the future?"

"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "When I reach the peak of my cultivation, I won’t want to bother with other matters anymore, and I will bring them all here to spend our old age together. At that time, I will think about my next steps, especially children."

"Hahaha," Long Wuzhao tapped Zhang Fei’s shoulder. "With your current strength and connections, it shouldn’t be a problem for you to have children, right? However, you have over a hundred wives, and I’m sure they all want children from you, so your descendants will be numerous."

"They’ve wanted a child from me for a long time, but I feel that I’m not ready. My strength is quite good, and my connections are also extensive, but I still have some fears inside me, so I don’t want to have a child before I become the strongest." Zhang Fei turned to Long Wuzhao. "Just look at you, Emperor Long. Without counting Feng Yao, you are the strongest in this universe, and other living beings fear you, including the ten demon gods, but your love life is zero."
"Haha," Long Wuzhao laughed bitterly. "Unlike you, I’ve never had any interest in love and family, and I’m completely focused on myself."

"What’s the use of us having power and prestige if we can’t share them with the people we love?" Long Wuzhao fell silent as soon as Zhang Fei asked that. "Just like you, I have the ambition to become the strongest in this universe, but I don’t want to live in solitude. For me, love and strength are an inseparable part of our lives; all of my wives and family are my driving force, and I want to become the strongest to protect them. Without them, I might not have such a goal, and I would certainly never have reached this level."
"Forget it," Long Wuzhao sighed. "You and I are two different individuals, and I will never be like you, so I’m content with my life now. By the way, who are the people who live in this soul world?"
"Check those two places." Zhang Fei pointed in two different directions.

Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong immediately checked both places. In the first place, they saw Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang meditating. In the second place, they saw Yin Yue, Tian Taiyang, and Tian Shuying cultivating their souls.
Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong recognized Jia Xianzu and Beiming Youhuang, but they did not recognize Yin Yue, Tian Taiyang, and Tian Shuying.

Zhang Fei immediately informed the two dragons. "Yin Yue is the leader of the Moon Clan, and the Endless Night Domain is her home realm. Meanwhile, Tian Taiyang is a member of the Sun Clan of the Zenith Solar Sanctum, and Tian Shuying is his ancestor. The three of them died due to the past disaster that occurred in the Ancient Realm, and I helped them recover their souls so they could reshape their bodies in the future."
"I see." Long Wuzhao nodded in understanding. "Can you take us to the Ancient Realm?"

Zhang Fei nodded at him. "I can take you two there, but I won’t. The avatars of the two primordial beasts are in the Ancient Realm, and they will immediately notice your presence if you go there. As for me, I have three other identities, so they don’t know that I am the current Calamity Demon Dragon."
After they talked about some other things, Zhang Fei brought Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong out of his soul world.

chapters.title: Chapter 1736: Invitations
paragraphs: After leaving his soul world, Zhang Fei bid farewell to Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong. He immediately left the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain before entering the training space, where he dual cultivated with Helian Xun’er.

Tianshi Bailong left his palace and gathered the leaders of all beast races, informing them about the marriage of Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie. All of them were shocked to hear that, but they also cheered with joy because they had been waiting for the appearance of the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox for a long time.

Like all the natural races, all the beast races had long awaited the appearance of the sole heir of the ten-tailed fox. They had long heard of Zhang Fei’s name and his exploits in the other domains, and they had long awaited his arrival, but he never came to meet them.

Since Zhang Fei was going to marry Tianshi Shengjie in a month, all the beast races immediately moved to prepare for their wedding. However, they were also anxious because Tianshi Bailong had told them that his son-in-law would invite people from all races, including the demon race.

Tianshi Bailong told them not to worry about it because Zhang Fei would only invite all his acquaintances, so they wouldn’t dare make a fuss at his wedding. He also informed them that Feng Yao and the people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain would be attending the wedding, but he didn’t tell them that the female phoenix was one of his son-in-law’s women.
Meanwhile, Long Wuzhao went to meet the overseers, and he informed them that Zhang Fei invited them to attend his wedding with Tianshi Shengjie.

Some of the overseers were looking forward to attending Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding, but some of them were not enthusiastic about it, and they thought that the marriage of the two was a natural thing.

However, they changed their minds once Long Wuzhao informed them that Feng Yao was one of Zhang Fei’s wives, and the men decided to attend the wedding of the two. The Dragon Emperor informed them that their wedding was no ordinary one, as all races would be present, and he sternly warned them not to cause trouble on that day, especially with those demons.

Some of them asked Long Wuzhao for an explanation about the presence of the demons, so he had no choice but to tell them the truth. He informed them that Ye Mingran and Qi Qingxiu were Zhang Fei’s wives, and Nalan Shizhe was his mother-in-law because her two daughters were also his wives.

Long Wuzhao also told them that Wu Mian was Zhang Fei’s close ally, and several other demons were his slaves, such as Jiu Mozu, Jiu Moze, and Ku Shenzu. As for Sha Mo, he was his future father-in-law, which shocked them.

Among them, only Feng Jinhuang was not surprised to hear all this because he had met Zhang Fei a few years ago, and he also knew the situation in the Moonlit Passion Sect, which was now inhabited by members from all races.

Long Wuzhao asked them to prepare generous wedding gifts for Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie; their marriage would also affect the reputation of the Celestial Dragon Race. After they finished talking, they immediately left the place to prepare the wedding gifts.
Feltia [2] went to the Forbidden Land to meet members of the Xuanyuan Clan, and he offered them to attend his wedding with Tianshi Shengjie.
At first, the people of the Xuanyuan Clan were doubtful about it because they couldn’t leave the Forbidden Land, but they remembered that Feltia [2] could enter and exit their domain freely.

Since they had been confined in the Forbidden Land for a long time, and they also wanted to establish a good relationship with Feltia [2], Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and the other five ancestors of the Xuanyuan Clan agreed to attend the wedding.
After Feltia [2] left the Forbidden Land, the people from the Xuanyuan Clan immediately moved to prepare the wedding gifts, and he would pick them up in a month.
In the Radiance Domain.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] suppressed his aura to the point of being undetectable, and he met with Tian Ziyu and several grand elders to invite them to his wedding with Tianshi Shengjie.

At first, Tian Ziyu and the others were hesitant to attend the wedding because Tian Qiye kept monitoring their movements, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] told them that they didn’t need to worry about that matter, and their leader wouldn’t notice their departure. Besides, he promised them that they could meet Xu Ling’er, who was the reincarnation of the first ancestor of the winged race, Tian Huangjin.

After hearing Xu Ling’er’s name, Tian Yizu and the others finally agreed to Zhang Xiaolong [3]’s request, and they will wait for him to pick them up in a month. After he left, they also started preparing wedding gifts.
In the Heavenly Mistveil Domain.
Zhang Fei [5] was sitting opposite Long Huoyan, Huo Jinying, and Si Yingwu to discuss his invitation to attend his and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding.

Long Huoyan and his two wives were hesitant about whether they should attend the wedding or not because they were afraid that their presence would disrupt the event, but Zhang Fei [5] assured them that no trouble would arise that day and he would kill anyone who dared cause trouble at his wedding.

After considering everything, Long Huoyan and his two wives agreed to accept Zhang Fei [5]’s invitation because he had helped the demihuman race members a lot by opening his alchemy shop in their domain, and his subordinates were willing to teach their members about alchemy.
After they agreed, Zhang Fei [5] immediately left the domain, and Long Huoyan ordered his subordinates to prepare wedding gifts.

Zhang Fei’s three clones then went to several other domains, such as the Sky Pillar Domain, the Heavenly Trial Domain, the Starfall Martial Domain, and the Peach Garden Domain, to invite his acquaintances from all of those domains.
Since they had long since decided to ally with Zhang Fei, Lan Yueru and Li Tianyu agreed to attend his wedding invitation without a second thought.

Dugu Yuanshen had witnessed Zhang Fei’s abilities on the second floor of the Tower of Eternity, and he had long since decided to side with him, so he readily agreed when he invited him to attend his wedding.

The Zhang Clan, the You Clan, the Qiao Clan, and several other clans of the Sky Pillar Domain also agreed to attend Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding without a second thought. After all, they have long been his allies, and they also have branch clans in the Twin Flames Domain.

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi naturally decided to attend the wedding because Zhang Fei was their son-in-law, but they still didn’t expect him to succeed in getting the Celestial Dragon Princess as one of his wives. However, they wavered slightly when the five Luo Ancestors heard the news and decided to attend, especially due to the dispute between them and their son-in-law in the Yin-Yang Corridor Domain several years ago.

Zhang Fei told them to remain calm and allow the five Luo Ancestors to attend his wedding. He was sure that they would not dare to cause trouble at his wedding, especially with the presence of many of his allies that day.
Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi ultimately decided to attend the wedding, and they left everything to Zhang Fei.
In the Puyang Clan, Puyang Yeyu was speaking with Puyang Shenmi in the secret chamber, and she informed her grandmother about Zhang Fei’s invitation.

As Puyang Yeyu had predicted, Puyang Shenmi immediately agreed to attend Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding. She also ordered the Puyang Clan members to prepare lavish wedding gifts, but unfortunately, not all of them could attend the wedding because they had to protect their clan from the relentless attacks of those creatures.
"How’s your relationship with Zhang Fei, Yeyu?"

Puyang Yeyu shook her head slightly. "Grandma, I’m happy to be by his side, and I’m already starting to develop feelings for Zhang Fei. However, I won’t rush into deciding my future, and I’ll wait for our relationship to deepen first."
"Alright, I won’t interfere with your relationship with Zhang Fei, but I hope you will make a decision about your future as soon as possible."
"I know, Grandma." Puyang Yeyu immediately left the secret chamber and returned to her private place, waiting for Zhang Fei to pick her up.

Inside the room, Zhang Fei was lying naked with Helian Xun’er sitting on his lower body, with both of her palms pressed against his chest. "So, how are the preparations for your wedding with Sister Shengjie?"

"Tianshi Shengjie and her parents will prepare everything, and my clones have already invited my acquaintances to attend, so our wedding will be very lively with the presence of all races." Zhang Fei kneaded Helian Xun’er’s breasts. "Do you want a wedding party, Xun’er?"
"No," Helian Xun’er shook her head. "Wedding ceremonies and banquets are just symbols, and what’s most important to me is our relationship, so I don’t care about them."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "If you change your mind and want a wedding ceremony in the future, you must tell me directly about your wishes, and I will hold a grand wedding for you."
"I won’t change my mind." Helian Xun’er stepped back, lay between Zhang Fei’s legs, and held his cock. "I’m going to be your wife today, so I don’t want to talk about anything else."
"Hehe," Zhang Fei chuckled. "You’re that impatient, huh? You don’t have to worry about that, and I’ll give you an unforgettable first time."

paragraphs: As the name suggests, the entire area in the Frozen Yin Domain was frozen solid like an ice planet, covered by a bone-chilling cold mist, which limited their vision.
Endless glaciers stretched to the horizon; a dark silver moon was hanging overhead. Countless frost chains float through the air, and frozen yin lotuses bloom from the frozen ground.
The cold had no effect on Zhang Fei and Feng Yao because they had powerful fire elements, but the case was different with Long Xukong, and he was forced to use his void element to protect his body.

"Over there!" Feng Yao pointed towards the front—precisely towards the central area of the domain. "Yuan Xiajie was there, protected by the Nine Yin Soul Banner. She seemed to have found nine powerful souls to strengthen the banner, especially since you exterminated the previous nine souls."
Zhang Fei opened the system map to see Yuan Xiajie’s location, but Mei informed him that the map couldn’t detect anything due to the bone-chilling cold mist that enveloped the domain.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei suddenly felt several presences circling around them. "Are they the yin demons?"
Feng Yao nodded. "They are yin demons, and they are powerful. However, only one of them is truly powerful, and her cultivation has already reached the Celestial God Realm."
"Oh? One of them has reached that stage, huh?" Zhang Fei muttered in surprise.
*Swoosh*
Huo Ling came out of Zhang Fei’s body and sat on his left shoulder. "I will protect you from that weak demon, husband."
"Haha," Feng Yao softly laughed. "Ling’er, you are becoming more and more like a doting wife, do you know that?"
"Stop teasing me, Master." Huo Ling pursed her lips. "Do you want to see all areas of this domain clearly, husband?"
*Swoosh*
Huo Diqiu also came out of Zhang Fei’s body and sat on his right shoulder. "Let me help you too, Master."
"Hey! A baby like you doesn’t need to interfere! You’ll just be a burden here!"

Huo Diqiu was annoyed to hear that from Huo Ling, but he didn’t dare do anything to her because she was much stronger than him. "Big Sis, I’m not a baby anymore, and my Earth Flame is enough to help my master."
"Humph!" Huo Ling snorted. "As long as I’m here, your Earth Flame will be useless, so you should return to his body now!"
Zhang Fei pulled Huo Ling in front of him, laid her on her stomach in the air, and smacked her bottom directly.
"Ahh!" Huo Ling screamed. "Why did you do that to me, husband?"

"If you continue to act like that towards Huo Diqiu, I won’t dual cultivate with you for an entire year!" Huo Ling hurriedly shut her mouth and sat back on Zhang Fei’s left shoulder. "Try using your Earth Flame, Diqiu."

"Yes, Master." Huo Diqiu transformed into his adult form, causing the temperature around them to rise rapidly, dispelling the bone-chilling cold mist. His adult form didn’t resemble a human at all; rather, it resembled a giant flame.
Long Xukong glanced at Huo Diqiu. "Which flame spirit is he?"

"The Earth Flame." Zhang Fei looked at Huo Diqiu, who was summoning fire from underground. "So far, I have four flame spirits by my side. The other two are the fire salamander, Huo Yan, and the Spirit of the Sun Flame, Ying Tai."
"Don’t you already have nine out of ten heavenly flames?"

Zhang Fei nodded to Long Xukong. "The Spirit of the Sky Flame, Tian Yan, chose Yuan Tianling as his master. The Spirit of the Moon Flame, Yin Ling, chose to stay with her previous master, Yin Yue. As for the other flames, they have not been given birth to spirits."
As they spoke, the frozen land beneath them began to melt due to Huo Diqiu’s Earth Flame, followed by the disappearance of the bone-chilling cold mist around them.
"Hmm?"
"Did you notice?" Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao. "Those yin demons live within the mist, so they can’t get close to our location because the mist around us is starting to disappear."
"So, what should we do to capture those yin demons?"
"Impatient, aren’t you?"
"I must improve my cultivation as soon as possible, and those yin demons are my best choice."

"You should stop now, Little Spirit." Hearing Feng Yao speak to him, Huo Diqiu immediately stopped and returned to his small form. "Those yin demons are invisible to the eye as long as they are in the mist, but you can lure them to come to us easily by using your yang qi. When they smell your yang qi, their bodies will become visible, and you can capture them at that moment."
"My yang qi, huh?" Zhang Fei took out a bottle containing his yang qi and opened the cap immediately.

In a matter of seconds, dozens of yin demons emerged from the mist, and their figures became visible before Zhang Fei and the others. However, Huo Ling immediately moved, creating a ring of flames that circled their area.

Female Yin Demons possess a beauty that seems born in the deepest reaches of the night. Their skin is pale and flawless like moonlit jade, carrying a faint chill that never fades regardless of the season. Long, silken hair cascades down their back. Their icy eyes are deep and dangerously alluring, drawing souls into an abyss of desire and obsession.
Despite their breathtaking beauty, there is always something unnatural about their existence. their smile carries hidden danger; their gaze seems capable of penetrating the heart.

Their figure is exquisitely feminine, with deep curves. Their every movement was mesmerizing. Flowing icy white dress drapes over their bodies, its translucent layers fluttering like mist around them.
Their presence is both enchanting and unsettling; those who gaze upon their beauty cannot decide whether they are witnessing celestial fairies or demonic temptresses.

Those yin demons were eager to absorb Zhang Fei’s yang qi, but they didn’t dare to get too close to them because of the Primordial Flames. They kept circling around them with their gazes fixed on the bottle.
Zhang Fei didn’t immediately capture the yin demons, choosing the strongest among them. However, most of them had cultivation levels below the Five Celestial Realms.

"That one!" Feng Yao pointed to a yin demon with a slightly larger build than the others. "Her cultivation is at the Celestial Emperor Realm, so you should capture her and send her to one of your spaces."

"Let me help you, husband." Huo Ling immediately moved towards the yin demon pointed at by Feng Yao. Capturing the female demon was a small matter for her, and she immediately brought her to Zhang Fei’s side. "Open your space and send her there."
Zhang Fei immediately opened the portal to the Yin-Yang Space. "Let’s go inside first."

Long Xukong was stunned as soon as they entered the Yin-Yang Space. He could see fifteen chambers in the space, with a clear tube filled with abundant Yin Qi in the center. "What kind of place is this?"

"A prison." Long Xukong looked at Zhang Fei. "If you check all the rooms, you’ll find eight women there. I deliberately locked them here while they were asleep, and their Yin Qi will automatically flow into the tube."
"Isn’t that too cruel for them?"

"I will never capture and use innocent people." Zhang Fei shook his head. "They are my enemies, and they have tried to kill me in the past. That’s why I captured them, and I imprisoned them here. Even though the tube will continue to absorb their Yin Qi, they won’t feel pain or anything, so they should be grateful for their situation. Besides, my clones always come here to wake them up and restore their bodies, so they don’t suffer at all."
"Which race do the eight women come from?"

"Four of them are from the beast race, and the rest are female humans." Zhang Fei pointed to the four rooms lined up. "Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu are a light dragon and a rain dragon; Wang Qingyi is the black tortoise, and Dai Yanxu is a white tiger."
Long Xukong frowned after Zhang Fei mentioned Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu, especially since both women were dragons, just like him. "Why don’t you take them as your women?"

"They are not worthy to be my woman." Zhang Fei looked at the female Yin Demon, who was completely immobile and unable to make a sound due to Huo Ling’s restraint. "Yao’er, how much Yin Qi can I get from this female demon?"

Feng Yao shook her head. "I can’t calculate the exact amount, so you’ll have to try absorbing her Yin Qi yourself. However, her Yin Qi is strong enough for the current you, and you can capture other yin demons after this."
"Alright."

Zhang Fei decided to bring his four clones into the Yin-Yang Space so they could absorb the yin demon’s yin qi much faster. The five of them stood around the yin demon, pressed their palms against her body, and began absorbing her yin qi at the same time.
The yin demon struggled to free herself, but Huo Ling’s restraint was simply too powerful for her, rendering her efforts futile.

Even though the woman in front of him was a demon, Long Xukong couldn’t bear to see her in pain because of Zhang Fei and his four clones. Unlike him, Feng Yao and Huo Ling weren’t bothered by it at all, and they patiently waited to find out the outcome.

On the third floor of the Tower of Eternity, Zhang Fei [1] gathered all his wives, Feng Jiu, Feng Tian, Su Shentian, Jian Kuang, and Zhuxian Sheng. "We’ve been in this tower for too long, so I’ll send you all back to the sect. In three days, I’ll bring everyone in the sect to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain to attend my wedding with Tianshi Shengjie."

"Hehe," Zhang Lin giggled. "Are you looking forward to your wedding day, Big Sister Shengjie?"
Tianshi Shengjie nodded. "All my preparations are complete, so I’m looking forward to my wedding day."
"Are there many interesting places here, Big Sister Shengjie?" Zhang Yue asked.
"Follow me!"

After they left, Tianshi Bailong said to Zhang Fei [1]. "I didn’t expect that your grandmother has transformed into a light dragon, and your big sister has transformed into an ice phoenix. What are your plans for them in the future?"

"Haha," Zhang Fei [1] laughed. "My grandmother only wants to stay by my side, but Yue’er will become the leader of the Ice Phoenix Race in the future. But as I said before, we will retire from the cultivation world after I become the strongest in this universe, and we will fully focus on our lives."
Tianshi Bailong nodded in understanding. "Let’s go! I’ll show you all the preparations for your grand wedding, and you can add anything if you feel like something is missing."
"Alright!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1741: Meet Two Dragon Prisoners
paragraphs: Tianshi Bailong provided a detailed explanation to Zhang Fei [1] about the division of areas for the wedding ceremony. "Since you have more than a hundred wives, I will place them in the front section with Brother Long and the leaders of the other races, and I will also prepare many guards to protect them."

"I think it’s no problem." Zhang Fei [1] was satisfied with Tianshi Bailong’s arrangements. "As for guards, you don’t need to worry about that, father-in-law. I’ve already prepared powerful guards to protect them, and Feng Yao’s subordinates will also protect them."

"I will have people from the Blazing Nirvana Domain sit right behind all your wives, so they are ready to move if there is any sudden danger. I trust in the abilities of Empress Huo’s subordinates, but I will still prepare those guards to protect them. After all, your wedding will be the first event where all races will gather together, and we cannot predict the problems that will arise then."

Zhang Fei [1] understood Tianshi Bailong’s worries, so he chose to accept her arrangements for his wedding. "Alright, you can arrange everything like that, father-in-law. As for the people from the Xuanyuan Clan and the Puyang Clan, you should place them in one area—near the area where all my wives are."
"I’ve arranged it that way because those two clans are closer to you." Tianshi Bailong grabbed Zhang Fei [1]’s shoulder. "Thank you."
"For what?
"For this grand wedding! Shengjie is my only daughter, and I always hoped she would have a grand wedding."

Zhang Fei [1] shook his head. "You don’t need to thank me, and the grand wedding is her right. Our wedding will be recorded in the history of the Paradise Realm, and people will never forget it for thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years to come."

"Haha," Tianshi Bailong laughed joyfully. "In the history of the Paradise Realm, no one has ever had such a grand wedding, let alone one that invited all the races. Your wedding will be the grandest one, and people will never forget it for a very long time."

Zhang Fei [1] agreed with him. "After the wedding, I plan to bring them into seclusion again, and we probably won’t come out for a decade or so. We’ll come out once most of them have reached the Celestial Emperor Realm, and they’ll be much stronger by then."
"Did you ever think that it would be detrimental to them?"
"I did."

"Their cultivation will increase rapidly with your help, but they will become like decorative vases if you continue to lock them in seclusion. Instead, you should let them be free so they can develop themselves as they wish."
Zhang Fei [1] sighed. "I want to let them be free and roam around this universe, but there are too many dangers out there, and I’m always worried that they will get hurt or die in their adventures."
"Isn’t all of that part of a cultivator’s life?"

"That’s true." Zhang Fei [1] looked off into the distance. "I have many people to protect them, but some situations are unpredictable. Many of them don’t have much experience in facing danger, so I’ve always been reluctant to let them go on adventures."

Tianshi Bailong looked at him. "How are they going to gain experience if you keep locking them up like now? They can only gain experience by going on adventures, but you’re too worried about their safety, and you don’t allow them to go out."
Zhang Fei [1] fell silent.

"When my daughter first reached adulthood, I let her go to other domains for adventure, and she nearly died several times during that time. I sent people to follow her from behind, but I forbade them from making any movements unless she was in grave danger." Zhang Fei [1] seriously considered Tianshi Bailong’s words. "All your wives’ cultivations have reached the Celestial King Realm at minimum, so they are much stronger when compared to my daughter at that time. Besides, they have been training for decades, so you should have more confidence in them and their abilities."
"I’ll think about it first."
"So, what is your real body doing?"
"Absorbing the Yin Demon’s cultivation." Tianshi Bailong looked at Zhang Fei [1] in shock. "They are demons, and they will kill anyone, especially men. So, I don’t need to have mercy on them, right?"
"Where did you meet those yin demons?"
"The Frozen Yin Domain in the Ancient Realm." Zhang Fei [1] opened a portal to the Ying-Yang Space. "Let’s go! I’ll take you there, and you can see everything for yourself."
"Alright."
"Oh? I didn’t expect that this kid would bring you here, Brother Bailong."
"Haha," Tianshi Bailong laughed. "You seem to be enjoying yourself traveling to various domains in the Ancient Realm, Brother Xukong."

Long Xukong shook his head. "All the domains in the Ancient Realm are no different from those in the Paradise Realm, and only the strength of qi differentiates them. Even so, some of the domains there are quite interesting, and the cultivators there are also far stronger than us, such as the members of the Puyang Clan."
"I also hope to go there someday."
"Your chance will come soon, Father-in-law."
"Alright." Tianshi Bailong looked at Zhang Fei and his four clones. "Is this woman the yin demon you mentioned before?"

"That’s right." Zhang Fei [1] nodded. "There are countless yin demons in the Frozen Yin Domain, but I can’t capture too many of them at once. The quantity of their Yin Qi is truly enormous, and I won’t be able to absorb them all in a short time, so I’ll absorb them one by one."

Tianshi Bailong felt that Zhang Fei [1]’s technique was too evil, but he had no problem with it as long as he used it on evil cultivators and demons. He looked around the Yin-Yang Space, especially at those rooms. "What kind of place is this exactly? Where did you get this place?"
"This place is a prison, and I got it by luck so many years ago."
"Zhang Fei, can you release Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu from this place? They are both a light dragon and a rain dragon, so I can’t bear to see you treat them like that."
"Female dragons?" Tianshi Bailong was shocked.
"Over there." Long Xukong pointed towards the two rooms, where the two female dragons slept.

Tianshi Bailong inspected both rooms and found Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu sound asleep. He frowned when he saw their yin qi being sucked out of their bodies, flowing into the glass tube in the center of the room. "This! Why are you doing this to them?"

"They are his enemies." Tianshi Bailong looked at Feng Yao, who was walking out of one of the rooms. "I understand how you feel about those two women because they are female dragons, but they tried to kill him in the past, so they have to face the consequences of their actions. Furthermore, they don’t experience the slightest pain, even though the glass tube absorbs their Yin Qin, and his clones always take care of their bodies."
"But—"

"Father-in-law, I can’t release Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu for now, but I will release them in the future." Tianshi Bailong returned his gaze to Zhang Fei [1]. "If you don’t believe me, you can ask them yourself."
Zhang Fei [1] immediately walked into the two rooms, and he woke up the two female dragons.
After a while, Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu woke up from their deep sleep. They were not surprised to see Zhang Fei [1] and hurriedly got out of bed. "Why did you wake us, Master?"
"Two people want to meet you two."
Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu followed behind Zhang Fei [1] out of those rooms, but they were shocked by the presence of Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong. "Dragons?"
"Senior Xukong is a void dragon, and my father-in-law is a celestial dragon."

Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu took a deep breath because the void dragon race and the celestial dragon race did not exist in the Three Mortal Realms, and they only existed in the Paradise Realm. They immediately approached Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong, paying respect to them. "Seniors."
"Do you two feel uncomfortable in your bodies?"
Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu exchanged glances for a moment before answering Long Xukong. "We have never experienced discomfort or pain in our bodies, Senior."
"Is that true?"

Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu nodded to Tianshi Bailong. "It’s true, Senior. Our master’s clones wake us up every now and then, and they always take care of our bodies, so our condition never declines. Besides, they helped us with our cultivation; otherwise, we would never have been able to reach this stage."
Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong observed the two female dragons seriously, but they couldn’t see any negative signs on their complexions, proving that they were completely healthy.
"Do you two want to leave this place?"
"If you two want to leave this place, you can just tell us."

Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu shook their heads. "We’ve been here for too long, and we’ve grown accustomed to our situation. Our master has never treated us badly, even though we’re his prisoners, so we won’t leave."

Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong glanced at the nonchalant Zhang Fei [1] before sighing in their hearts. "Since you two don’t feel uncomfortable, and you’re both used to this place, we won’t force you to leave."
"When are you going to release them?" Tianshi Bailong asked Zhang Fei [1].

"When my cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm." After that, Zhang Fei [1] returned the two female dragons to their room and put them to sleep again. "When my cultivation has reached that stage, I will no longer need them, and I will send them to your domain."
