"There are countless yin demons in the Frozen Yin Domain, but I can’t capture too many of them at once.
The quantity of their Yin Qi is truly enormous, and I won’t be able to absorb them all in a short time, so I’ll absorb them one by one."
Tianshi Bailong felt that Zhang Fei [1]’s technique was too evil, but he had no problem with it as long as he used it on evil cultivators and demons.
He looked around the Yin-Yang Space, especially at those rooms.
"What kind of place is this exactly?
Where did you get this place?"
"This place is a prison, and I got it by luck so many years ago."
"Zhang Fei, can you release Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu from this place?
They are both a light dragon and a rain dragon, so I can’t bear to see you treat them like that."
"Female dragons?" Tianshi Bailong was shocked.
"Over there." Long Xukong pointed towards the two rooms, where the two female dragons slept.
Tianshi Bailong inspected both rooms and found Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu sound asleep.
He frowned when he saw their yin qi being sucked out of their bodies, flowing into the glass tube in the center of the room.
"This!
Why are you doing this to them?"
"They are his enemies." Tianshi Bailong looked at Feng Yao, who was walking out of one of the rooms.
"I understand how you feel about those two women because they are female dragons, but they tried to kill him in the past, so they have to face the consequences of their actions.
Furthermore, they don’t experience the slightest pain, even though the glass tube absorbs their Yin Qin, and his clones always take care of their bodies."
"But—"
"Father-in-law, I can’t release Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu for now, but I will release them in the future." Tianshi Bailong returned his gaze to Zhang Fei [1].
"If you don’t believe me, you can ask them yourself."
Zhang Fei [1] immediately walked into the two rooms, and he woke up the two female dragons.
After a while, Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu woke up from their deep sleep.
They were not surprised to see Zhang Fei [1] and hurriedly got out of bed.
"Why did you wake us, Master?"
"Two people want to meet you two."
Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu followed behind Zhang Fei [1] out of those rooms, but they were shocked by the presence of Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong.
"Dragons?"
"Senior Xukong is a void dragon, and my father-in-law is a celestial dragon."
Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu took a deep breath because the void dragon race and the celestial dragon race did not exist in the Three Mortal Realms, and they only existed in the Paradise Realm.
They immediately approached Tianshi Bailong and Long Xukong, paying respect to them.
"Seniors."
"Do you two feel uncomfortable in your bodies?"
Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu exchanged glances for a moment before answering Long Xukong.
"We have never experienced discomfort or pain in our bodies, Senior."
"Is that true?"
Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu nodded to Tianshi Bailong.
"It’s true, Senior.
Our master’s clones wake us up every now and then, and they always take care of our bodies, so our condition never declines.
Besides, they helped us with our cultivation; otherwise, we would never have been able to reach this stage."
Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong observed the two female dragons seriously, but they couldn’t see any negative signs on their complexions, proving that they were completely healthy.
"Do you two want to leave this place?"
"If you two want to leave this place, you can just tell us."
Long Tianzhu and Long Yingwu shook their heads.
"We’ve been here for too long, and we’ve grown accustomed to our situation.
Our master has never treated us badly, even though we’re his prisoners, so we won’t leave."
Long Xukong and Tianshi Bailong glanced at the nonchalant Zhang Fei [1] before sighing in their hearts.
"Since you two don’t feel uncomfortable, and you’re both used to this place, we won’t force you to leave."
"When are you going to release them?" Tianshi Bailong asked Zhang Fei [1].
"When my cultivation reaches the Celestial God Realm." After that, Zhang Fei [1] returned the two female dragons to their room and put them to sleep again.
"When my cultivation has reached that stage, I will no longer need them, and I will send them to your domain."

chapters.title: Chapter 1742: Fourth Meeting With Yuan Xiajie
paragraphs: Since Tianshi Bailong still had many duties in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, Zhang Fei [1] sent him back to the domain, and he replaced his real body to absorb the Yin Qi from the female Yin Demon.
"How long do you think this will take?"

Feng Yao smiled at the impatience on Zhang Fei’s face. "According to my estimation, it will take you a week to completely absorb this female demon’s Yin Qi, and you will know the exact amount of her Yin Qi at that time. In my opinion, you should move her to your other space because the flow of time there is much faster, and Ling’er will help you to restrain her."

"You’re right." Zhang Fei opened a portal to the training space before sending his five clones, Huo Ling, and the female yin demon there. "Senior Xukong, we will return to the Frozen Yin Domain, and you can wait for our return here."
Long Xukong shook his head. "I will go with you two to that domain, and I will use my void element to keep those yin demons away from us."
"Alright then."
Once the three of them returned to the Frozen Yin Domain, the previously thawed area had frozen again, and the bone-chilling cold mist had covered the area once more.
Zhang Fei used his primordial flame to keep the yin demons away from them, and Long Xukong directly enveloped the three of them with his void element. "Let’s meet Yuan Xiajie."
"Let’s go." Feng Yao led Zhang Fei and Long Xukong to Yuan Xiajie’s hiding location in the center of the domain.

The Yin Demons, who were hiding in the mist, tried to attack them, but their attacks couldn’t penetrate Long Xukong’s void element. Apart from them, Zhang Fei and the others saw several other demons trying to attack them, and they fell into the category of ice demons.

"I’ve wanted to obtain the void element for a long time, but the location of the void elemental seed is too troublesome, and Bing Xingying isn’t strong enough to take me there." Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao. "Can you take me to the void core?"

Feng Yao replied with a shake of her head. "The void core is beyond my control because its location is beyond this universe, and Bing Xingying is the only one who can help you get there, so you have no other choice to wait for her to be ready."
"Can I go to that place?" Long Xukong asked.
"You are the void dragon, but you still can’t reach the void core. Unlike you, Bing Xingying is the void spirit, and she can take my husband there in the future."
"The void spirit, huh? Was she the one who helped you create the void barrier in your sect?"
Zhang Fei nodded. "I had Zhe Wuming by my side, but he couldn’t create such a strong void barrier, so Bing Xingying helped me create one."
"I see." Long Xukong nodded in understanding. "Is that woman still far from us?"
"A few miles ahead."
"Okay."
Yuan Xiajie, who was cultivating amidst the Nine Yin Soul Banner, opened her eyes when she sensed the presence of Zhang Fei and the others.

"This aura! There’s no mistake, this aura belongs to that hateful brat! Moreover, I also sensed two other auras by his side, and I feel familiar with one of them! How did he come to this realm?" Yuan Xiajie stood up. "Tch! Since that hateful brat came here, I have to beat him black and blue because he stole all the female demons that I had prepared to smooth my ultimate goal!"
Yuan Xiajie looked around, frowning. If it weren’t for the Nine Yin Soul Banner, the demons in the domain would have attacked her the moment she arrived, so she didn’t dare to go out carelessly.

Just as Yuan Xiajie was thinking about that, Zhang Fei and the others had already arrived in front of the Nine Yin Soul Banner. She froze as soon as she saw Feng Yao, and her body trembled violently, remembering their two meetings several years ago. ’Shit! This hateful brat brought her here!’
"You seem afraid of me, Yuan Xiajie." Feng Yao said with a smile.
’Tch!’ Yuan Xiajie gnashed her teeth as she glared hatefully at Zhang Fei.

Zhang Fei looked at Yuan Xiajie with a relaxed smile. Although he still felt afraid of her, his fear was no longer as severe as it had been during their first meeting, which was thanks to the first soul challenge in the Tower of Eternity. In that challenge, he witnessed the destruction of the Ancient Nether Race, and he also saw the Nightmare Lord, Meng Zhuo. "Long time no see, Yuan Xiajie. A little over six years have passed since our last meeting in the Endless Domain, and I came here specifically to look for you."

"Hmm?" Yuan Xiajie raised an eyebrow, sensing that there was something different about Zhang Fei. During their last meeting in the Endless Domain a little over six years ago, she could see that he was afraid of her, but she couldn’t see his fear anymore. "Why are you looking for me?"
"Three reasons."
"Hmm?"

"First, I came to defeat you; otherwise, my fear of you will never completely disappear. Second, you messed with my woman, and you erased all her memories." Yuan Xiajie wasn’t afraid of Zhang Fei, but she was afraid of Feng Yao. She knew for sure that the woman he was referring to was Wang Yin. "Third, this Nine Yin Soul Banner was supposed to be mine, but you used my woman to snatch it from me."

Yuan Xiajie frowned deeply after Zhang Fei mentioned the past incident. Back then, he brought Wang Yin to the Abyssal Domain, and he defeated all nine demons from the Nine Yin Soul Banner. Before he could take it, she controlled Wang Yin and snatched the banner from him, and she also took the female demon with her before erasing her memories.
"Humph!" Yuan Xiajie snorted. "Do you think you can defeat me with your current strength? If that woman hadn’t appeared to save you from me, I would have killed you the moment we first met."
"Your arrogance will ruin your life." Yuan Xiajie was shocked as soon as Zhang Fei’s cultivation increased to the Celestial Venerable Realm. "Do you think I still can’t defeat you?"

Yuan Xiajie stole a glance at Feng Yao, thinking that she was lending her strength to Zhang Fei. However, she dismissed the thought because she didn’t sense any movement of qi within the female phoenix’s body. ’How could he raise his cultivation that high? Did he use a special technique to do it?’
"I won’t interfere in the fight between the two of you today." Feng Yao nonchalantly said.
Long Xukong didn’t understand Feng Yao’s reasons for not helping Zhang Fei. "I won’t interfere in your fight either."

"By the way, I’m sorry for the deaths of all the members of your Ancient Nether Clan." Yuan Xiajie’s face darkened as soon as Zhang Fei mentioned the most painful memory of her life. "You may not believe me, but I witnessed what happened that night, and—"
"Shut up!" Yuan Xiajie’s aura exploded instantly. "Don’t ever mention members of my race with that foul mouth of yours! You don’t know anything about what happened that day!"
Zhang Fei shook his head slightly before creating a qi screen, which made Yuan Xiajie’s body stiffen. "Do you believe me now? I got these memories by accident, and—"

"Shut up!" Yuan Xiajie was truly enraged, and a pitch-black aura enveloped her body. Gradually, her form transformed into her demon form, just like what Zhang Fei saw in the first soul challenge back then. "At that time, I failed to kill you because of that woman, but I will not fail to kill you this time!"
Zhang Fei raised his right hand, and the primordial flame appeared above his palm.
Yuan Xiajie was shocked to see the flame, and she summoned the nine souls from the Nine Yin Soul Banner, ordering them to attack Zhang Fei.
"These souls are powerful, but they are useless before my flame." Zhang Fei threw the flame, which immediately split into nine and struck the nine souls.

The nine souls released an eerie shriek, and they quickly vanished from sight, causing Yuan Xiajie to spit out a mouthful of blood. She was utterly shocked as Zhang Fei’s flames obliterated the nine souls that she had so painstakingly obtained in the blink of an eye.

Zhang Fei controlled the primordial flame and shot it towards the barrier created by the Nine Yin Soul Banner, forcing Yuan Xiajie to deactivate it and take the ancient artifact away from him. ’Shit! What kind of flame is that? Is that really the Eternal Flame? How did it fall into his hands?’

The demons inhabiting the Frozen Yin Domain tried to attack Yuan Xiajie after the barrier disappeared, but Zhang Fei hurriedly threw the primordial flame in his hand, forming a large circle on the ground that forced them back.

Zhang Fei landed a little distance in front of Yuan Xiajie. "Honestly, I never hated you for what you did to me when we first met, but I was furious because you messed up Wang Yin’s memories several times. Even though she was an undead demon, she was my woman, and you erased her memories with me. Even though our memories weren’t many, they were all precious to us."
"Humph!" Yuan Xiajie stored the banner into her storage ring, and two pitch-black swords appeared in both hands. "Since you came to challenge me, I will kill you today!"
"Do you think you can kill me now?"
"You will surely die by my hands!"
"Let’s fight then."

chapters.title: Chapter 1743: Jiu Tou Sen First Mention
paragraphs: Yuan Xiajie trembled and subconsciously took a step back as the demon extermination sword appeared in Zhang Fei’s right hand. Two auras—red and white—enveloped his body, followed by the appearance of two terrifying silhouettes.
Yuan Xiajie’s pupils constricted, staring at the white silhouette of the nine-tailed fox floating side by side with the red silhouette of a woman.

’A nine-tailed fox? Is that woman’s silhouette the Eternal Flame?’ Yuan Xiajie hadn’t experienced such a feeling of fear in a long time, let alone the feeling coming from a young cultivator who was much younger and weaker than her. Her gaze shifted to the demon extermination sword that was trembling non-stop in Zhang Fei’s grasp. ’What kind of sword is that? Why do I feel that the sword is impatient to kill me?’
Yuan Xiajie’s feelings became messy and complicated after seeing the current Zhang Fei.
At their first meeting, Zhang Fei was still living in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and he was still so weak that Yuan Xiajie could easily suppress him without batting an eye.

Their second meeting occurred in the Abyssal Realm so many years ago. Yuan Xiajie knew that Zhang Fei had become slightly stronger that time, but he was far weaker than the current him. She knew that he wanted the Nine Yin Soul Banner, but she used Wang Yin, who was under her control, to seize it from him.

Their third meeting occurred within the mountain in the Endless Domain several years ago, and Zhang Fei came there to look for Wang Yin. He found her and the four female demons in an unusual condition, but she did not recognize him because Yuan Xiajie had altered their memories.

At that time, Feng Yao appeared to help Zhang Fei, and she forced the female demon to release the five female demons from her control. Yuan Xiajie was truly terrified at that time, and she carried out the female phoenix’s orders by releasing them, which made all her plans fail miserably and she had to start over from scratch.
Yuan Xiajie was bewildered. Her brain couldn’t register Zhang Fei’s progress, which was too fast compared to all the cultivators in the universe.

When they first met about thirteen years ago, Zhang Fei’s cultivation had only recently broken through to the Divine Transcend Realm, but his cultivation had already reached the Celestial Emperor Realm now, and he could increase it to the Celestial Venerable Realm by borrowing the power of other cultivators.
"Daydreaming in front of your enemy?"

Yuan Xiajie was momentarily shocked to hear Zhang Fei’s voice from behind her. She swiftly turned around and attacked him, but unfortunately, her attack only hit his illusion. ’His speed is too fast!’
Zhang Fei appeared a little far away from Yuan Xiajie. "I don’t want to waste my time with you, so I will use my highest techniques now."
In the blink of an eye, a giant golden sword appeared above Zhang Fei, followed by a flurry of petals formed from his sword intent, blooming from nothing.

"What the hell?" Yuan Xiajie was increasingly shocked by Zhang Fei’s two sword techniques. She released her strength to the maximum, and the pitch-black aura surrounding her body grew even thicker. "Shit! I’ll die if I get hit by those two techniques!"
"Are you afraid?" Zhang Fei calmly asked.
"Humph!" Yuan Xiajie snorted. "I’m much stronger and more experienced than you! I will never be afraid of you! Come on! Strike me with your attacks!"
Zhang Fei chuckled lightly before swinging his sword twice. "Final move: Sever the Heavenly Path! Last move: Ashen Bloom!"
In that instant, the giant golden sword above Zhang Fei, followed by the flurry of petals, glided toward Yuan Xiajie.

Yuan Xiajie could feel the terrifying pressure, especially from the giant golden sword. Her eyes widened as the flurry of petals severed everything in its path, giving her a deep sense of dread. She swung the two black swords in her hands, but all her attacks disappeared before they could touch the petals.
Yuan Xiajie flew away from Zhang Fei, but the giant golden sword and the flurry of petals continued to chase him as if they had locked onto her.

Long Xukong, who was watching from a distance, could only be stunned while holding his breath. Next to him, Feng Yao’s lips curled up into an enchanting smile, and the pride on her face could not be hidden.

Yuan Xiajie grew even more frightened when she looked back. She turned her gaze to Zhang Fei, thinking of a way to reverse the situation. She gnashed her teeth, maneuvered, and flew towards him at high speed. "If I must die today, I will take you down to hell with me!"

"Sorry to disappoint you; today is not the day I died but yours." Zhang Fei removed his sword techniques and activated his sword domain, imprisoning Yuan Xiajie within it. Countless white and red swords quickly appeared within it, and they shot towards her simultaneously.

Yuan Xiajie was shocked again by the appearance of those swords. She nimbly counterattacked them while dodging them. However, the swords were simply numerous, which made it difficult for her to dodge them. Within seconds, her body was covered in slashes, and black blood flowed profusely from her wounds, gradually weakening her and slowing her movements.

In her entire life, Yuan Xiajie had never felt death so close, and at that moment, she felt as if she could die at any time. She tried to get close to Zhang Fei to attack him, but all the swords blocked her path. "Since I couldn’t get close to you, I was forced to use a last resort! Even though I can’t take revenge on Meng Zhuo for the death of my entire clan, I will at least take you to death with me!"

After she said that, Yuan Xiajie’s body expanded to several times its true size, and her strength also increased significantly. She looked at Zhang Fei hatefully, but she felt she had no choice but to use that technique to kill him.
’Father! Mother! Brothers! Sisters! Please forgive me for not being able to avenge you, and I will catch up with you all after this.’ Yuan Xiajie swung her two black swords towards Zhang Fei. "Die!"
Long Xukong wanted to move to save Zhang Fei, but Feng Yao immediately stopped him and shook her head at him.

Zhang Fei remained unfazed by Yuan Xiajie’s attack, and the primordial flames enveloped the Demon Extermination Sword. He flew toward her and swung his sword, which immediately clashed with her two swords.
*Crack*

Yuan Xiajie fell into despair as soon as she saw her two black swords broken in half. She sighed in her heart and closed her eyes, waiting for her death. However, the death she awaited never came, and Zhang Fei’s voice rang out. "What a fool! Do you want to die that badly? If you die, how can I restore Wang Yin’s memories?"
Yuan Xiajie opened her eyes and stared at Zhang Fei. "Why? Why didn’t you kill me?"

"Like I said, I need you to restore Wang Yin’s memories." Yuan Xiajie opened her mouth, but no words came out. "Moreover, I never intended to kill you from the start, and I wanted to defeat you to dispel the fear in my heart."
"Why? I already—"

Zhang Fei sighed. "At first, I wanted to kill you after what you did to Wang Yin, but I changed my mind after I saw your past and the destruction of your clan. I realized that you harbored a deep grudge, and you did everything to avenge the deaths of your clan members, so I decided to forgive you."

Yuan Xiajie turned sad as soon as Zhang Fei mentioned her clan members, tears streaming down from her pitch-black eyes. "Sob... There’s only one goal left in my life, and I want to kill Meng Zhuo with my own hands."

Feng Yao flew beside them and spoke to Yuan Xiajie. "Even though your cultivation has reached his level, Meng Zhuo is still too strong for you. He is the Nightmare Lord who has lived long before your clan, and he is one of the cultivators most feared by the Ancients. No matter how hard you try to improve your strength, you will never be able to defeat him, let alone kill him."
"Am...am I really never going to be able to defeat and kill Meng Zhuo?"
"You won’t have a chance for that." Feng Yao glanced at Zhang Fei. "You will never be able to defeat Meng Zhuo, but my husband can defeat him in the future."

Yuan Xiajie looked at Zhang Fei. At first, she believed that he would never be able to reach her level, let alone defeat her. However, the results showed otherwise, and he defeated her without much difficulty.
Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao. "How strong is Meng Zhuo really?"

"In the past, there were ten cultivators who were considered the strongest in this Ancient Realm. The Nightmare Lord was the third strongest, and the Demon God was the fourth strongest. With the disappearance of the strongest cultivator, their ranking automatically rose by one place."
"The strongest cultivator should be Guang Zhiyi, right?"
Feng Yao smiled. "You could say that, but I’ve never cared about that, and I’m more focused on achieving my goals."
"If the Nightmare Lord is the second strongest right now, then who is the strongest among that list?"
"The title of the strongest cultivator in this Ancient Realm is currently held by a demon beast named Jiu Tou Sen, and he comes from the same race as your contract beast, Jiu Shui."
Zhang Fei was surprised to hear that. "You mean Jiu Tou Sen is the Nine-Headed Serpent Beast?"

sentences.text: Yuan Xiajie trembled and subconsciously took a step back as the demon extermination sword appeared in Zhang Fei’s right hand.
Two auras—red and white—enveloped his body, followed by the appearance of two terrifying silhouettes.
Yuan Xiajie’s pupils constricted, staring at the white silhouette of the nine-tailed fox floating side by side with the red silhouette of a woman.
’A nine-tailed fox?

Is that woman’s silhouette the Eternal Flame?’ Yuan Xiajie hadn’t experienced such a feeling of fear in a long time, let alone the feeling coming from a young cultivator who was much younger and weaker than her.
Her gaze shifted to the demon extermination sword that was trembling non-stop in Zhang Fei’s grasp. ’What kind of sword is that?
Why do I feel that the sword is impatient to kill me?’
Yuan Xiajie’s feelings became messy and complicated after seeing the current Zhang Fei.
At their first meeting, Zhang Fei was still living in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, and he was still so weak that Yuan Xiajie could easily suppress him without batting an eye.
Their second meeting occurred in the Abyssal Realm so many years ago.
Yuan Xiajie knew that Zhang Fei had become slightly stronger that time, but he was far weaker than the current him.
She knew that he wanted the Nine Yin Soul Banner, but she used Wang Yin, who was under her control, to seize it from him.
Their third meeting occurred within the mountain in the Endless Domain several years ago, and Zhang Fei came there to look for Wang Yin.
He found her and the four female demons in an unusual condition, but she did not recognize him because Yuan Xiajie had altered their memories.
At that time, Feng Yao appeared to help Zhang Fei, and she forced the female demon to release the five female demons from her control.
Yuan Xiajie was truly terrified at that time, and she carried out the female phoenix’s orders by releasing them, which made all her plans fail miserably and she had to start over from scratch.
Yuan Xiajie was bewildered.
Her brain couldn’t register Zhang Fei’s progress, which was too fast compared to all the cultivators in the universe.

When they first met about thirteen years ago, Zhang Fei’s cultivation had only recently broken through to the Divine Transcend Realm, but his cultivation had already reached the Celestial Emperor Realm now, and he could increase it to the Celestial Venerable Realm by borrowing the power of other cultivators.
"Daydreaming in front of your enemy?"
Yuan Xiajie was momentarily shocked to hear Zhang Fei’s voice from behind her.
She swiftly turned around and attacked him, but unfortunately, her attack only hit his illusion. ’His speed is too fast!’
Zhang Fei appeared a little far away from Yuan Xiajie.
"I don’t want to waste my time with you, so I will use my highest techniques now."
In the blink of an eye, a giant golden sword appeared above Zhang Fei, followed by a flurry of petals formed from his sword intent, blooming from nothing.
"What the hell?" Yuan Xiajie was increasingly shocked by Zhang Fei’s two sword techniques.
She released her strength to the maximum, and the pitch-black aura surrounding her body grew even thicker.
"Shit!
I’ll die if I get hit by those two techniques!"
"Are you afraid?" Zhang Fei calmly asked.
"Humph!" Yuan Xiajie snorted.
"I’m much stronger and more experienced than you!
I will never be afraid of you!
Come on!
Strike me with your attacks!"
Zhang Fei chuckled lightly before swinging his sword twice.
"Final move: Sever the Heavenly Path!
Last move: Ashen Bloom!"
In that instant, the giant golden sword above Zhang Fei, followed by the flurry of petals, glided toward Yuan Xiajie.
Yuan Xiajie could feel the terrifying pressure, especially from the giant golden sword.
Her eyes widened as the flurry of petals severed everything in its path, giving her a deep sense of dread.
She swung the two black swords in her hands, but all her attacks disappeared before they could touch the petals.
Yuan Xiajie flew away from Zhang Fei, but the giant golden sword and the flurry of petals continued to chase him as if they had locked onto her.
Long Xukong, who was watching from a distance, could only be stunned while holding his breath.
Next to him, Feng Yao’s lips curled up into an enchanting smile, and the pride on her face could not be hidden.
Yuan Xiajie grew even more frightened when she looked back.
She turned her gaze to Zhang Fei, thinking of a way to reverse the situation.
She gnashed her teeth, maneuvered, and flew towards him at high speed.
"If I must die today, I will take you down to hell with me!"
"Sorry to disappoint you; today is not the day I died but yours." Zhang Fei removed his sword techniques and activated his sword domain, imprisoning Yuan Xiajie within it.
Countless white and red swords quickly appeared within it, and they shot towards her simultaneously.
Yuan Xiajie was shocked again by the appearance of those swords.
She nimbly counterattacked them while dodging them.
However, the swords were simply numerous, which made it difficult for her to dodge them.
Within seconds, her body was covered in slashes, and black blood flowed profusely from her wounds, gradually weakening her and slowing her movements.
In her entire life, Yuan Xiajie had never felt death so close, and at that moment, she felt as if she could die at any time.
She tried to get close to Zhang Fei to attack him, but all the swords blocked her path.
"Since I couldn’t get close to you, I was forced to use a last resort!
Even though I can’t take revenge on Meng Zhuo for the death of my entire clan, I will at least take you to death with me!"
After she said that, Yuan Xiajie’s body expanded to several times its true size, and her strength also increased significantly.
She looked at Zhang Fei hatefully, but she felt she had no choice but to use that technique to kill him.
’Father!
Mother!
Brothers!
Sisters!
Please forgive me for not being able to avenge you, and I will catch up with you all after this.’ Yuan Xiajie swung her two black swords towards Zhang Fei.
"Die!"
Long Xukong wanted to move to save Zhang Fei, but Feng Yao immediately stopped him and shook her head at him.
Zhang Fei remained unfazed by Yuan Xiajie’s attack, and the primordial flames enveloped the Demon Extermination Sword.
He flew toward her and swung his sword, which immediately clashed with her two swords.
*Crack*
Yuan Xiajie fell into despair as soon as she saw her two black swords broken in half.
She sighed in her heart and closed her eyes, waiting for her death.
However, the death she awaited never came, and Zhang Fei’s voice rang out.
"What a fool!
Do you want to die that badly?
If you die, how can I restore Wang Yin’s memories?"
Yuan Xiajie opened her eyes and stared at Zhang Fei.
"Why?
Why didn’t you kill me?"
"Like I said, I need you to restore Wang Yin’s memories." Yuan Xiajie opened her mouth, but no words came out.
"Moreover, I never intended to kill you from the start, and I wanted to defeat you to dispel the fear in my heart."
"Why?
I already—"
Zhang Fei sighed.
"At first, I wanted to kill you after what you did to Wang Yin, but I changed my mind after I saw your past and the destruction of your clan.
I realized that you harbored a deep grudge, and you did everything to avenge the deaths of your clan members, so I decided to forgive you."
Yuan Xiajie turned sad as soon as Zhang Fei mentioned her clan members, tears streaming down from her pitch-black eyes.
"Sob...
There’s only one goal left in my life, and I want to kill Meng Zhuo with my own hands."
Feng Yao flew beside them and spoke to Yuan Xiajie.
"Even though your cultivation has reached his level, Meng Zhuo is still too strong for you.
He is the Nightmare Lord who has lived long before your clan, and he is one of the cultivators most feared by the Ancients.
No matter how hard you try to improve your strength, you will never be able to defeat him, let alone kill him."
"Am...am I really never going to be able to defeat and kill Meng Zhuo?"
"You won’t have a chance for that." Feng Yao glanced at Zhang Fei.
"You will never be able to defeat Meng Zhuo, but my husband can defeat him in the future."

However, the results showed otherwise, and he defeated her without much difficulty.

chapters.title: Chapter 1744: The Sky Dragon Bloodline
paragraphs: Feng Yao nodded. "Jiu Tou Sen is indeed the Nine-Headed Serpent Beast, and he is truly powerful. The current Long Wuzhao and the others will never be able to defeat him. Unlike Jiu Shui, he is a mature ancient beast, and he already has nine heads."
Zhang Fei was concerned about Jiu Shui because he was still too young compared to Jiu Tou Sen, and he only had four heads despite cultivating in the beast space for decades.

"I know your thoughts, but the Nine-Headed Serpent Beasts are different from other beasts, and it is difficult for them to reach maturity, so you don’t need to be surprised if Jiu Shui is still weak." Zhang Fei smiled wryly because there were still so many things he didn’t know. "When he is fully mature and has nine heads, he will become your strongest beast contract."
Yuan Xiajie looked at Feng Yao in shock, not expecting that she was the reincarnation of Guang Zhiyi. ’No wonder she’s really scary.’
"So, are the other cultivators on the list still alive?"

"Six of them are dead." Zhang Fei, Long Xukong, and Yuan Xiajie were all shocked. "Besides Meng Zhuo, Mo Qingwei, and Jiu Tou Sen, only Long Yunxi remains among the cultivators on the list. Six new cultivators have joined the list, but their strength is far inferior to the previous six. Their strength is only slightly above Puyang Shenmi, so the list is no longer valid."
"If that’s the case, we should call them the four strongest cultivators, right?"
"Yes." Feng Yao agreed with Long Xukong. "By the way, Long Yunxi is the only member of the demihuman race on that list."
"Oh?" Zhang Fei’s eyes sparkled, making Feng Yao smile in amusement. "Is Long Yunxi that powerful that her name is on the list?"
"Hahaha," Feng Yao laughed out loud. "Compared to all the members of the demihuman race you know, Long Yunxi is truly powerful. Otherwise, she wouldn’t be able to get her name on the list, right?"
"What’s her bloodline?"
"The Sky Dragon Bloodline."
Zhang Fei remembered that Long Huoyan possessed the flame dragon bloodline, but in his opinion, his demihuman form wasn’t particularly appealing.
"The sky dragon bloodline? Does that mean the beasts still exist in this realm?" Long Xukong asked with a look of excitement, as there was no sky dragon race in the Paradise Realm.

Feng Xiao’s next words dashed Long Xukong’s hopes. "The sky dragon race has long been extinct, and Long Yunxi is the last possessor of their bloodline. If she dies, their bloodline will disappear forever."
"Sigh." Long Xukong sighed in disappointment. "Did the sky dragon race also become extinct because of the past disaster?"

"The past disaster changed the Ancient Realm completely, and many races became extinct because of that incident, leaving only a small number of people and races remaining here." Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei. ’If I think about it, Long Yuxi should be the representative of the demihuman race.’

Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow slightly. ’Luo Yunxiao is the representative of the human race, Xu Ling’er is the representative of the winged race, Jia Yuyan is the representative of the natural race, Tianshi Shengjie is the representative of the beast race, and Long Yuxi is the representative of the demihuman race. As for the representative of the demon race, that person should be the woman in the Lotus Limbo World, right?’
’Yes,’ Feng Yao replied with a nod. ’You can’t enter the Lotus Limbo World now, and you have to be patient until you evolve into the ten-tailed fox first.’
Zhang Fei inwardly sighed. "So, where does Long Yuxi live?"
"She—"

"Kid! You already have more than a hundred wives, but you are still looking for another woman." Long Xukong spoke in a displeased tone, particularly because Zhang Fei was set to marry Tianshi Shengjie in three days.

Zhang Fei smirked. "I am a lust demon and a dragon; what can you expect from me? A dragon and a lust demon are the most lustful creatures, and I am a combination of both, so you shouldn’t be surprised if I am more lustful than both."
"You! You are truly hopeless!" Long Xukong fumed.

Yuan Xiajie was truly shocked to hear that Zhang Fei had more than a hundred wives, but she was astonished by his two identities as a lust demon and a dragon. "What do you mean by you are a lust demon and a dragon?"
"Literally." Zhang Fei showed his four forms to Yuan Xiajie, which blew her mind. "Have you seen it all? I am a human, a lust demon, a heavenly fox, and a dragon."
"No wonder your strength is so terrifying, and it only took you around thirteen years to defeat me." Yuan Xiajie muttered as he looked at Zhang Fei.
"What? Are you interested in me now?" Zhang Fei teased her.
"Humph!" Yuan Xiajie snorted. "I don’t know what all your wives see in you that makes them willing to marry you, but I will never be interested in a playboy like you!"
"Why don’t you ask my wife directly?" Zhang Fei pointed at Feng Yao.
Yuan Xiajie was stunned for a moment; she just remembered that Feng Yao addressed Zhang Fei as her husband. "Why are you willing to accept a man like him?"

"Because no man is worthy of being my husband except him." Yuan Xiajie glanced at Zhang Fei, unwilling to believe that there was no man better than him. "You don’t know him yet, so you still doubt my words. Once you get to know him better, you’ll know the truth of my words. Anyway, Long Yunxi lives in solitude at the edge of the Ancient Realm, and it will take us several months to arrive at her place. Besides, she is in deep sleep now, so we will meet her in the future."
"Alright then." Zhang Fei was also in no rush to meet Long Yunxi, and he preferred to focus on other things first. "I will take you to meet Wang Yin, and I want you to recover her past memories."
"Is the female undead demon that important to you?" Yuan Xiajie felt strange about it because Wang Yin only had a body but not a soul.
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded solemnly. "You may see her as nothing more than a tool for revenge, but she is my woman, and all my women are important to me."
"Bring me to her, and I will restore her memories."
"Let’s go." Zhang Fei brought Feng Yao, Long Xukong, and Yuan Xiajie into the Yin-Yang Space. "Wait for a while."

"Alright." When Yuan Xiajie saw the glass tube in the middle of the room, her interest piqued, and she immediately approached it. She touched it and felt the contents inside. "This! Is the content of this tube really Yin Qi?"

"That’s right." Zhang Fei walked to Yuan Xiajie’s side. "The Yin Qi inside this glass tube comes from the female prisoners in those rooms. In fact, I once considered imprisoning you here if I managed to defeat you, but I changed my mind after witnessing your past."

Yuan Xiajie said nothing, and she checked all the rooms around the area, finding several female cultivators asleep in some of them. She could see their Yin Qi coming out of their bodies, flowing directly into the glass tube. "I didn’t expect you to be so cruel! You imprisoned them here, and you also harvested their Yin Qi."
"They are my enemies, so I don’t need to be merciful to them. If I hadn’t witnessed your past, you would have suffered the same fate as them."

Yuan Xiajie fiercely glared at Zhang Fei, but she did not say anything to him. Previously, she had prepared to die at his hands, but he didn’t kill her. She turned around as the portal opened, and five familiar female demons walked in.

Wang Yin, Nong Qinhua, Bian Luosha, Yan Huanying, and Dong Binghua froze in place the moment they saw Yuan Xiajie. They remembered that she had been ordering them, and she also altered their memories.

Yuan Xiajie inwardly sighed after seeing the five female demons again. In the past, she prepared them to become her weapons against Meng Zhuo, but all her plans fell apart because of Zhang Fei and Feng Yao.
"Zhang Fei."
"It’s okay, you don’t need to be afraid of her." Zhang Fei walked to Wang Yin’s side. "I brought her here to restore your memories, and you’ll be able to remember our old memories again."

"Will I really be able to remember our old memories later?" Wang Yin’s eyes lit up with excitement. More than six years had passed since Zhang Fei rescued her from Yuan Xiajie, and they had built many new memories since then. However, she still felt like something was missing from her, and she always harbored the hope of regaining her past memories.

"I would rather not recall my past memories." Nong Qinhua’s life had changed since Zhang Fei saved her and the others, and she had long since accepted her new life, so she would rather not remember the past anymore.
Bian Luosha thought for a moment. "I don’t want to remember my past memories anymore, and I’m satisfied with my current life."
Bian Luosha remembered Zhang Fei once saying that they were enemies when they lived in the Sovereign Heaven Realm, so she didn’t want to remember everything for fear they would become enemies again.
"What about you two?" Zhang Fei asked Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua.

On the one hand, Yan Huanying and Dong Binghua wanted to remember all their old memories, but on the other hand, they were already satisfied with their current lives, so they were hesitant to make a decision. "Zhang Fei, the past is over, so we don’t want to remember everything that’s gone."

chapters.title: Chapter 1745: Wang Jingzhi - Xian Xianqin
paragraphs: Since the three female demons would rather not recall their past memories, Zhang Fei didn’t force them.
Yuan Xiajie walked before Wang Yin, and a black light appeared as soon as she touched her forehead. A while later, she pulled back her hand. "It’s done."

Wang Yin closed her eyes, letting all the old and new memories merge into one. After a few minutes, she looked at Zhang Fei with a blush on her cheeks. "I never thought I’d ever do something like that, and we ended up in bed."

"Everything has happened, right?" Zhang Fei naturally remembered the past incident when he went to see Wang Yin in her realm after a long absence. At that time, he didn’t have any feelings for her because she was an undead demon, but she turned into an infatuated woman because Yuan Xiajie altered her memories, and they ended up in bed for several days. "Even though we didn’t have that kind of relationship before that day, you were my woman from then on."
"Mhmm." Wang Yin hugged Zhang Fei. "Thank you! All those memories are very important to me, and I would never have been able to remember them all without your help."
Zhang Fei hugged Wang Yin back. "I’m happy if you’re happy, Yin’er. I’ll send the four of you back to the sect now, and I’ll be heading to the Myriad Abyss Domain after this."
"Alright! I’ll wait for you to come back."
Wang Yin and three other female demons immediately returned to the Moonlit Passion Temple after Zhang Fei opened the gate.
"Are you really going to the Myriad Abyss Domain?"

Zhang Fei closed the gate and looked at Yuan Xiajie. "My demon wives, who are stuck in the Empress Realm, number many. The materials needed to upgrade their ranks are extremely rare in the Paradise Realm, so I have to go to the Myriad Abyss Domain to find them."

"I will go with you to the Myriad Abyss Domain because I am quite familiar with the situation in that domain, and I am closely acquainted with a demon god there. We can ask her for help in gathering those materials; I am sure she can gather them faster." Yuan Xiajie decided without a second thought.
"A female demon god?"
"Are you thinking about seducing her?"

Zhang Fei shook his head. "I told you that not every woman is worthy of joining my harem, let alone women I don’t know. If it were easy for me to take women into my harem, I would have thousands or even tens of thousands of women by my side by now."

"That’s true." Yuan Xiajie believed that with Zhang Fei’s abilities, it wouldn’t be difficult for him to obtain that many women. Never mind thousands or tens of thousands; she believed he could obtain hundreds of thousands of women if he wanted. "Let’s go now! The journey to the Myriad Abyss Domain takes two months."
Inside the void, Long Xukong had already returned to his dragon form and was flying away at high speed, following the direction indicated by Feng Yao.
"Xiajie, lend me the Nine Yin Soul Banner."
Yuan Xiajie raised an eyebrow. "Do you want the Nine Yin Soul Banner? Unfortunately, the banner has already recognized me as its master, so you won’t be able to use it."

"I just want to see it." Yun Xiajie took out the Nine Yin Soul Banner and handed it to Zhang Fei. The banner resisted in his hand, but it calmed down as soon as Feng Yao lightly touched it. "Since I’ve destroyed the nine demon souls, I’ll help you obtain nine new ones, and we should be able to search for them in the Myriad Abyss Domain."
Yuan Xiajie nodded. "We can do that, but we can’t act recklessly there. If we act recklessly, we’ll incur the wrath of those demon gods, and we’ll face even greater danger if we provoke Mo Qingwen."
"I want to meet Mo Qingwen, but we won’t be meeting him right away, and I want to focus on getting those demon materials first."

Yuan Xiajie stole a glance at Feng Yao, but the latter hadn’t mentioned anything about Zhang Fei wanting to accompany Mo Qingwen, so she didn’t comment on it either. She accepted the Nine Yin Soul Banner and stored it in her storage ring. "What are your next plans after leaving the Myriad Abyss Domain?"
"I haven’t thought about my next plan yet, and I will take one step at a time." Zhang Fei looked at Feng Yao. "What do you think, Yao’er?"

"You will marry Tianshi Shengjie in three days, so we should go back first, and we will continue our journey after that." Zhang Fei agreed with Feng Yao. After all, Long Xukong was one of the leaders of the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, so he had to attend the wedding. "Besides, we will probably be spending a lot of time in the Myriad Abyss Domain, so you don’t need to rush your next plans."
Zhang Fei pondered a few things, especially regarding all the female demons by his side. "Do you think I should bring Zhang Lin and the others to the Myriad Abyss Domain?"

"Although there are many demon gods in the Myriad Abyss Domain, the situation there isn’t as bad as you imagine. Besides, Zhang Lin and the others are demons, and they’ll benefit greatly if you bring them there."

"With you and Ling’er protecting them, I don’t have to worry about their safety, and I’ll let them train there for a while." Then, Zhang Fei asked Yuan Xiajie. "Can you contact that female demon god?"
"I can."
"Please contact her and ask her to find a remote residence for dozens of people."
"Alright." Yuan Xiajie hurriedly contacted the female demon god and conveyed Zhang Fei’s request to her. "Let’s wait for now."
Feng Yao suddenly burned her dress and Zhang Fei’s clothes, which shocked Yuan Xiajie.

Yuan Xiajie gulped hard as soon as she saw Zhang Fei’s naked body, especially when she looked at his lower body. She hurriedly closed her eyes, and her heart fluttered uncontrollably, seeing a naked man for the first time. ’Tch! This Guang Zhiyi is truly shameless! Her current behavior is completely different from her past cold behavior!’
Feng Yao chuckled at Yuan Xiajie’s reaction. "You don’t have to be so shy, you know? You can join us if you want, and your first experience will definitely be satisfying."
"Humph!" Yuan Xiajie snorted and ignored her.
Feng Yao said nothing more and began her sexual activity with Zhang Fei, which tormented Yuan Xiajie for a long time.
At the Moonlit Passion Temple.
Wang Jingzhi and Xian Xianqin are opposite each other. "I heard from your husband that the Sky-Severing Sword is in your hand, Xianqin. Can you summon it now?"
"Sure." Xian Xianqin summoned the sword. "Do you want to hold my sword?"
"No," Wang Jingzhi summoned the Mirror of Eternity, which surprised Xian Xianqin.
Ling and Zhi Jing immediately came out of the two artifacts.
"Ling!"
"Jing!"
Ling and Zhi Jing shouted in joy before hugging each other.
"Hahaha! I didn’t expect we would meet again after so long, Ling!" Zhi Jing said.
Ling nodded slightly. "I didn’t know that you had already chosen your master, Jing."
"Hehe," Zhi Jing rubbed his nose. "I met my master at the Tower of Eternity several decades ago, and I have followed him ever since."
"I see." Ling nodded in understanding. "I met my master in the Forbidden Land a few years ago."
Zhi Jing looked at Xian Xianqin. "I’m confused as to why you chose her as your master, Ling. You should have chosen her as your husband."

"My master’s husband possesses the Demon Extermination Sword, and that sword possesses twin sword spirits, so I chose his wife as my master." Ling looked at Xian Xianqin. "Moreover, my master is not bad, and she has mastered the Heaven-Severing Sword Technique to such a degree. She has been able to maximize the sword’s capabilities, so I am completely satisfied with that."
Zhi Jing was dissatisfied with Ling’s choice because Xian Xianqin was inferior to Zhang Fei, but he chose not to say anything. "Master, I will go with Ling first!"
"Alright." After Wang Jingzhi agreed, Ling and Zhi Jing went together to another area of the sect. "Xianqin, are you able to use the sword to its full potential?"

"Yes," Xian Xianqin nodded. "Unlike the other Seven Profound Treasures, all the functions of the Sky-Severing Sword are unlocked from the start, and Ling helped me use the sword to its full potential. However, there are some functions that drain my qi, so I can’t use it for too long, and I have to wait until my cultivation breaks through again."
Wang Jingzhi wasn’t surprised by this because he hadn’t been able to use the Mirror of Eternity’s full potential due to the seals within it. "Can I ask you something personal?"
"Are your questions related to my husband?" Xian Xianqin guessed immediately.
"Yes," Wang Jingzhi admitted. "I heard from Qing Qiu’er that you were once a princess, but you chose to abandon everything to follow Zhang Fei."

Xian Xianqin smiled. "Before I met my husband, I felt my status as a princess was extraordinary, but I started to change after getting to know him. Besides, I didn’t abandon everything, and my family lives in this sect."
"Oh? Does your family really live in this sect?"
"That’s true." Xian Xianqin rose to his feet. "If you want to know more about my husband, you can follow me, and I will introduce you to my sisters."
Wang Jingzhi glanced at the barrier not far from them, and she knew that Zhang Fei’s residence was within it. "Alright."

chapters.title: Chapter 1746: Grand Wedding I
paragraphs: Wang Jingzhi knew that Zhang Fei had more than a hundred wives, but she was truly shocked after seeing their beauty. Each of them possessed incomparable beauty, which made her jealous of them.
Xian Xianqin introduced Wang Jingzhi to Zhang Fei’s other women, and her words indicated that the woman would be part of their extended family one day.

Since there was such a sign, they invited Wang Jingzhi to live with them so they could grow closer more quickly. Initially, she refused their request, but they insisted that she stay with them, and she eventually agreed to their request.
Two days passed quickly.

Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding preparations were complete, and they would hold their grand wedding tomorrow. His clones brought all of his women and their families to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and Tianshi Bailong ordered members of the Celestial Race to escort them to a specially prepared location.
All members of the beast races felt uncomfortable with the presence of female demons, especially demon gods such as Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, Nalan Shizhe, and Dong Xuanyin.
Long Wuzhao and Tianshi Bailong calmed them down and explained to them that Qi Qingxiu and Ye Mingran were Zhang Fei’s wives, Dong Xuanyin was his future wife, and Nalan Shizhe was his mother-in-law.
The majority of the members of the beast races didn’t know about Zhang Fei’s relationship with the four female gods; Long Wuzhao’s explanation sparked a stir in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.

Not to mention that Nalan Yushu and Nalan Wangzi were Zhang Fei’s wives, and Sha Qingge was his future wife. They also recognized Mo Zainan, and they remembered that she was the empress of the Celestial Demon Race, so they didn’t expect her to join their group. As for Shang Xueli, their relationship was gray, mainly because of his desire to defeat Shang Zhanluo.

The presence of Puyang Yeyu was the most shocking for all residents of the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, especially after Long Wuzhao introduced her as a member of the Puyang Clan in the Ancient Realm.

The majority of people in the Paradise Realm never knew about the Ancient Realm, and there was no information that recorded the existence of that realm, but none of them dared to doubt Long Wuzhao’s words. The source? The golden dragon emperor said that Zhang Fei was the one who brought Puyang Yeyu to their realm, and she was his future wife.
Since they were guests and would become their family, the Celestial Dragon Race hosted all of Zhang Fei’s wives, led by Tianshi Bailong and Tianshi Lingyue.
Inside the void.

Yuan Xiajie sat outside the barrier, on top of Long Xukong’s head, to be precise. She was uncomfortable being inside the barrier because Zhang Fei and Feng Yao had been dual cultivating non-stop for the past two days, and Huo Ling also decided to join them.

Long Xukong himself was bored because he was flying in the void alone, and Yuan Xiajie’s presence was enough to relieve his boredom. The two of them talked extensively about the Ancient Realm, which cultivators from the Paradise Realm never knew about.
In a domain.
Huang Tianzhun and Ouyang Xuening stood side by side, but their expressions were horrifying.
"I didn’t expect that Zhang Fei would marry the Celestial Dragon Princess tomorrow, and he invited all races to attend their wedding."

Ouyang Xuening asked Huang Tianzhun. "Are we still going to continue searching for the location of the Twin Flames Domain? With their marriage, we will face trouble with the beast race if we attack the sect and kill Zhang Fei, and we won’t be able to face the wrath of Tianshi Bailong and Long Wuzhao."

"Mhmm," Huang Tianzhun grunted. "Where exactly did Zhang Fei get his gate ability? We’ve been searching for the Twin Flames Domain for almost four months, and people from both our clans have been searching for it as well. Unfortunately, we haven’t been able to find it, but he can travel freely between all domains using his ability. By the way, do they know the identity of your spy in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain?"

Ouyang Xuening shook her head. "My Ouyang Clan’s spy in that domain is a beast that was saved by my grandfather, and no one suspects him, so his position is still safe now. Should we send people to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain?"

"No need," Huang Tianzhun sighed. "If we send our men there, Long Wuzhao will definitely be displeased, and he will come to our sect with Zhang Fei’s assistance. People recognize him as the strongest cultivator in the Paradise Realm for a reason, you know? Even if everyone from the Huang and Ouyang Clans join forces to fight him, we will never win against him, and we might have to beg him for mercy. Besides, you forgot about that damn woman, and she’s even more terrifying than the Golden Dragon Emperor. Her relationship with that kid is no joke, and she’ll destroy both of our clans if she gets angry."
"Does that mean we will give up on killing Zhang Fei?"

"Zhang Fei’s marriage to the Celestial Dragon Princess was beyond my calculations, and our chances of killing him will be even slimmer after tomorrow." Huang Tianzhun wore a disappointed expression. "Even so, we still need to find the location of the Twin Flames Domain so we can think of another way to kill him."
"Let’s go then."
"Alright."
At the Celestial Demon Palace.

Mo Shentian, who had just arrived at his seclusion chamber, was shocked when he couldn’t find the fake Shang Yueli and the others. He ran to the underground palace, but he couldn’t find the fake Mo Zainan there either.
"Bastard!" Mo Shentian was furious after discovering all his tools were missing, and he ransacked the place for quite some time. After his anger subsided a little, he went to see his master.
Mo Zhejun told Mo Shentian that he didn’t see any intruders in their domain, and he also said that he didn’t pay attention to the situation in the palace while he was away.

After a fruitless discussion, Mo Shentian left his master’s place and contacted his three sons. They should have arrived in the Endless Domain three months ago, but they hadn’t reported to him. He grew increasingly furious when they didn’t answer his calls, and he considered going to the domain himself.

Thereafter, Mo Shentian contacted his five trusted aides, but their answers made him even more furious because they still hadn’t managed to find the other demon domains after being gone for so long. However, he didn’t know that there was an invisible factor that was deliberately hindering them, and that factor was Feng Yao.
As the embodiment of the core of the universe, it was too easy for Feng Yao to obstruct Mo Shentian’s five trusted aides, and she did so after the incident in Qi Qingxiu’s demon domain some time ago.
In the end, Mo Shentian decided to leave his domain and head to the Endless Domain.

Wu Mian, who was using another body in the domain, naturally learned of Mo Shentian’s departure. He immediately reported the matter to Zhang Fei, but he didn’t want to dwell on it because tomorrow was his wedding day with Tianshi Shengjie, and he would take care of the matter after the celestial demon god arrived in the Endless Domain.
As the day passed midnight,
Long Xukong stopped flying, and Zhang Fei led them into the Yin-Yang Space. He left one of his clones inside so they could continue their journey after his wedding with Tianshi Shengjie was over.
At first, Yuan Xiajie didn’t want to attend the wedding, but Zhang Fei forced her to join them, to which she eventually agreed.

When they arrived at the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, the wedding area was fully prepared. The workers from the beast race had neatly arranged thousands of tables and chairs, and they were working on the final touches.
Long Xukong returned to the Void Dragon Palace to prepare.

As the groom, Zhang Fei went to the Celestial Dragon Palace to prepare himself. Meanwhile, one of his clones brought Feng Yao back to the Blazing Nirvana Domain, but they didn’t stay there for long, and she led her prepared subordinates straight to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.

After Zhang Fei cleaned himself up, the people from the Celestial Dragon Race helped him to dress up. Meanwhile, his four other clones went to several domains, such as the Empyrean Domain and others, to pick up his wedding guests. Although the wedding was still a long way off, he felt it would be better if the people arrived earlier, so the event could start on time.

Zhang Fei invited everyone from the Empyrean Domain, led by his father-in-law, Luo Fenghan. As for the people from the Twin Flames Domain, he brought everyone from the Moonlit Passion Temple and those from clans closely related to him.
As for the people from the demon races, Zhang Fei only brought the closest people from Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, Nalan Shizhe, Sha Mo, Jiu Moze, Jiu Mozu, Wu Mian, and Ku Shenzu.

All natural races were also present, but each race was only represented by its kings, queens, and elders. At first, Zhang Fei considered bringing more people, but he thought their numbers were too great.

The members of the beast race didn’t recognize the people from the Puyang Clan, but many of them recognized the people from the Xuanyuan Clan. Their presence caused even more commotion in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and they wondered how Zhang Fei had brought those people out of the Forbidden Realm.

The presence of Long Huoyan and his two wives, who led the demihuman race, also received significant attention. As for the members of the winged race, they are represented by Tian Yizu and several grand elders who are in the same group as them. As for Tian Yaoqin, she naturally joined Zhang Fei’s wives’ group.

"My Ouyang Clan’s spy in that domain is a beast that was saved by my grandfather, and no one suspects him, so his position is still safe now.
Should we send people to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain?"
"No need," Huang Tianzhun sighed.
"If we send our men there, Long Wuzhao will definitely be displeased, and he will come to our sect with Zhang Fei’s assistance.
People recognize him as the strongest cultivator in the Paradise Realm for a reason, you know?
Even if everyone from the Huang and Ouyang Clans join forces to fight him, we will never win against him, and we might have to beg him for mercy.
Besides, you forgot about that damn woman, and she’s even more terrifying than the Golden Dragon Emperor.
Her relationship with that kid is no joke, and she’ll destroy both of our clans if she gets angry."
"Does that mean we will give up on killing Zhang Fei?"
"Zhang Fei’s marriage to the Celestial Dragon Princess was beyond my calculations, and our chances of killing him will be even slimmer after tomorrow." Huang Tianzhun wore a disappointed expression.
"Even so, we still need to find the location of the Twin Flames Domain so we can think of another way to kill him."
"Let’s go then."
"Alright."
At the Celestial Demon Palace.
Mo Shentian, who had just arrived at his seclusion chamber, was shocked when he couldn’t find the fake Shang Yueli and the others.
He ran to the underground palace, but he couldn’t find the fake Mo Zainan there either.
"Bastard!" Mo Shentian was furious after discovering all his tools were missing, and he ransacked the place for quite some time.
After his anger subsided a little, he went to see his master.
Mo Zhejun told Mo Shentian that he didn’t see any intruders in their domain, and he also said that he didn’t pay attention to the situation in the palace while he was away.
After a fruitless discussion, Mo Shentian left his master’s place and contacted his three sons.
They should have arrived in the Endless Domain three months ago, but they hadn’t reported to him.
He grew increasingly furious when they didn’t answer his calls, and he considered going to the domain himself.
Thereafter, Mo Shentian contacted his five trusted aides, but their answers made him even more furious because they still hadn’t managed to find the other demon domains after being gone for so long.
However, he didn’t know that there was an invisible factor that was deliberately hindering them, and that factor was Feng Yao.
As the embodiment of the core of the universe, it was too easy for Feng Yao to obstruct Mo Shentian’s five trusted aides, and she did so after the incident in Qi Qingxiu’s demon domain some time ago.
In the end, Mo Shentian decided to leave his domain and head to the Endless Domain.
Wu Mian, who was using another body in the domain, naturally learned of Mo Shentian’s departure.

He immediately reported the matter to Zhang Fei, but he didn’t want to dwell on it because tomorrow was his wedding day with Tianshi Shengjie, and he would take care of the matter after the celestial demon god arrived in the Endless Domain.
As the day passed midnight,
Long Xukong stopped flying, and Zhang Fei led them into the Yin-Yang Space.
He left one of his clones inside so they could continue their journey after his wedding with Tianshi Shengjie was over.
At first, Yuan Xiajie didn’t want to attend the wedding, but Zhang Fei forced her to join them, to which she eventually agreed.
When they arrived at the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, the wedding area was fully prepared.
The workers from the beast race had neatly arranged thousands of tables and chairs, and they were working on the final touches.
Long Xukong returned to the Void Dragon Palace to prepare.
As the groom, Zhang Fei went to the Celestial Dragon Palace to prepare himself.

Meanwhile, one of his clones brought Feng Yao back to the Blazing Nirvana Domain, but they didn’t stay there for long, and she led her prepared subordinates straight to the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain.
After Zhang Fei cleaned himself up, the people from the Celestial Dragon Race helped him to dress up.
Meanwhile, his four other clones went to several domains, such as the Empyrean Domain and others, to pick up his wedding guests.
Although the wedding was still a long way off, he felt it would be better if the people arrived earlier, so the event could start on time.
Zhang Fei invited everyone from the Empyrean Domain, led by his father-in-law, Luo Fenghan.
As for the people from the Twin Flames Domain, he brought everyone from the Moonlit Passion Temple and those from clans closely related to him.
As for the people from the demon races, Zhang Fei only brought the closest people from Ye Mingran, Qi Qingxiu, Nalan Shizhe, Sha Mo, Jiu Moze, Jiu Mozu, Wu Mian, and Ku Shenzu.
All natural races were also present, but each race was only represented by its kings, queens, and elders.
At first, Zhang Fei considered bringing more people, but he thought their numbers were too great.
The members of the beast race didn’t recognize the people from the Puyang Clan, but many of them recognized the people from the Xuanyuan Clan.
Their presence caused even more commotion in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and they wondered how Zhang Fei had brought those people out of the Forbidden Realm.
The presence of Long Huoyan and his two wives, who led the demihuman race, also received significant attention.
As for the members of the winged race, they are represented by Tian Yizu and several grand elders who are in the same group as them.
As for Tian Yaoqin, she naturally joined Zhang Fei’s wives’ group.

chapters.title: Chapter 1747: Grand Wedding II
paragraphs: As all the guests had gathered and the auspicious hour was approaching, the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, which was already filled with people, became even more crowded as hundreds of beasts from all beast races flew in the sky in their beast forms.

Dozens of fire phoenixes, ice phoenixes, celestial dragons, and various other beasts use their respective elements to entertain the guests. The guests continued to hear explosions resembling fireworks. The Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, once bright, now shines even brighter.

As arranged by Tianshi Bailong and Tianshi Lingyue, all of Zhang Fei’s wives and their families were at the forefront along with Long Wuzhao, members of the Celestial Dragon Race, the people from the Xuanyuan and Puyang Clans, and the nine overseers.
The guests from the human races, the beast races, the natural races, the demon races, the winged race, and the demihuman race are placed in the central area of the weeding area.
Meanwhile, the back row was filled with people from the beast races, eagerly awaiting the couple’s arrival. Today would be the most special day in the Paradise Realm, so they didn’t want to miss it.

All the members of the Moonlit Passion Temple were present there because Zhang Fei was their true leader. The Celestial Moon Sect is represented by the female elders because Yue Xuelian and Yue Qianrou joined with his other wives. Dongfang Yuechan, Lan Xuening, Yun Chang, and Nong Qinwei led the members of the Hidden Moon Sect. The Qing, You, Zhang, and several other clans led the group from the Twin Flames Domain.
The Xuanyuan Clan was represented by Xuanyuan Zhuanxu and the five ancestors, and they brought some members of their clan to see the merriment of Zhang Fei’s wedding.
The Puyang Clan was represented by Puyang Shangren, Puyang Zong, and several other members. Puyang Shenmi chose not to attend because their clan was still facing attacks from those shadowy creatures.

Luo Fenghan and Huang Xiaoyi represented the Immortal Lotus Sanctuary, accompanied by their two sons, two daughters-in-law, and two grandchildren. Apart from them, people from the Empyrean Domain were also present there.
As for the demon races, they were led by several demon gods, such as Wu Mian, Sha Mo, Sha Yuan, Jiu Moze, Jiu Mozu, and Ku Shenzu.
The demihuman race was led by Long Huoyan and his two wives. All the natural races were led by their kings and queens.
The winged race was led by Tian Yizu, Tian Wei, and several other grand elders.
"Such a grand wedding!" One of the overseers, Hui Chen, exclaimed.
Wang Jinyang agreed. "Tianshi Bailong didn’t hold back for his daughter’s marriage."
"Isn’t this grand wedding Zhang Fei’s idea?" Jing Ruzhi asked.
"That’s true." Shen Jinyue nodded slightly. "Zhang Fei seems to have decided to no longer be as low-key as before, and he planned this grand wedding to announce his existence."

"Hehe," Feng Jinhuang chuckled. "With the strength of those around him, it would be strange if Zhang Fei chose to remain low-key, right? Even Empress Huo was already one of his wives, so I thought that no one would dare to deal with him anymore, let alone become his enemy."

The other four overseers did not say anything, but they agreed with Feng Jinhuang’s words. They didn’t want to admit it, but they were aware that Zhang Fei had become the strongest and most popular figure in the Paradise Realm given his connections with all races.
However, one of the overseers wore a dark look, and his eyes kept moving as if he were waiting for something.
As void cultivators, Long Wuzhao assigned Nu Liexi and Kong Bai to protect the couple and their families if there was sudden danger.

When the auspicious hour arrived, the guests cheered with joy as they saw a nine-tailed fox flying alongside a giant white dragon from the Celestial Dragon Palace, followed by Tianshi Bailong, Tianshi Lingyue, and four humans flying slightly behind them.
The sight of a fox and a dragon flying side by side gave guests a strange feeling. They were from different races, yet they were husband and wife, which sounds quite absurd.

As soon as they approached the main wedding platform, they immediately transformed into their human forms. Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie landed side by side, followed by Tianshi Bailon, Tianshi Lingyue, Zhang Chen, Qing Yi, Zhang Yue, and Zhang Lin.
Even though Zhang Chen, Qing Yi, Zhang Yue, and Zhang Lin were Zhang Fei’s wives, they were still members of his family, so they were worthy to stand beside the couple.
Zhang Fei took Tianshi Shengjie by the hand, and the two of them thanked all their wedding guests. Afterward, their wedding ceremony began, presided over by an elder of the Celestial Dragon Race.

Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie’s wedding ceremony didn’t last long—about half an hour. After the ceremony, the members of the beast race immediately brought out all the dishes, which had been prepared by Zhu Yan and the chefs from the groom’s Sky Jade Restaurant.
The wedding banquet was held with great fanfare, and Zhang Fei led Tianshi Shengjie to meet all the important guests of their wedding, especially the members of the Puyang Clan and the natural races.

Zhang Fei breathed a sigh of relief after the notifications appeared. The quests had been appearing since he ascended to the Paradise Realm, and he had established good relationships with many cultivators from all races, but they had remained unfinished for decades. ’Your guess was proven correct, Mei.’
[Hehe! I also didn’t expect those quests to be completed at your wedding with Tianshi Shengjie, Master. At first, I was just guessing, but the results have been proven now.]
After they met the important guests, Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie returned to their seats to enjoy their wedding dishes. "Are you happy, my little dragon princess?"
"I’m really happy." Tianshi Shengjie nodded with a smile. "I’ve been looking forward to my wedding day for a long time, but I didn’t expect you to hold such a grand wedding for me."
Zhang Fei smiled. "You are the Celestial Dragon Princess, so I can’t possibly give you a simple wedding, right? If I do that, all races will mock you and your race, so I did all this."
"Hehe," Tianshi Shengjie giggled. "I thought you never thought about your reputation and prestige, husband."

"Reputation and prestige aren’t important to me, but your Celestial Dragon Race is different. Your dragon race is one of the greatest races in this Paradise Realm, so I can’t bring shame on them because of our marriage."

Tianshi Shengjie was naturally pleased with Zhang Fei’s choice for their marriage. "However, everyone knows about you now, and news of you will eventually spread throughout all domains. If that happens, you will face even more danger."

"Yes," Zhang Fei agreed with Tianshi Shengjie. That’s why he only invited those closest to him, which was to prevent news about him from spreading further. Besides, those gates had long since disappeared, and the distance between each domain was very far, so he didn’t think much about it.
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei and all the guests present at the wedding frowned when the sky above them suddenly darkened, followed by a powerful pressure descending on them, which caused everyone to panic.
Zhang Fei’s four clones quickly moved to send most of his wives into the training space, as the pressure was too strong for them to withstand.
Zhang Fei activated the soul link, pulled Tianshi Shengjie into his arms, and protected her.
Long Wuzhao, Tianshi Bailong, Long Xukong, and the other leaders of all races moved to protect the guests. They were assisted by people from the Xuanyuan Clan and the Puyang Clan.
Feng Yao moved beside Zhang Fei and Tianshi Shengjie. "What exactly happened, Yao’er? Where did this powerful pressure come from?"
"Do you really not recognize the aura of this pressure, husband?" Feng Yao casually asked back.
Zhang Fei raised an eyebrow and tried to sense the aura, which shocked him. "This."
"That’s right!" Feng Yao nodded. "This aura belongs to the Primordial Nihility Beast, and he seems to have come to capture Long Wuzhao."
Zhang Fei’s expression turned ugly, not expecting that the Primordial Nihility Beast would descend during his wedding with Tianshi Shengjie.

"Let’s go up there!" Feng Yao quickly flew into the sky, followed by Zhang Fei. Tianshi Shengjie wanted to join them, but he stopped her because she was too weak to face the Primordial Nihility Beast.
"What exactly is going on here, Empress Huo?" Long Wuzhao asked.
Soon, a giant black vortex appeared in the sky, and they heard a loud roar, followed by a powerful sound wave, which knocked most of the wedding guests unconscious.
"Such power!" Tianshi Bailong and the others were shocked to see that.
Feng Yao inwardly sighed. "A powerful enemy has come to capture you, Long Wuzhao!"
"You mean—" Long Wuzhao immediately realized it.
"That’s right!" Feng Yao pointed to the center of the black vortex. "The Primordial Nihility Beast has come to capture you!"
Long Wuzhao and everyone else in the sky were shocked upon hearing this, except for one person. That person’s gaze was solely focused on Long Wuzhao.
