chapters.title: Chapter 1748: Huang Yuanzhi - Xu Yuanzhi
paragraphs: The Primordial Nihility Beast had not yet descended, but Long Wuzhao and all the cultivators in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain were horrified by the appearance of a white vortex a little away from the black vortex, which caused the pressure pressing down on them to become even stronger.
"The Primordial Genesis Beast."
Long Wuzhao and the others froze after Feng Yao said that name; they were truly horrified by the appearance of the two primordial beasts.
Mass panic swept across the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and all the cultivators scattered to leave the domain.
"How are we going to defeat them? They didn’t come down here using their real bodies, right?"

"No." Feng Yao shook her head. "The two primordial beasts are still in a deep slumber in the Primordial Realm, and the two that will appear soon are their avatars. Although these two are only their avatars, they are still far stronger than the Ancients, let alone the cultivators of this Paradise Realm."

The faces of all the cultivators who heard Feng Yao’s words turned pale, including Yuan Xiajie and the people from the Puyang and Xuanyuan Clans. None of them dared to doubt her words because she was the strongest cultivator in the Paradise Realm.
Unlike them, Feng Yao still had a relaxed attitude, and a faint smile appeared on her beautiful face. "It’s been a long time since I last saw them, so I’m going to play around with them a little."
All eyes instantly turned to Feng Yao, staring at her in disbelief. However, they could see that she was so calm, and her calmness sent a chill down their spine.
Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei. "After today, I won’t be able to accompany you anymore, so you have to take good care of yourself out there."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned.

Feng Yao explained to him directly, "The Paradise Realm... Wrong... The entire universe won’t be able to contain my power. This realm will be destroyed if I stay here, and I will have to enter a deep slumber like the other primordials. As for your soul world, it isn’t yet capable of containing my true strength, so I can’t stay in it either."
"Didn’t you forget something, Yao’er?" Zhang Fei rubbed Feng Yao’s face.
"Haha," Feng Yao laughed softly. "Do you really want to use that method?"
"We have no other choice, right?" Zhang Fei replied with a helpless sigh. "I didn’t want to use that method, but I didn’t want you to leave me, so it was the only way to keep you by my side."
"What are you two talking about?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.
Feng Yao did not reply to Tianshi Shengjie and pressed her forehead against Zhang Fei’s. "Let’s do it! We won’t run out of time if their avatars appear!"

"Alright." Zhang Fei began the process of taking Feng Yao as his contract beast, which shocked all the cultivators present. They knew that she was his wife, but they didn’t expect that she would decide to become his contract beast, especially with her aloof character.
’This woman has gone mad because of love!’

The people of the Puyang Clan could only shake their heads at that, but today’s events made them realize that Feng Yao’s feelings for Zhang Fei were already deep-rooted, and she was willing to become his contract beast because she would rather not leave him.
Unlike them, the people of the Xuanyuan Clan did not yet know the depth of Feng Yao and Zhang Fei’s relationship, and they thought that her actions were truly ridiculous and unbelievable.
Seeing them, Yuan Xiajie could only shake her head. ’This woman loves him to death!’

One of the overseers’ expressions darkened when he saw that, and he considered stopping them, but he decided against it on second thought because his actions would expose him. However, he was unaware that everyone already knew his hidden secret, including a junior like Tianshi Shengjie.

Soon, the contract between them was established, and Feng Yao smiled at Zhang Fei. "From today onwards, I am your wife and contract beast, husband. However, you cannot summon me carelessly because your actions will anger those hidden forces, and they will not forgive you."
"I don’t know for sure the strength of those hidden forces, but I will never bow down to them, and I will eliminate them one day." Zhang Fei spoke solemnly.
Zhang Fei and Feng Yao’s conversation confused everyone, except for those close to them, such as Tianshi Shengjie, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and the others.
Feng Yao smiled. "I believe you will be able to do that in the future, but you must also know that your actions will change the future of this universe and all its inhabitants."

"Do you think I care about that?" Zhang Fei asked with a shake of his head. "I am the most selfish living creature in this universe, remember? If those hidden forces dare to stand in my way, I will do whatever it takes to destroy them, no matter what the final result is."
"Let’s talk about that matter later because the two uninvited guests will appear soon." Zhang Fei nodded to Feng Yao, and they returned their gaze to the white and black vortex.
A few minutes later, Long Wuzhao and all the cultivators present held their breath, and their bodies trembled violently, seeing the heads of two giant beasts emerge from the black and white vortex.
The head of the Primordial Nihility Beast was completely black, with deep, dark eyes that sent a chill down one’s spine.

The head of the Primordial Genesis Beast was smooth and pure white, feeling too perfect. His eyes were pure white too, with no pupils or color at all. There was no expression in his gaze, no anger or kindness, just a calm, distant feeling.
Zhang Fei hugged Tianshi Shengjie, who was trembling with fear, tightly. "I’ll send you to my training space, okay?"
"No," Tianshi Shengjie refused by shaking her head. "Today is our wedding day, so I will not leave you, and I will stay by your side to face the two beasts."
"Alright." Zhang Fei looked at the other woman. "Qingxiu! Mingran! Mother-in-law! Move behind me and don’t move."
Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe didn’t argue with Zhang Fei and moved behind him. Luo Fenghan, Huang Xiaoyi, and everyone close to him also moved behind him.
"Ling’er."
Huo Ling instantly appeared on Zhang Fei’s shoulder and protected everyone close to him with her aura.
The heads of the two primordial beasts had already fully emerged from the two vortexes, intently looking at the people below them before sneering.

Long Wuzhao and the others froze after Feng Yao said that name; they were truly horrified by the appearance of the two primordial beasts.
Mass panic swept across the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain, and all the cultivators scattered to leave the domain.
"How are we going to defeat them?

"No." Feng Yao shook her head.

"It’s been a long time since I last saw them, so I’m going to play around with them a little."
All eyes instantly turned to Feng Yao, staring at her in disbelief.

Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei.
"After today, I won’t be able to accompany you anymore, so you have to take good care of yourself out there."
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned.
Feng Yao explained to him directly, "The Paradise Realm...
Wrong...
The entire universe won’t be able to contain my power.
This realm will be destroyed if I stay here, and I will have to enter a deep slumber like the other primordials.
As for your soul world, it isn’t yet capable of containing my true strength, so I can’t stay in it either."

"Haha," Feng Yao laughed softly.
"Do you really want to use that method?"
"We have no other choice, right?" Zhang Fei replied with a helpless sigh.
"I didn’t want to use that method, but I didn’t want you to leave me, so it was the only way to keep you by my side."
"What are you two talking about?" Tianshi Shengjie asked.
Feng Yao did not reply to Tianshi Shengjie and pressed her forehead against Zhang Fei’s.
"Let’s do it!
We won’t run out of time if their avatars appear!"

’This woman has gone mad because of love!’

The people of the Puyang Clan could only shake their heads at that, but today’s events made them realize that Feng Yao’s feelings for Zhang Fei were already deep-rooted, and she was willing to become his contract beast because she would rather not leave him.

One of the overseers’ expressions darkened when he saw that, and he considered stopping them, but he decided against it on second thought because his actions would expose him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1749: Unseal
paragraphs: "Humph!" Xu Yuanzhi snorted. "Do you think we need to be afraid of you? Your strength is nothing compared to what it was in the past, and we can kill you like an ant."
Huo Ling frowned as she listened to Xu Yuanzhi’s insults towards Feng Yao, but she didn’t move because her master ordered her to stay still.

Unlike Xu Yuanzhi, Huang Yuanzhi didn’t dare underestimate Feng Yao, even though her cultivation wasn’t as high as it was in the past. He clearly remembers her cunning and deceit when she tricked him in the past. "Kill her! I will catch that dragon and fox."
Long Wuzhao and the others became tense as soon as Huang Yuanzhi flew towards them, and Feng Yao also made no move to stop him.
Before Huang Yuanzhi could get close to them, Zhang Fei enveloped them with his aura and teleported away, leaving him stunned for a moment.

"So, it’s true, huh? That fox brat is Hu Tianlang’s successor because he’s the only fox who can teleport!" Huang Yuanzhi was excited and tried to chase Zhang Fei again, but he swiftly took everyone beside him to teleport several times, angering him. "Damn it! What a troublesome ability!"
"How long are you going to stall?" Huo Ling asked.
"Be patient, Ling’er." Zhang Fei glanced at Feng Yao and Xu Yuanzhi. "She’ll do something soon, so we’ll stall for now."
Naturally, Huo Ling knew Feng Yao’s plan, but she couldn’t wait to beat up Huang Yuanzhi. She stretched out her slender right hand and shot a fireball at him.
Huang Yuanzhi frowned and dodged the fireball, but he felt something familiar about it. "What kind of fire is that? Why does it give me a strangely familiar feeling?"
Zhang Fei and his four clones took advantage of the situation to lead everyone away from Huang Yuanzhi.
Long Wuzhao and the others wanted to help Zhang Fei, but he forbade them because they were clearly not Huang Yuanzhi’s opponents. "Be patient and wait."

Xu Yuanzhi was also shocked to see Zhang Fei taking many people to teleport, but his smile widened like a madman’s. "Hahaha! I didn’t expect that my decision to descend to this domain today would help me discover so many good things! At first, I descended here to kill that golden dragon, but I didn’t expect to find you and that male fox here."

"You are still as arrogant as in the past! Since you still haven’t changed, I have to plant something in your brain to eliminate your arrogance." Feng Yao calmly spoke, but her words caused Xu Yuanzhi to shiver.

Xu Yuanzhi calmed himself, his gaze became sharp, and he mocked Feng Yao. "Do you think you can do that with your current cultivation? Since you’re so eager to beat me, I’ll teach you a lesson, and I’ll have some fun with you after you’ve weakened."
"Sleeping for a long time has made you stupid." Xu Yuanzhi tried to grab Feng Yao by the neck, but she grabbed his hand and threw him away.
"Shit!" Xu Yuanzhi stabilized himself after a moment of shock. "How can you move that fast?"
Not only was Xu Yuanzhi shocked by Feng Yao’s speed, but Huang Yuanzhi was also shocked by Zhang Fei’s speed, which was much faster than his.
Feng Yao disappeared for a moment and reappeared behind Xu Yuanzhi. She threw a hard and fast punch at his back, but he immediately turned around and blocked the blow.

Once again, Xu Yuanzhi tried to capture Feng Yao, but his efforts failed again, which left him baffled. As he thought about this, a strong blow landed on his chest, but he didn’t feel anything and only raised his eyebrows for a moment.
Xu Yuanzhi looked at Feng Yao, who was quite far in front of him. "Do you think you can hurt me with your current strength? I admit your speed is extraordinary, but you are simply too weak."
"Is that so?" The smirk on Feng Yao’s face gave Xu Yuanzhi a goosebump. "Do you think I can reach this stage at my current age?"
Xu Yuanzhi raised an eyebrow for a moment before turning shocked the next moment. "Fuck! You’re still under a thousand years old!"
"Hahaha!" Feng Yao touched her chest. "Unseal!"
Xu Yuanzhi was shocked and frightened as soon as he felt Feng Yao’s cultivation rising rapidly. "Shit! I should have known that she had sealed her past strength before reincarnating!"

Huang Yuanzhi, who was previously chasing Zhang Fei and Long Wuzhao, suddenly stopped and looked at Feng Yao. He frowned upon realizing that her cultivation was increasing rapidly, but he chose to ignore her and continued his pursuit, increasing his speed significantly.

Xu Yuanzhi flew towards Feng Yao to kill her before it was too late, but a pillar of fire suddenly emerged from within her body. He wasn’t afraid of the fire pillar, but he was shocked when he saw the silhouette of a giant fire phoenix appear behind her.
"Fuck!" Xu Yuanzhi cursed as the silhouette of a giant fire phoenix shot a huge fireball at him. He countered it with a giant black ball, and the two collided in midair.

Xu Yuanzhi didn’t stop there and summoned a giant black spear that looked more like a giant horn, which he threw at Feng Yao. The silhouette of a giant fire phoenix didn’t let the spear hit her, and the beast countered it with another fireball.
*Boom*

The fireball disappeared after the huge explosion, but the black spear did not disappear, and it continued to shoot towards Feng Yao. Before the spear hit the fire pillar, a fire arrow shot lightning fast from a distance and hit the spear.
Xu Yuanzhi was shocked to see the black spear disappear; he tried to find the source of the fire arrow. He saw Huang Yuanzhi pointing at Huo Ling, who was sitting casually on Zhang Fei’s shoulders.
"That girl used that fire arrow just now!"

Xu Yuanzhi could hear the worry in Huang Yuanzhi’s tone. He looked at Feng Yao, who was still in the process of unsealing her cultivation. He knew that she would need quite a bit of time to recover her cultivation.
"Tch!" Xu Yuanzhi gnashed his teeth before flying beside Huang Yuanzhi. "Let’s go! We have to capture them before Shen Yuanzhi finishes, or it will be too late!"
"Let’s go!"
Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi flew toward Zhang Fei and the others, aiming to capture him and Long Wuzhao. However, they suddenly heard a woman’s snort, and a flame sphere enveloped them.

Wasting no time, Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi launched attacks at the flame sphere to destroy it. However, the results were not as they had hoped, as the fire sphere did not disintegrate; instead, their attacks dissipated upon contact.
"Who are you?"
"Humph!" Huo Ling snorted. "Do you think I’ll let you capture them? If I wanted to, I could have destroyed both of your avatars from the start, but my master asked me to buy some time."
Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi instinctively saw the appearance of the fire pillar, and they immediately realized that Huo Ling’s master was Feng Yao.

"Humph!" Huo Ling shot two fire arrows at Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi, and the dread they felt forced them to avoid both of them. "Coward! I only used a little of my strength, but you don’t dare to block my fire arrows! You two should have killed yourselves because you already disgraced the primordials!"
Huo Ling’s sharp insult to Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi made Zhang Fei and the others laugh. Meanwhile, the two men’s faces darkened, and their facial muscles protruded from beneath their skin.

Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi wanted to attack Huo Ling, but the sky above them suddenly turned dark, with lightning bolts flashing across the sky. A second later, the temperature in the domain rose sharply, causing everyone to feel hot.

Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi looked at the fire pillar again, but it had disappeared, and standing there was the woman they had feared so much. "Impossible! How could her cultivation have reached that level?"

After a moment of shock, Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi’s expressions changed to joy as a lightning dragon descended from the sky towards Feng Yao. However, Zhang Fei’s four clones suddenly appeared in front of her and blocked the lightning dragon, which shocked them again.
"Haha!" Xu Yuanzhi laughed loudly. "That fox brat is such an idiot! He overestimates himself!"
Huang Yuanzhi narrowed his eyes, sensing something different from the bodies of the four Zhang Fei’s clones.
Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi were confused when Feng Yao became two, and her clone immediately disappeared after one of Zhang Fei’s clones sent her to the beast space.
Huo Ling, who also saw that, grinned faintly. "Husband, are you sure you want to do that?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded. "Fighting the avatars of the two primordial beasts is a rare opportunity, so I won’t miss this chance."
"Alright! You can fight them, and I will protect you."
Zhang Fei activated the soul connect and the soul link to borrow the power of Feng Yao and all the beasts in the beast space.
*Boom*
Zhang Fei’s burst of aura drew the attention of Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi to him. "What the hell? How could his cultivation improve that fast?"
Unlike Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi, Long Wuzhao and the people who knew Zhang Fei were not surprised by it because they had often seen him improve his cultivation using certain methods.

"Ling’er, you must protect them." Huo Ling was reluctant to do so, but she had no other choice, so she agreed to Zhang Fei’s request. "Since you two descended into the domain to capture us, and you also ruined my wedding, I will deal with you now."

Huo Ling, who also saw that, grinned faintly.
"Husband, are you sure you want to do that?"
"Yes," Zhang Fei nodded.
"Fighting the avatars of the two primordial beasts is a rare opportunity, so I won’t miss this chance."
"Alright!
You can fight them, and I will protect you."
Zhang Fei activated the soul connect and the soul link to borrow the power of Feng Yao and all the beasts in the beast space.
*Boom*
Zhang Fei’s burst of aura drew the attention of Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi to him.
"What the hell?
How could his cultivation improve that fast?"
Unlike Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi, Long Wuzhao and the people who knew Zhang Fei were not surprised by it because they had often seen him improve his cultivation using certain methods.
"Ling’er, you must protect them." Huo Ling was reluctant to do so, but she had no other choice, so she agreed to Zhang Fei’s request.
"Since you two descended into the domain to capture us, and you also ruined my wedding, I will deal with you now."

chapters.title: Chapter 1750: The Hidden Forces
paragraphs: Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi didn’t expect that Zhang Fei’s four clones could withstand the power of the first lightning dragon, and they absorbed it for their own benefit.

Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi knew for sure that Feng Yao’s lightning tribulation would not stop there, and the heavens would not let her live after all that she did in the past. Unfortunately, they didn’t know anything about Zhang Fei, especially about all the lightning tribulations he had gone through throughout his life.

Zhang Fei’s four clones were very calm in facing the lightning dragon, and they absorbed its power as quickly as possible because they knew that Feng Yao’s lightning tribulation had not yet finished, and it would become stronger and stronger.
After the first lightning dragon disappeared, another two lightning dragons descended from the sky, snaking towards Feng Yao and Zhang Fei’s four clones.
*Scree*

Four Azure Emperor Rocs appeared in the dark sky, shocking everyone present, including Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi. Four lightning domains enveloped Feng Yao and Zhang Fei’s four clones after the Azure Emperor Rocs appeared.

The four Azure Emperor Rocs opened their mouths and attacked the two lightning dragons, which collided with the four lightning domains. Within seconds, the two lightning dragons disappeared from the sky, and Zhang Fei’s four clones absorbed their power as before.

Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi were completely shocked, finding it difficult to believe what they saw. If they hadn’t seen it all with their own eyes, they wouldn’t have believed that anyone could withstand the lightning dragons so easily. Even though they were primordial beasts, they didn’t dare underestimate their lightning tribulations because they had already faced their horrors in the past.

"Do you two understand now?" Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi looked at Zhang Fei and gulped hard because his cultivation had already surpassed the Five Celestial Realms, and it was still increasing along with Feng Yao’s cultivation. "Many people are afraid of their lightning tribulations, but I’m different from them. Although my cultivation isn’t as high as my wife’s or the two of you, I’ve faced countless lightning tribulations since I broke through to the Earth Realm, and the heavens are desperate to kill me because I’ve always survived my lightning tribulations."
"Impossible!" Xu Yuanzhi roared. "How did you survive those lightning tribulations?"

"Because I am special! The heavens will never be able to kill me even if they manifest themselves!" Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi’s lips twitched at Zhang Fei’s boast. "You two might not believe me, but the heavens have already manifested themselves twice: once when I broke through to the Seven Divine Realms and once when I broke through to the Five Celestial Realms, and both times they failed to kill me."
"You—Gah!" Xu Yuanzhi was sent flying backwards as soon as Zhang Fei moved, forcing him to stabilize himself. "You—Shit!"
Xu Yuanzhi crossed both arms in front of his face to block Zhang Fei’s attack, but the attack sent him flying once again.
Huang Yuanzhi, who saw that, immediately moved to attack Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei immediately teleported behind Huang Yuanzhi and kicked his back.
"Gah!" Huang Yuanzhi rolled in the air several times before jumping next to Xu Yuanzhi. "I didn’t expect your speed to be so fast, and I couldn’t feel your aura when you moved."

"Aura?" Zhang Fei smirked and suppressed his aura so that no one could feel it, including Hu Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi. "You two are primordial beasts, but your two avatars are not my match, especially since they only have half your strength."
Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi didn’t understand how Zhang Fei could suppress his aura and increase his speed to such a high speed, but they were aware that their two avatars were not his match.
*Rumble...Rumble...*
*Roar*

They looked up at the sky, and four lightning dragons that were stronger than the previous three were hurtling towards Feng Yao to kill her, but Zhang Fei’s four clones wouldn’t allow that, and the four Azure Emperor Rocs attacked the dragons again.
Unlike before, those four lightning dragons did not disappear, and they absorbed the attack power of the four Azure Emperor Rocs to strengthen themselves.
"Hahaha!" Xu Yuanzhi laughed upon seeing that. "You are so arrogant, but you will never be able to save Shen Yuanzhi from her lightning tribulations!"
"Is that so?" Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi frowned when they saw the calmness on Zhang Fei’s face. "Take a good look!"

Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi returned their gazes to Feng Yao and Zhang Fei’s four clones. Their eyes widened in shock as they saw four Ice Phoenixes appear beside the four Azure Emperor Rocs, and all them flew toward the four lightning dragons, shattering them.
"This." Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi found it hard to believe that Zhang Fei’s four clones could summon four Ice Phoenixes, which could destroy the four lightning dragons so easily.
Zhang Fei smirked. "As long as I exist in this universe, the heavens must bow beneath my feet, let alone primordial beasts like you two."

Zhang Fei’s arrogant words echoed clearly in the ears of everyone present in the Dragon-Soaring Divine Domain. Some thought he was too arrogant; some thought it was natural given his strength in facing those lightning tribulations, and some were speechless or unable to express an opinion.
Zhang Fei narrowed his eyes to Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi. "You two should leave now and never return to this realm; otherwise, I will destroy both of your avatars."
"Cocky!" Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi flew towards Zhang Fei, but he swiftly trapped them in his soul domain, absorbing their soul power. "This."

Zhang Fei activated his speed domain, and he wasted no time in beating Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi. He wanted to destroy the second avatar of the primordial beasts, but Feng Yao forbade him to do so for some reason.

Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi tried to protect themselves from Zhang Fei’s attack, but his speed was simply too frighteningly fast, and their defenses were insufficient to stop it. In the blink of an eye, their bodies were covered in wounds and blood from all his heavy attacks.
The people, who were watching Zhang Fei and the two primordial beasts fight, could only hold their breaths, including Yuan Xiajie and the people from the Xuanyuan and Puyang Clans.
None of them could see Zhang Fei’s movement because his speed was too fast for their eyes, except for Tianshi Shengjie, Qi Qingxiu, Ye Mingran, and Nalan Shizhe.
Even Puyang Yeyu and Mo Zainan, who had been training in the training space, still couldn’t see Zhang Fei’s movements.

Zhang Fei’s speed was already incredibly fast from the start, and it became even faster once he used his speed domain. No matter how high their cultivation and speed were, none of them could keep up with his movements.

As primordial beasts, Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi had never felt so hopeless before, and their bodies ached from the heaviness of each attack by Zhang Fei, especially after he borrowed Feng Yao’s power, which continued to grow.
In the end, Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi chose to flee. "You brat! We’ll definitely come back to kill you!"
"At that time, we’ll torture you until you beg for death!"
Zhang Fei smirked. "I’m ready at any time! At that time, I won’t spare you two anymore, and you guys will become my contract beasts!"
Long Wuzhao and the others breathed a sigh of relief after Huang Yuanzhi and Xu Yuanzhi disappeared, but they became tense again once the eight lightning dragons descended from the sky.
Zhang Fei moved in front of his four clones, summoned the demon extermination sword, and took a stance to attack the eight dragons. "Final move: Sever the Heavenly Path!"
As soon as the giant golden sword appeared above Zhang Fei, it moved toward the eight lightning dragons. However, they dodged the sword before sharply swerving toward Feng Yao.
Fortunately, Zhang Fei’s clones’ four domains were still active and held off the eight lightning dragons. The four Ice Phoenixes and the four Azure Emperor Rocs immediately attacked them.
Zhang Fei breathed a sigh of relief once the eight lightning dragons disappeared, and his four clones absorbed their power.
The next moment, several powerful pressures descended from the sky, pressing down on all the cultivators present and forcing them to their knees.

Zhang Fei himself could feel those pressures, but he steeled himself not to kneel. Huo Ling immediately moved next to him and sat on his shoulders. "The situation is getting troublesome, husband! They are those hidden powers!"
"Hmm?" Zhang Fei frowned. "Are they really going to show up today?"
"Yes," Huo Ling nodded seriously. "Your actions and my master’s cultivation forced them to show up, but I don’t know what they’ll do next."
Soon, several figures appeared in the sky, and Zhang Fei recognized one of them because he was the embodiment of the heavens. He clenched his fists and looked at them with high alert.

One of them looked at Feng Yao, who had not completed the process of unsealing her power. He waved his hand, and Zhang Fei’s clones’ four domains instantly disappeared along with the four Ice Phoenixes and the four Azure Emperor Rocs.

Since he became a cultivator, Zhang Fei had encountered countless powerful enemies, and some of them had left him terrified. However, the fear he felt today was far greater, and he found it difficult to breathe in the face of those hidden forces. ’They are truly terrifying!’
They didn’t disturb Feng Yao and focused their gazes on Zhang Fei. "The sole heir of the ten-tailed fox is truly impressive; you don’t even kneel before our presence."
Zhang Fei took a deep breath. "Why did you guys decide to show up today?"
